@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5234 sha256=3509da576b48b5e7f348fb4dbd865afeef6e0a246ce0bbce6ab9dec1b9bc3822 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/Entry.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.GuardGeometry

/-!
# Anchored V4 — the exact `ENTRY` proposition

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`ENTRY` is the exact entrance datum of the conditional endgame.  It is *not* the vague statement
"all large-prime rows have been handled": every condition below is an explicit proposition about
the finite omission set `Z ⊂ (aM, M)`:

* `Z` has no two adjacent positions (`NoAdjacent`);
* every `z ∈ Z` fails `z ∣ 2 * L Q`, i.e. every omitted position has normalized prime-power
  height `> Q` (`Entry.height_gt`);
* every **odd** omitted position lies in the declared high-height mask, and the mask itself only
  contains positions of height `> Q`: transition heights in the window `[Y, Q]` can therefore only
  be corrected by *even* omissions;
* the entry word value `S_init = ∑_{n ∈ [aM, M] \ Z} 1/n` satisfies the **doubled** denominator
  condition `den S_init ∣ 2 * L Q`.

`Entry` is a structure, so a proof of `∃ e : Entry M aM Q Y, …` is exactly the ENTRY-existence
owner.  `entryDegenerate` shows the axioms are consistent (a degenerate witness with `Z = ∅`);
it is **not** an ENTRY for large `M` and proves nothing about the actual owner.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- **The exact ENTRY datum** on the interval `[aM, M]` with transition window `[Y, Q]`. -/
structure Entry (M aM Q Y : ℕ) where
  /-- the omitted (zero) positions -/
  Z : Finset ℕ
  /-- the declared high-height odd-zero mask -/
  mask : Finset ℕ
  /-- the low end of the transition window is a legitimate height -/
  one_le_Y : 1 ≤ Y
  /-- the transition window `[Y, Q]` is nonempty -/
  Y_le_Q : Y ≤ Q
  /-- all omitted positions are interior to the interval -/
  Z_subset : Z ⊆ Finset.Ioo aM M
  /-- the `no-00` guard -/
  Z_noAdjacent : NoAdjacent Z
  /-- every omitted position is outside the `2 L Q` lattice -/
  Z_not_dvd : ∀ z ∈ Z, ¬ (z ∣ 2 * L Q)
  /-- odd omissions are confined to the declared mask -/
  Z_odd_mask : ∀ z ∈ Z, ¬ Even z → z ∈ mask
  /-- the mask only contains genuinely high-height positions -/
  mask_high : ∀ n ∈ mask, Q < normHeight n
  /-- the **doubled** denominator condition on the entry word value -/
  den_init : (wordSum (Finset.Icc aM M) Z).den ∣ 2 * L Q

namespace Entry

variable {M aM Q Y : ℕ}

/-- The entry word value. -/
def Sinit (e : Entry M aM Q Y) : ℚ := wordSum (Finset.Icc aM M) e.Z

lemma one_le_Q (e : Entry M aM Q Y) : 1 ≤ Q := le_trans e.one_le_Y e.Y_le_Q

lemma Z_pos (e : Entry M aM Q Y) {z : ℕ} (hz : z ∈ e.Z) : 0 < z := by
  have := e.Z_subset hz
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo] at this
  omega

/-- **Height form of the entry condition**: every omitted position has normalized prime-power
height strictly above the top of the transition window. -/
theorem height_gt (e : Entry M aM Q Y) {z : ℕ} (hz : z ∈ e.Z) : Q < normHeight z := by
  by_contra h
  exact e.Z_not_dvd z hz
    ((normalizedHeight_le_iff_dvd_two_lcm (e.Z_pos hz).ne' e.one_le_Q).2
      (not_lt.1 h))

/-- Positions of height `≤ Q` are never in the odd-zero mask; this is the exact reason a fresh
even center with low-height neighbours is safe. -/
theorem not_mem_mask_of_height_le (e : Entry M aM Q Y) {j : ℕ} (hj : normHeight j ≤ Q) : j ∉ e.mask := by
  intro hmem
  exact absurd (e.mask_high j hmem) (not_lt.2 hj)

/-- **Safe even center.**  Omitting a fresh even position whose two neighbours have height `≤ Q`
preserves the `no-00` guard. -/
theorem noAdjacent_insert_safe (e : Entry M aM Q Y) {c : ℕ} (hc : Even c)
    (hnb : ∀ j, (j = c + 1 ∨ j + 1 = c) → normHeight j ≤ Q) :
    NoAdjacent (insert c e.Z) :=
  noAdjacent_insert_even_of_mask e.Z_noAdjacent e.Z_odd_mask hc
    (fun j hj => e.not_mem_mask_of_height_le (hnb j hj))

/-- **Safe even reservoir.**  Omitting a whole fresh block of even positions with low-height
neighbours preserves the `no-00` guard. -/
theorem noAdjacent_union_safe (e : Entry M aM Q Y) {E : Finset ℕ} (hE : ∀ c ∈ E, Even c)
    (hnb : ∀ c ∈ E, ∀ j, (j = c + 1 ∨ j + 1 = c) → normHeight j ≤ Q) :
    NoAdjacent (e.Z ∪ E) :=
  noAdjacent_union_even_of_mask e.Z_noAdjacent e.Z_odd_mask hE
    (fun c hc j hj => e.not_mem_mask_of_height_le (hnb c hc j hj))

/-- The entry denominator condition in normalized-height form. -/
theorem normHeight_den_init_le (e : Entry M aM Q Y) : normHeight e.Sinit.den ≤ Q :=
  (normalizedHeight_le_iff_dvd_two_lcm e.Sinit.den_nz e.one_le_Q).1 e.den_init

end Entry

/-- **Consistency witness** (degenerate).  The `Entry` conditions are satisfiable, so every
conditional theorem with an `Entry` hypothesis is non-vacuous.  This witness has an empty omission
set on the one-point interval `[1,1]` and says nothing about ENTRY existence for large `M`. -/
def entryDegenerate : Entry 1 0 1 1 where
  Z := ∅
  mask := ∅
  one_le_Y := le_rfl
  Y_le_Q := le_rfl
  Z_subset := by simp
  Z_noAdjacent := noAdjacent_empty
  Z_not_dvd := by simp
  Z_odd_mask := by simp
  mask_high := by simp
  den_init := by
    have h : wordSum (Finset.Icc 0 1) (∅ : Finset ℕ) = 1 := by
      decide +kernel
    rw [h]
    simp

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5275 sha256=8b0747ef67d51553ddd9a75b213b6d2877060ecf6a54605e1b1482286d9d164c path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/EntryColumns.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.ConditionalExactEndgame

/-!
# Anchored V4 — exact column arithmetic of the transition problem

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

This module converts the *analytic-looking* descent condition

`den (S − ∑_{n ∈ E} 1/n) ∣ 2 L h'`

into an **exact integer congruence** on the chosen positions, which is the honest finite form of
the global transition problem:

`numerator_at P S − ∑_{n ∈ E} (P / n) ≡ 0 (mod r)`,  where `P = 2 L h`, `P = r · P'`.

The two principal results are

* `den_dvd_quotient_iff` — the exact equivalence between a smaller denominator lattice and an
  integer divisibility of the numerator;
* `descent_congruence_iff` — its application to one descent move, so that the descent is a finite
  linear congruence over the physical positions;

together with the exact **component splitting** `dvd_mul_iff_of_coprime`, which is the reason the
single congruence modulo `r` decomposes into one constraint per active prime-power component, and
the explicit warning `column_sum_not_rowwise` that solving the global congruence does **not**
require solving it position-block by position-block.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- The integer numerator of a rational at a common denominator `P` (well defined when
`x.den ∣ P`). -/
noncomputable def numeratorAt (P : ℕ) (x : ℚ) : ℤ := (x * P).num

lemma mul_natCast_eq_numeratorAt {P : ℕ} {x : ℚ} (hx : x.den ∣ P) :
    x * P = (numeratorAt P x : ℚ) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (den_dvd_iff_mul_natCast_isInt x P).1 hx
  rw [numeratorAt, hz]
  simp

/-- **Exact descent criterion.**  For `P = r * P'` and `x` in the `P` lattice, `x` lies in the
smaller `P'` lattice exactly when `r` divides the numerator of `x` at `P`. -/
theorem den_dvd_quotient_iff {P P' r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hP : P = r * P') {x : ℚ}
    (hx : x.den ∣ P) : x.den ∣ P' ↔ (r : ℤ) ∣ numeratorAt P x := by
  have hk : x * P = (numeratorAt P x : ℚ) := mul_natCast_eq_numeratorAt hx
  have hr0 : (r : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hr.ne'
  rw [den_dvd_iff_mul_natCast_isInt]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    have : x * P = (r : ℚ) * (x * P') := by rw [hP]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hk, hz] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    have h1 : (r : ℚ) * (x * P') = (numeratorAt P x : ℚ) := by
      rw [← hk, hP]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hz] at h1
    have : (r : ℚ) * (x * P') = (r : ℚ) * (z : ℚ) := by rw [h1]; push_cast; ring
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hr0 this

/-- **The descent move as a finite linear congruence.**  Omitting the fresh positions `E` from a
word of value `S` lands in the smaller lattice `P'` exactly when the integer congruence holds. -/
theorem descent_congruence_iff {P P' r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hP : P = r * P') {S : ℚ}
    (hS : S.den ∣ P) {E : Finset ℕ} (hE : ∀ n ∈ E, n ≠ 0 ∧ n ∣ P) (hPne : P ≠ 0) :
    (S - recipSum E).den ∣ P' ↔
      (r : ℤ) ∣ numeratorAt P S - ∑ n ∈ E, (weight P n : ℤ) := by
  have hrec : recipSum E = (∑ n ∈ E, (weight P n : ℚ)) / P := recipSum_eq_weightSum hPne hE
  have hPQ : (P : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hPne
  have hden : (S - recipSum E).den ∣ P := by
    rw [den_dvd_iff_mul_natCast_isInt]
    refine ⟨numeratorAt P S - ∑ n ∈ E, (weight P n : ℤ), ?_⟩
    rw [sub_mul, hrec, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hPQ, mul_natCast_eq_numeratorAt hS]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hnum : numeratorAt P (S - recipSum E) = numeratorAt P S - ∑ n ∈ E, (weight P n : ℤ) := by
    have h1 : (S - recipSum E) * P = ((numeratorAt P S - ∑ n ∈ E, (weight P n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [sub_mul, hrec, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hPQ, mul_natCast_eq_numeratorAt hS]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [numeratorAt, h1]
    exact Rat.num_intCast _
  rw [den_dvd_quotient_iff hr hP hden, hnum]

/-- **Component splitting.**  A congruence modulo a product of coprime prime-power components is
exactly the conjunction of the component congruences: the global constraint decomposes into one
constraint per active component. -/
theorem dvd_mul_iff_of_coprime {r₁ r₂ : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime r₁ r₂) (x : ℤ) :
    ((r₁ * r₂ : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ x ↔ (r₁ : ℤ) ∣ x ∧ (r₂ : ℤ) ∣ x := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨dvd_trans (by exact_mod_cast Dvd.intro _ rfl) hx,
      dvd_trans (by exact_mod_cast Dvd.intro_left _ rfl) hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hcop : IsCoprime (r₁ : ℤ) (r₂ : ℤ) := Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.2 (by simpa using h)
    push_cast
    exact hcop.mul_dvd h1 h2

/-- **Global, not rowwise.**  A single global congruence can be solved by a set of positions no
sub-block of which solves it: the column compiler is allowed to use cancellations that are
invisible to any per-block treatment.  Explicit witness: modulo `5`, the positions with weights
`2` and `3` jointly hit the target `0`, while neither alone does. -/
theorem column_sum_not_rowwise :
    ((5 : ℤ) ∣ ((2 : ℤ) + 3)) ∧ ¬ ((5 : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ)) ∧ ¬ ((5 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ)) := by
  refine ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=2460 sha256=47cc08e3a9b46c9e13cac7de56626750bc51db2994356f820ad3b9a91cf255dd path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/EntryMobility.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.TransitionSystem

/-!
# Anchored V4 — mobility versus the column image (Route B)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Route B asks whether target mobility can move a transition target into the image of the global
column compiler.  The honest content of that question is an **exact intersection statement**, not
a counting statement: a coset of the mobility subgroup meets the column subgroup exactly when the
target lies in their sum.

* `coset_meets_subgroup_iff` — the exact intersection theorem (any abelian group);
* `mobility_targets_not_hit` — a finite witness with four distinct mobility targets which are all
  disjoint from the column image.  Many distinct targets do **not** imply a hit.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- **Exact coset/subgroup intersection.**  For subgroups `H` (mobility) and `K` (column image) of
an abelian group, the mobility coset of a target `t` meets the column image iff `t ∈ H ⊔ K`. -/
theorem coset_meets_subgroup_iff {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (H K : AddSubgroup G) (t : G) :
    (∃ h ∈ H, t + h ∈ K) ↔ t ∈ H ⊔ K := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hh, hk⟩
    have : t = (-h) + (t + h) := by abel
    rw [this]
    exact AddSubgroup.mem_sup.2 ⟨-h, H.neg_mem hh, t + h, hk, rfl⟩
  · intro ht
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_sup.1 ht
    refine ⟨-y, H.neg_mem hy, ?_⟩
    have : t + (-y) = z := by rw [← hyz]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact hz

/-- Four distinct mobility targets modulo `8`. -/
def mobilityTargets : Finset (ZMod 8) := {1, 3, 5, 7}

/-- The column image modulo `8` of this witness. -/
def columnImage : Finset (ZMod 8) := {0, 4}

/-- **Firewall (mobility fallacy).**  A mobility family with many distinct targets can be entirely
disjoint from the column image: target abundance is not an intersection theorem. -/
theorem mobility_targets_not_hit :
    mobilityTargets.card = 4 ∧ Disjoint mobilityTargets columnImage := by
  constructor
  · decide
  · decide

/-- Route B in its only legitimate form: mobility solves the transition target exactly when the
target lies in the sum of the mobility subgroup and the column subgroup. -/
theorem mobility_route_B {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (H K : AddSubgroup G) (t : G) :
    (∃ h ∈ H, t + h ∈ K) ↔ t ∈ H ⊔ K := coset_meets_subgroup_iff H K t

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4885 sha256=add42c1f3b08801dc25e6adb9cf87259e3fb1a92951fb511b71dcb417dd623e6 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/EntryObstructions.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.EntryMobility

/-!
# Anchored V4 — necessary conditions for ENTRY, and the status of ENTRY existence

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

ENTRY existence is the live research owner.  This module proves genuine **necessary** conditions
that any ENTRY must satisfy, which is what a future construction has to meet (or a future
impossibility proof has to contradict):

* `normHeight_le_self` — the normalized prime-power height never exceeds its argument;
* `Entry.Q_lt_mem` — consequently **every omitted position exceeds `Q`**;
* `noAdjacent_card_bound` and `Entry.two_mul_card_le` — a guarded omission set inside `(aM, M)`
  has at most `(M − aM)/2` elements;
* `Entry.odd_mem_mask` — every odd omitted position is inside the declared mask, so the mask must
  itself contain enough high-height positions.

`EntryExists` is the exact open owner.  It is inhabited here **only** in the degenerate
one-point case, which is explicitly *not* an ENTRY for large `M`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- The normalized prime-power height of a positive integer never exceeds it. -/
theorem normHeight_le_self {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : normHeight n ≤ n := by
  rw [normHeight, max_le_iff]
  refine ⟨hn, Finset.sup_le ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hdvd : p ^ n.factorization p ∣ n := Nat.ordProj_dvd n p
  have hle : p ^ n.factorization p ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
  by_cases hp2 : p = 2
  · subst hp2
    rw [heightAt_two]
    calc 2 ^ (n.factorization 2 - 1) ≤ 2 ^ n.factorization 2 :=
          Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ ≤ n := hle
  · rw [heightAt_odd hp2]
    exact hle

/-- **Necessary condition.**  Every omitted position of an ENTRY is larger than `Q`. -/
theorem Entry.Q_lt_mem {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (e : Entry M aM Q Y) {z : ℕ} (hz : z ∈ e.Z) : Q < z :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (e.height_gt hz) (normHeight_le_self (e.Z_pos hz))

/-- A guarded (`no-00`) omission set inside the open interval `(aM, M)` has at most half as many
elements as the interval has positions. -/
theorem noAdjacent_card_bound {aM M : ℕ} {Z : Finset ℕ} (hZ : Z ⊆ Finset.Ioo aM M)
    (hna : NoAdjacent Z) : 2 * Z.card ≤ M - aM := by
  classical
  have hdisj : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ z' ∈ Z, z ≠ z' →
      Disjoint ({z, z + 1} : Finset ℕ) ({z', z' + 1} : Finset ℕ) := by
    intro z hz z' hz' hne
    simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    have h1 : z + 1 ∉ Z := hna z hz
    have h2 : z' + 1 ∉ Z := hna z' hz'
    rintro a (rfl | rfl) hcon <;> rcases hcon with h | h
    · exact hne h
    · exact h2 (by rw [← h]; exact hz)
    · exact h1 (by rw [h]; exact hz')
    · exact hne (by omega)
  have hsub : Z.biUnion (fun z => ({z, z + 1} : Finset ℕ)) ⊆ Finset.Icc (aM + 1) M := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hx⟩ := hx
    have := hZ hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo] at this
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl <;> omega
  have hcard : (Z.biUnion (fun z => ({z, z + 1} : Finset ℕ))).card = 2 * Z.card := by
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion hdisj]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => by simp : ∀ z ∈ Z, ({z, z + 1} : Finset ℕ).card = 2)]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [hcard, Nat.card_Icc] at this
  omega

/-- **Necessary condition.**  An ENTRY omission set is at most half the size of the interval. -/
theorem Entry.two_mul_card_le {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (e : Entry M aM Q Y) : 2 * e.Z.card ≤ M - aM :=
  noAdjacent_card_bound e.Z_subset e.Z_noAdjacent

/-- **Necessary condition.**  Every odd omitted position lies in the declared mask, and the mask
consists of positions of height `> Q`. -/
theorem Entry.odd_mem_mask {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (e : Entry M aM Q Y) {z : ℕ} (hz : z ∈ e.Z)
    (hodd : ¬ Even z) : z ∈ e.mask ∧ Q < normHeight z :=
  ⟨e.Z_odd_mask z hz hodd, e.height_gt hz⟩

/-- **The ENTRY-existence owner.**  This is the live research question; it is `OPEN`. -/
def EntryExists (M aM Q Y : ℕ) : Prop := Nonempty (Entry M aM Q Y)

/-- The degenerate parameters admit an ENTRY.  This is a consistency check of the definition and
**not** evidence for ENTRY existence at large `M`. -/
theorem entryExists_degenerate : EntryExists 1 0 1 1 := ⟨entryDegenerate⟩

/-- Any ENTRY at parameters with a nonempty omission set forces the interval to be long enough;
recorded as the first quantitative constraint on a candidate construction. -/
theorem Entry.interval_length_lower_bound {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (e : Entry M aM Q Y)
    (hne : e.Z.Nonempty) : 2 ≤ M - aM := by
  have h := e.two_mul_card_le
  have : 1 ≤ e.Z.card := Finset.card_pos.2 hne
  omega

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=10929 sha256=5c4cc9ba482a5aaef261816901949a141745029f7daa9be0db0908a6bc09304a path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/FourierAbsorber.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.GuardedReservoir

/-!
# Anchored V4 — the exact guarded absorber

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The absorber has to produce an **exact** rational equality `∑_{n ∈ E} 1/n = Δ`, never an
approximate one and never a congruence.  This module separates the three genuinely different
ingredients and proves the deterministic ones.

1. **Lattice reduction** (`recipSum_eq_weightSum`, `exact_absorption_iff_weight_subsetSum`).
   If every reservoir denominator divides `P` and `Δ · P = k ∈ ℕ`, then
   `∑_{n ∈ E} 1/n = Δ` is *equivalent* to the integer subset-sum equation
   `∑_{n ∈ E} (P / n) = k`.  No analysis is involved.

2. **No wraparound** (`exact_absorption_of_congruence`).  A solution of the subset-sum equation
   *modulo* `Qm` is upgraded to an exact solution precisely when the total reservoir weight and
   the target are both `< Qm`.  This is the formal firewall against confusing
   `∑ 1/n = Δ` with a congruence.

3. **Fourier counting** (`fourier_count_identity`, `congCount_pos_of_dominance`).  The exact
   finite identity

   `∑_{j < Qm} (∏_{n ∈ R} (1 + ζ^{j w n})) · (ζ^{j k})⁻¹ = Qm · #{E ⊆ R : ∑_E w ≡ k (mod Qm)}`

   is proved here for an arbitrary primitive `Qm`-th root of unity `ζ`, and yields
   `congCount > 0` whenever the trivial frequency `j = 0` dominates the remaining spectrum.

The composite theorem `exact_absorption_of_fourier_dominance` has exactly these hypotheses and no
hidden analytic input; the *asymptotic supply* of reservoirs satisfying the dominance hypothesis
remains the OPEN owner `GUARDED_ABSORBER_ANALYTIC_SUPPLY` (see `OpenOwners.lean`).
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-! ## 1. Lattice reduction -/

/-- The integer weight of a reservoir denominator at common denominator `P`. -/
def weight (P n : ℕ) : ℕ := P / n

/-- With all denominators dividing `P`, the reciprocal sum is the weight sum divided by `P`. -/
theorem recipSum_eq_weightSum {P : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {E : Finset ℕ}
    (hE : ∀ n ∈ E, n ≠ 0 ∧ n ∣ P) :
    recipSum E = (∑ n ∈ E, (weight P n : ℚ)) / P := by
  rw [recipSum, Finset.sum_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨hn0, hdvd⟩ := hE n hn
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdvd
  have hw : weight P n = c := by
    rw [weight, hc, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0)]
  have hc0 : (c : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [Nat.cast_eq_zero] at h
    rw [h, Nat.mul_zero] at hc
    exact hP hc
  have hn0' : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hn0
  rw [hw, hc]
  push_cast
  field_simp

/-- **Exact absorption is an integer subset-sum problem.** -/
theorem exact_absorption_iff_weight_subsetSum {P k : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {R : Finset ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ n ∈ R, n ≠ 0 ∧ n ∣ P) {Δ : ℚ} (hΔ : Δ * P = k) :
    (∃ E ⊆ R, recipSum E = Δ) ↔ (∃ E ⊆ R, ∑ n ∈ E, weight P n = k) := by
  have hP' : (P : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hP
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, hE, hsum⟩
    refine ⟨E, hE, ?_⟩
    have := recipSum_eq_weightSum hP (fun n hn => hR n (hE hn))
    rw [hsum] at this
    have hq : (∑ n ∈ E, (weight P n : ℚ)) = (k : ℚ) := by
      field_simp at this
      rw [← this, hΔ]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  · rintro ⟨E, hE, hsum⟩
    refine ⟨E, hE, ?_⟩
    rw [recipSum_eq_weightSum hP (fun n hn => hR n (hE hn))]
    have : (∑ n ∈ E, (weight P n : ℚ)) = (k : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast congrArg (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℚ)) hsum
    rw [this, ← hΔ]
    field_simp

/-! ## 2. Exact versus modular: the no-wraparound firewall -/

/-- **No wraparound.**  A congruence solution below the modulus is an exact solution.  This is the
only legitimate way to pass from a modular statement to the exact rational equality. -/
theorem exact_absorption_of_congruence {P k Qm : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {R : Finset ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ n ∈ R, n ≠ 0 ∧ n ∣ P) {Δ : ℚ} (hΔ : Δ * P = k)
    (hk : k < Qm) (hmass : ∑ n ∈ R, weight P n < Qm)
    (hcong : ∃ E ⊆ R, (∑ n ∈ E, weight P n) ≡ k [MOD Qm]) :
    ∃ E ⊆ R, recipSum E = Δ := by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hc⟩ := hcong
  refine (exact_absorption_iff_weight_subsetSum hP hR hΔ).2 ⟨E, hE, ?_⟩
  have hle : ∑ n ∈ E, weight P n ≤ ∑ n ∈ R, weight P n :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hE
  have h1 : (∑ n ∈ E, weight P n) % Qm = ∑ n ∈ E, weight P n :=
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hle hmass)
  have h2 : k % Qm = k := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk
  rw [Nat.ModEq, h1, h2] at hc
  exact hc

/-! ## 3. The exact finite Fourier identity -/

variable {Qm : ℕ} {ζ : ℂ}

private lemma pow_mod_eq (hζ : ζ ^ Qm = 1) (s : ℕ) : ζ ^ s = ζ ^ (s % Qm) := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod s Qm]
  rw [pow_add, pow_mul, hζ, one_pow, one_mul]

/-- Exponents of a primitive root are determined modulo the order. -/
theorem pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ Qm) (hQ : 0 < Qm) (s k : ℕ) :
    ζ ^ s = ζ ^ k ↔ s ≡ k [MOD Qm] := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [pow_mod_eq hζ.pow_eq_one s, pow_mod_eq hζ.pow_eq_one k] at h
    exact hζ.pow_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ hQ) (Nat.mod_lt _ hQ) h
  · intro h
    rw [pow_mod_eq hζ.pow_eq_one s, pow_mod_eq hζ.pow_eq_one k, h]

/-- Orthogonality of the geometric sum of a `Qm`-th root of unity. -/
theorem geom_orthogonality (x : ℂ) (hx : x ^ Qm = 1) :
    ∑ j ∈ range Qm, x ^ j = if x = 1 then (Qm : ℂ) else 0 := by
  by_cases h : x = 1
  · simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h, geom_sum_eq h, hx]; simp

/-- Expansion of the absorber generating product over all subsets. -/
theorem prod_one_add_pow (R : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    ∏ n ∈ R, (1 + z ^ (w n)) = ∑ E ∈ R.powerset, z ^ (∑ n ∈ E, w n) := by
  classical
  rw [show (fun n => 1 + z ^ w n) = (fun n => z ^ w n + 1) from funext fun n => add_comm _ _,
    Finset.prod_add]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro E _
  rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
  simp

/-- The number of subsets of the reservoir whose weight sum hits the target modulo `Qm`. -/
def congCount (R : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ) (k Qm : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (R.powerset.filter (fun E => (∑ n ∈ E, w n) ≡ k [MOD Qm])).card

/-- **Exact finite Fourier counting identity** for subset sums of the reservoir weights. -/
theorem fourier_count_identity (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ Qm) (hQ : 0 < Qm)
    (R : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range Qm, (∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (j * w n))) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹
      = Qm * (congCount R w k Qm : ℂ) := by
  classical
  have hζ0 : ζ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 := hζ.pow_eq_one
    rw [h, zero_pow (by omega)] at h1
    exact zero_ne_one h1
  have hz : ∀ m : ℕ, (ζ ^ m) ^ Qm = 1 := by
    intro m; rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, hζ.pow_eq_one, one_pow]
  have key : ∀ j ∈ range Qm, (∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (j * w n))) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹
      = ∑ E ∈ R.powerset, (ζ ^ (∑ n ∈ E, w n) * (ζ ^ k)⁻¹) ^ j := by
    intro j _
    have h1 : ∀ n, ζ ^ (j * w n) = (ζ ^ j) ^ (w n) := fun n => by rw [← pow_mul]
    simp only [h1]
    rw [prod_one_add_pow, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro E _
    have hterm : ∀ S : ℕ, ζ ^ (j * S) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹ = (ζ ^ S * (ζ ^ k)⁻¹) ^ j := by
      intro S
      rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, inv_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm S j, mul_comm k j]
    rw [← pow_mul]
    exact hterm _
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl key, Finset.sum_comm]
  have key2 : ∀ E ∈ R.powerset, ∑ j ∈ range Qm, (ζ ^ (∑ n ∈ E, w n) * (ζ ^ k)⁻¹) ^ j
      = if (∑ n ∈ E, w n) ≡ k [MOD Qm] then (Qm : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro E _
    have hx : ((ζ ^ (∑ n ∈ E, w n)) * (ζ ^ k)⁻¹) ^ Qm = 1 := by
      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, hz, hz, inv_one, mul_one]
    rw [geom_orthogonality _ hx]
    congr 1
    simp only [eq_iff_iff]
    rw [mul_inv_eq_one₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hζ0)]
    exact pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq hζ hQ _ _
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl key2, Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_const_zero,
    add_zero, congCount, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

/-- **Dominance of the trivial frequency implies a congruence solution.**  If the `j = 0` term
`2 ^ |R|` strictly exceeds the total size of the remaining spectrum, the modular subset-sum
equation has a solution. -/
theorem congCount_pos_of_dominance (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ Qm) (hQ : 0 < Qm)
    (R : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hdom : ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 Qm, ‖(∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (j * w n))) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹‖
      < 2 ^ R.card) :
    0 < congCount R w k Qm := by
  classical
  by_contra hcount
  have hzero : congCount R w k Qm = 0 := by omega
  have hid := fourier_count_identity hζ hQ R w k
  rw [hzero] at hid
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero] at hid
  have hsplit : ∑ j ∈ range Qm, (∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (j * w n))) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹
      = (∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (0 * w n))) * (ζ ^ (0 * k))⁻¹
        + ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 Qm, (∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (j * w n))) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹ := by
    rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hQ]
  have hzeroterm : (∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (0 * w n))) * (ζ ^ (0 * k))⁻¹ = 2 ^ R.card := by
    simp
    norm_num
  rw [hsplit, hzeroterm] at hid
  have hnorm : ‖(2 : ℂ) ^ R.card‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 Qm,
      ‖(∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (j * w n))) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹‖ := by
    have : ((2 : ℂ) ^ R.card) = - ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 Qm,
        (∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (j * w n))) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹ := by linear_combination hid
    rw [this, norm_neg]
    exact norm_sum_le _ _
  rw [norm_pow] at hnorm
  simp only [Complex.norm_ofNat] at hnorm
  linarith

/-- **Exact absorption from Fourier dominance.**  Every analytic input is a visible hypothesis:
the lattice condition `Δ · P = k`, the divisibility of the reservoir denominators, the
no-wraparound bounds, and the spectral dominance inequality. -/
theorem exact_absorption_of_fourier_dominance {P k : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {R : Finset ℕ}
    (hR : ∀ n ∈ R, n ≠ 0 ∧ n ∣ P) {Δ : ℚ} (hΔ : Δ * P = k)
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ Qm) (hQ : 0 < Qm)
    (hk : k < Qm) (hmass : ∑ n ∈ R, weight P n < Qm)
    (hdom : ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 Qm, ‖(∏ n ∈ R, (1 + ζ ^ (j * weight P n))) * (ζ ^ (j * k))⁻¹‖
      < 2 ^ R.card) :
    ∃ E ⊆ R, recipSum E = Δ := by
  classical
  have hpos := congCount_pos_of_dominance hζ hQ R (weight P) k hdom
  have : ∃ E ∈ R.powerset.filter (fun E => (∑ n ∈ E, weight P n) ≡ k [MOD Qm]), True := by
    rcases Finset.card_pos.1 hpos with ⟨E, hE⟩
    exact ⟨E, hE, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE, -⟩ := this
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hE
  exact exact_absorption_of_congruence hP hR hΔ hk hmass ⟨E, hE.1, hE.2⟩

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=7980 sha256=576858a786b650e6623bbc127e9f49ba16522ebf4c3112a8331703df3a494ddc path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/GuardGeometry.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.DoubledLattice

/-!
# Anchored V4 — guard geometry (the finite `no-00` combinatorics)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

A *word* on an interval `I` of denominators is described by the finite set `Z ⊆ I` of **omitted**
(zero) positions; the *selected* positions are `I \ Z` and the value of the word is the reciprocal
sum `wordSum I Z = ∑ n ∈ I \ Z, 1/n`.

The `no-00` guard is `NoAdjacent Z : ∀ i ∈ Z, i + 1 ∉ Z`.  This module proves, with no analytic
input whatsoever:

* all-even omission sets always satisfy the guard (`noAdjacent_of_all_even`);
* the guard is inherited by subsets, in particular restoring an omitted position to selected can
  never create an adjacent pair (`NoAdjacent.subset`, `NoAdjacent.erase`);
* inserting a new even center whose two (odd) neighbours are outside the declared odd-zero mask
  preserves the guard (`noAdjacent_insert_even_of_mask`);
* adding a whole fresh even reservoir preserves the guard (`noAdjacent_union_even_of_mask`);
* exact bookkeeping of the word value under omission and restoration (`wordSum_insert`,
  `wordSum_erase`), and additivity of reciprocal sums over disjoint sets.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- The reciprocal sum of a finite set of denominators. -/
def recipSum (E : Finset ℕ) : ℚ := ∑ n ∈ E, (1 : ℚ) / n

@[simp] lemma recipSum_empty : recipSum ∅ = 0 := by simp [recipSum]

lemma recipSum_insert {n : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} (h : n ∉ E) :
    recipSum (insert n E) = 1 / n + recipSum E := by
  simp [recipSum, Finset.sum_insert h]

lemma recipSum_union_of_disjoint {E F : Finset ℕ} (h : Disjoint E F) :
    recipSum (E ∪ F) = recipSum E + recipSum F := by
  simp [recipSum, Finset.sum_union h]

lemma recipSum_nonneg (E : Finset ℕ) : 0 ≤ recipSum E :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ => by positivity

/-- The value of the word on `I` with omitted positions `Z`. -/
def wordSum (I Z : Finset ℕ) : ℚ := recipSum (I \ Z)

/-- Omitting one further selected position decreases the word value by exactly its reciprocal. -/
lemma wordSum_insert {I Z : Finset ℕ} {z : ℕ} (hz : z ∈ I) (hzZ : z ∉ Z) :
    wordSum I (insert z Z) = wordSum I Z - 1 / z := by
  classical
  have hsplit : I \ Z = insert z (I \ insert z Z) := by
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x = z <;> simp [hx, hz, hzZ, Finset.mem_sdiff]
  have hnot : z ∉ I \ insert z Z := by simp
  have := recipSum_insert (n := z) (E := I \ insert z Z) hnot
  unfold wordSum
  rw [hsplit, this]
  ring

/-- Restoring an omitted position to selected increases the word value by exactly its
reciprocal. -/
lemma wordSum_erase {I Z : Finset ℕ} {z : ℕ} (hz : z ∈ I) (hzZ : z ∈ Z) :
    wordSum I (Z.erase z) = wordSum I Z + 1 / z := by
  classical
  have h1 : Z = insert z (Z.erase z) := (Finset.insert_erase hzZ).symm
  have h2 : z ∉ Z.erase z := Finset.notMem_erase z Z
  have := wordSum_insert (I := I) (Z := Z.erase z) hz h2
  rw [← h1] at this
  linarith

/-- Omitting a whole fresh block of selected positions decreases the word value by exactly the
reciprocal sum of the block. -/
lemma wordSum_union {I Z E : Finset ℕ} (hE : E ⊆ I) (hdisj : Disjoint E Z) :
    wordSum I (Z ∪ E) = wordSum I Z - recipSum E := by
  classical
  have hsub : E ⊆ I \ Z := by
    intro x hx
    exact Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hE hx, fun hxZ => (Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hx) hxZ⟩
  have hsplit : I \ (Z ∪ E) = (I \ Z) \ E := by
    ext x; simp [Finset.mem_sdiff]; tauto
  unfold wordSum recipSum
  rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_sdiff_eq_sub hsub]

/-! ## The `no-00` guard -/

/-- The guard: no two omitted positions are adjacent. -/
def NoAdjacent (Z : Finset ℕ) : Prop := ∀ i ∈ Z, i + 1 ∉ Z

@[simp] lemma noAdjacent_empty : NoAdjacent ∅ := by simp [NoAdjacent]

/-- **Two distinct even positions are never adjacent**, so an all-even omission set is always
guarded. -/
theorem noAdjacent_of_all_even {Z : Finset ℕ} (h : ∀ z ∈ Z, Even z) : NoAdjacent Z := by
  intro i hi hi1
  have h1 := h i hi
  have h2 := h (i + 1) hi1
  rw [Nat.even_add_one] at h2
  exact h2 h1

/-- The guard is inherited by subsets: restoring omitted positions to selected can never create a
new adjacent pair. -/
theorem NoAdjacent.subset {Z Z' : Finset ℕ} (hsub : Z' ⊆ Z) (h : NoAdjacent Z) :
    NoAdjacent Z' := fun i hi hi1 => h i (hsub hi) (hsub hi1)

theorem NoAdjacent.erase {Z : Finset ℕ} (z : ℕ) (h : NoAdjacent Z) : NoAdjacent (Z.erase z) :=
  h.subset (Finset.erase_subset z Z)

/-- Inserting a center whose two neighbours are not omitted preserves the guard. -/
theorem noAdjacent_insert {Z : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (h : NoAdjacent Z) (hup : c + 1 ∉ Z)
    (hdown : ∀ i ∈ Z, i + 1 ≠ c) : NoAdjacent (insert c Z) := by
  intro i hi hi1
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hi with rfl | hiZ
  · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hi1 with h1 | h1
    · omega
    · exact hup h1
  · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hi1 with h1 | h1
    · exact hdown i hiZ h1
    · exact h i hiZ h1

/-- **Safe even center.**  If every odd omitted position of `Z` lies in the declared odd-zero mask
`H`, the new center `c` is even, and both neighbours of `c` are outside `H`, then omitting `c`
preserves the guard. -/
theorem noAdjacent_insert_even_of_mask {Z H : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (h : NoAdjacent Z)
    (hmask : ∀ z ∈ Z, ¬ Even z → z ∈ H) (hc : Even c)
    (hnb : ∀ j, (j = c + 1 ∨ j + 1 = c) → j ∉ H) : NoAdjacent (insert c Z) := by
  refine noAdjacent_insert h (fun hmem => ?_) (fun i hi hic => ?_)
  · have hodd : ¬ Even (c + 1) := by simp [Nat.even_add_one, hc]
    exact hnb (c + 1) (Or.inl rfl) (hmask _ hmem hodd)
  · have hodd : ¬ Even i := by
      intro hi2
      have : Even (i + 1) := hic ▸ hc
      rw [Nat.even_add_one] at this
      exact this hi2
    exact hnb i (Or.inr hic) (hmask i hi hodd)

/-- **Fresh even reservoir.**  Adding a whole set of fresh even centers, all of whose neighbours
avoid the odd-zero mask, preserves the guard. -/
theorem noAdjacent_union_even_of_mask {Z H E : Finset ℕ} (h : NoAdjacent Z)
    (hmask : ∀ z ∈ Z, ¬ Even z → z ∈ H) (hE : ∀ c ∈ E, Even c)
    (hnb : ∀ c ∈ E, ∀ j, (j = c + 1 ∨ j + 1 = c) → j ∉ H) : NoAdjacent (Z ∪ E) := by
  intro i hi hi1
  rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hi with hiZ | hiE <;> rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hi1 with h1Z | h1E
  · exact h i hiZ h1Z
  · -- `i` omitted, `i+1` an even reservoir center: then `i` is odd, hence in `H`
    have hodd : ¬ Even i := by
      have := hE _ h1E
      rw [Nat.even_add_one] at this
      exact this
    exact hnb (i + 1) h1E i (Or.inr rfl) (hmask i hiZ hodd)
  · -- `i` an even reservoir center, `i+1` omitted: then `i+1` is odd, hence in `H`
    have hodd : ¬ Even (i + 1) := by simp [Nat.even_add_one, hE i hiE]
    exact hnb i hiE (i + 1) (Or.inl rfl) (hmask _ h1Z hodd)
  · have h1 := hE i hiE
    have h2 := hE (i + 1) h1E
    rw [Nat.even_add_one] at h2
    exact h2 h1

/-- Multiple descent steps: a union of guarded sets each satisfying the mask discipline stays
guarded. -/
theorem noAdjacent_union_even_of_mask' {Z H E F : Finset ℕ} (h : NoAdjacent Z)
    (hmask : ∀ z ∈ Z, ¬ Even z → z ∈ H) (hE : ∀ c ∈ E ∪ F, Even c)
    (hnb : ∀ c ∈ E ∪ F, ∀ j, (j = c + 1 ∨ j + 1 = c) → j ∉ H) : NoAdjacent (Z ∪ E ∪ F) := by
  have : Z ∪ E ∪ F = Z ∪ (E ∪ F) := by ext x; simp
  rw [this]
  exact noAdjacent_union_even_of_mask h hmask hE hnb

/-- Every omitted position of a guarded all-even set stays even after a further even insertion:
the mask discipline is stable. -/
theorem mask_stable_insert {Z H : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ} (hmask : ∀ z ∈ Z, ¬ Even z → z ∈ H)
    (hc : Even c) : ∀ z ∈ insert c Z, ¬ Even z → z ∈ H := by
  intro z hz hodd
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hz with rfl | hzZ
  · exact absurd hc hodd
  · exact hmask z hzZ hodd

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=5131 sha256=0b3b43feb24abdc11e95fc40ada7a02c2d76710c801248a0a9159622d2335849 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/GuardedReservoir.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.PrimePowerDescent

/-!
# Anchored V4 — the guarded reservoir (finite core)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

A `GuardedReservoir` is a finite set of *eligible even positions* of the interval which are fresh
(not already omitted) and whose neighbours all have low normalized height, so that omitting **any**
subset of them preserves the `no-00` guard and the mask discipline
(`GuardedReservoir.noAdjacent_absorb`), and changes the word value by exactly the reciprocal sum
of the chosen subset (`GuardedReservoir.wordSum_absorb`).

The module also bans the standard fallacy: `positive_mass_not_exact_coverage` is an explicit finite
witness of a guarded reservoir whose mass exceeds a target `Δ > 0` and which nevertheless has
**no** subset with reciprocal sum exactly `Δ`.  Positive reservoir mass is not exact subset-sum
coverage.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- A finite guarded reservoir of eligible even positions, relative to the current omission set
`Zcur` and the height threshold `Q` of the odd-zero mask. -/
structure GuardedReservoir (aM M Q : ℕ) (Zcur : Finset ℕ) where
  /-- the eligible positions -/
  positions : Finset ℕ
  /-- eligible positions lie in the interior of the interval -/
  positions_subset : positions ⊆ Finset.Ioo aM M
  /-- eligible positions are currently selected (fresh) -/
  positions_fresh : Disjoint positions Zcur
  /-- eligible positions are even -/
  positions_even : ∀ c ∈ positions, Even c
  /-- both neighbours of an eligible position have low normalized height -/
  positions_nb_low : ∀ c ∈ positions, ∀ j, (j = c + 1 ∨ j + 1 = c) → normHeight j ≤ Q

namespace GuardedReservoir

variable {aM M Q : ℕ} {Zcur : Finset ℕ}

/-- The total reservoir mass. -/
def mass (R : GuardedReservoir aM M Q Zcur) : ℚ := recipSum R.positions

lemma mass_nonneg (R : GuardedReservoir aM M Q Zcur) : 0 ≤ R.mass := recipSum_nonneg _

/-- Omitting any subset of the reservoir preserves the `no-00` guard. -/
theorem noAdjacent_absorb (R : GuardedReservoir aM M Q Zcur) {mask : Finset ℕ}
    (hmask_high : ∀ n ∈ mask, Q < normHeight n) (hZ : NoAdjacent Zcur)
    (hZmask : ∀ z ∈ Zcur, ¬ Even z → z ∈ mask) {E : Finset ℕ} (hE : E ⊆ R.positions) :
    NoAdjacent (Zcur ∪ E) :=
  noAdjacent_union_even_of_mask hZ hZmask (fun c hc => R.positions_even c (hE hc))
    (fun c hc j hj hmem =>
      absurd (hmask_high j hmem) (not_lt.2 (R.positions_nb_low c (hE hc) j hj)))

/-- Omitting a subset of the reservoir changes the word value by exactly its reciprocal sum. -/
theorem wordSum_absorb (R : GuardedReservoir aM M Q Zcur) {E : Finset ℕ} (hE : E ⊆ R.positions) :
    wordSum (Finset.Icc aM M) (Zcur ∪ E) = wordSum (Finset.Icc aM M) Zcur - recipSum E :=
  wordSum_union (hE.trans (R.positions_subset.trans Finset.Ioo_subset_Icc_self))
    (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left hE R.positions_fresh)

/-- The mask discipline survives absorption (all new omissions are even). -/
theorem mask_absorb (R : GuardedReservoir aM M Q Zcur) {mask : Finset ℕ}
    (hZmask : ∀ z ∈ Zcur, ¬ Even z → z ∈ mask) {E : Finset ℕ} (hE : E ⊆ R.positions) :
    ∀ z ∈ Zcur ∪ E, ¬ Even z → z ∈ mask := by
  intro z hz hodd
  rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hz with h | h
  · exact hZmask z h hodd
  · exact absurd (R.positions_even z (hE h)) hodd

/-- Exact absorption of a target by a reservoir. -/
def AbsorbsExactly (R : GuardedReservoir aM M Q Zcur) (Δ : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ E ⊆ R.positions, recipSum E = Δ

end GuardedReservoir

/-! ## Firewall: positive mass is not exact coverage -/

private lemma normHeight_le_of_le {j Q : ℕ} (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjQ : j ≤ Q) : normHeight j ≤ Q := by
  have hQ : 1 ≤ Q := le_trans hj1 hjQ
  exact (normalizedHeight_le_iff_dvd_two_lcm (by omega) hQ).1
    (Dvd.dvd.mul_left (dvd_L hj1 hjQ) 2)

/-- A one-element guarded reservoir `{4}` inside `[0, 10]` with mask threshold `100`. -/
def singletonReservoir : GuardedReservoir 0 10 100 (∅ : Finset ℕ) where
  positions := {4}
  positions_subset := by decide
  positions_fresh := by simp
  positions_even := by decide
  positions_nb_low := by
    intro c hc j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hc
    subst hc
    rcases hj with rfl | hj
    · exact normHeight_le_of_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    · have : j = 3 := by omega
      subst this
      exact normHeight_le_of_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

/-- **Firewall.**  Positive reservoir mass — even mass strictly larger than the target — does not
imply exact subset-sum coverage of the target. -/
theorem positive_mass_not_exact_coverage :
    0 < (1 : ℚ) / 8 ∧ (1 : ℚ) / 8 < singletonReservoir.mass ∧
      ¬ singletonReservoir.AbsorbsExactly (1 / 8) := by
  refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [GuardedReservoir.mass, singletonReservoir, recipSum]
    norm_num
  · rintro ⟨E, hE, hsum⟩
    have : E = ∅ ∨ E = {4} := Finset.subset_singleton_iff.1 hE
    rcases this with rfl | rfl <;> simp [recipSum] at hsum

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4693 sha256=b0fd69f25b6b1df571ae96fae6a7e2b24f7f1707245e8eaccecb9b0fe6136947 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/OpenOwners.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.OriginalBridge

/-!
# Anchored V4 — machine-readable open owners

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Every unresolved dependency of the V4 layer is a named `Prop` together with a machine-readable
status, so that a later run cannot forget which premises are still unproved.  There is no `axiom`,
`sorry`, `native_decide`, `opaque` or `@[implemented_by]` anywhere in this layer, and none of the
`OPEN` owners below is inhabited.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4
namespace OpenOwners

/-- The audited status of an owner. -/
inductive OwnerStatus
  | PROVED
  | CONDITIONAL_INTERFACE
  | OPEN
  | FALSE
  | NOT_NEEDED
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

open OwnerStatus

/-! ## The four principal owners -/

/-- **OPEN.**  Existence of an actual ENTRY at arbitrarily large scale, with the interval and the
paid height both a bounded fraction of `M`.  Never inhabited in this project. -/
def ENTRY_EXISTENCE : Prop :=
  ∀ M₀ : ℕ, ∃ M aM Q Y : ℕ, M₀ ≤ M ∧ 2 * aM ≤ M ∧ 2 * Q ≤ M ∧ EntryExists M aM Q Y

/-- **OPEN.**  Existence of a valid descent move at every state above the floor height, for the
ENTRY data at hand.  Never inhabited in this project. -/
def SAFE_DESCENT_SUPPLY : Prop :=
  ∀ (aM M Q Y : ℕ) (mask : Finset ℕ), DescentSupply aM M Q Y mask

/-- **OPEN.**  The analytic supply of guarded reservoirs which absorb the residual exactly.  Never
inhabited in this project; the deterministic part of the absorber is proved in
`FourierAbsorber.lean` and consumes only the visible dominance and no-wraparound hypotheses. -/
def GUARDED_ABSORBER_ANALYTIC_SUPPLY : Prop :=
  ∀ (aM M Q Y : ℕ) (mask : Finset ℕ), AbsorberSupply aM M Q Y mask

/-- **PROVED.**  The bridge from a final V4 configuration to the original Erdős #287 counterexample
statement.  This owner is discharged by `final_configuration_is_counterexample`. -/
def ENTRY_TO_ORIGINAL_287_BRIDGE : Prop :=
  ∀ (aM M : ℕ) (Zf : Finset ℕ), 1 < aM → Zf ⊆ Finset.Ioo aM M → NoAdjacent Zf →
    wordSum (Finset.Icc aM M) Zf = 1 → Erdos287Counterexample

/-- The bridge owner is discharged. -/
theorem entry_to_original_287_bridge : ENTRY_TO_ORIGINAL_287_BRIDGE :=
  fun _ _ _ haM hsub hna hval => final_configuration_is_counterexample haM hsub hna hval

/-! ## The audited ledger -/

/-- The machine-readable ledger of V4 owners. -/
def ownerLedger : List (String × OwnerStatus) :=
  [ ("ENTRY_EXISTENCE", OPEN),
    ("SAFE_DESCENT_SUPPLY", OPEN),
    ("GUARDED_ABSORBER_ANALYTIC_SUPPLY", OPEN),
    ("ENTRY_TO_ORIGINAL_287_BRIDGE", PROVED),
    ("NORMALIZED_PRIME_POWER_HEIGHT", PROVED),
    ("DOUBLED_DENOMINATOR_LATTICE", PROVED),
    ("GUARD_GEOMETRY", PROVED),
    ("WELL_FOUNDED_PRIME_POWER_DESCENT", PROVED),
    ("EXACT_FOURIER_COUNTING_IDENTITY", PROVED),
    ("EXACT_ABSORPTION_FROM_DOMINANCE", CONDITIONAL_INTERFACE),
    ("CONDITIONAL_ENTRY_TO_EXACT_ONE", CONDITIONAL_INTERFACE),
    ("GLOBAL_COLUMN_SURJECTIVITY", FALSE),
    ("ROWWISE_NEUTRALITY_NECESSARY", FALSE),
    ("POSITIVE_MASS_IMPLIES_COVERAGE", FALSE),
    ("MANY_TARGETS_IMPLY_HIT", FALSE) ]

/-- The exact list of owners that remain `OPEN`. -/
theorem open_owners :
    ownerLedger.filter (fun e => e.2 = OwnerStatus.OPEN) =
      [ ("ENTRY_EXISTENCE", OPEN),
        ("SAFE_DESCENT_SUPPLY", OPEN),
        ("GUARDED_ABSORBER_ANALYTIC_SUPPLY", OPEN) ] := by
  decide

/-- The exact list of shortcuts that are formally `FALSE` and must never be revived. -/
theorem false_shortcuts :
    ownerLedger.filter (fun e => e.2 = OwnerStatus.FALSE) =
      [ ("GLOBAL_COLUMN_SURJECTIVITY", FALSE),
        ("ROWWISE_NEUTRALITY_NECESSARY", FALSE),
        ("POSITIVE_MASS_IMPLIES_COVERAGE", FALSE),
        ("MANY_TARGETS_IMPLY_HIT", FALSE) ] := by
  decide

/-! ## Unmatched V3 ↔ V4 interfaces

These are *not* claimed as bridges: the V3 objects exist and are frozen, but their types do not
line up with the V4 objects without additional data, so no bridge lemma is stated.

* the V3 `AlignedBank` alignment coefficient is a statement about a fixed terminal bank with a
  reserved mobility family; the V4 absorber is a statement about a guarded even reservoir inside
  the word interval.  `absorber_is_sumset_membership` shows the two have the same *shape*
  (subset-sum membership), but no data-level identification is proved;
* the V3 packet theorems give many disjoint zero-sum packets; converting them into V4 descent
  moves would additionally require the parity and neighbour-height conditions of
  `DescentStep`, which the V3 statements do not provide. -/

end OpenOwners
end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4342 sha256=47a310e91cb6a711be370b576eadff7fb19b1abcf9ad40a9e0859fdcdb798211 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/OriginalBridge.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.Reconciliation

/-!
# Anchored V4 — bridge from the internal word model to the original Erdős #287 statement

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The internal objects of this programme are words on an interval: an interval `[aM, M]`, a set `Zf`
of omitted positions, and the reciprocal sum of the selected positions.  The original Erdős #287
question is about a finite set of integers `1 < n₁ < ⋯ < n_k` with `∑ 1/nᵢ = 1` and maximum
consecutive gap `≤ 2`.

This module proves the exact translation `final_configuration_is_counterexample`: **any** final
configuration of the V4 endgame — an interval word with non-adjacent omissions, selected
endpoints, and exact value `1` — *is* a #287 counterexample in the original sense.

This is a bridge theorem, not a counterexample: no such configuration is constructed anywhere in
this project, and the existence of one (via `ENTRY_EXISTENCE` and the two supply owners) remains
open.  Contrapositively, the bridge shows that if Erdős #287 is true then no ENTRY can be completed
by the V4 endgame — which is why the ENTRY question is the live owner.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- The maximal consecutive gap of a finite set of integers is at most `2`. -/
def GapAtMostTwo (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n ∈ A, (∀ m ∈ A, m ≤ n) ∨ ∃ m ∈ A, n < m ∧ m ≤ n + 2

/-- The original Erdős #287 counterexample statement: distinct integers `> 1` with reciprocal sum
exactly `1` and all consecutive gaps at most `2`. -/
def Erdos287Counterexample : Prop :=
  ∃ A : Finset ℕ, (∀ n ∈ A, 1 < n) ∧ recipSum A = 1 ∧ GapAtMostTwo A

/-- **Bridge theorem.**  A final V4 configuration is literally a #287 counterexample: the selected
positions of an interval word with non-adjacent omissions, selected endpoints and exact value `1`
form a set of distinct integers `> 1` with reciprocal sum `1` and all gaps `≤ 2`. -/
theorem final_configuration_is_counterexample {aM M : ℕ} {Zf : Finset ℕ}
    (haM : 1 < aM) (hZ : Zf ⊆ Finset.Ioo aM M) (hna : NoAdjacent Zf)
    (hval : wordSum (Finset.Icc aM M) Zf = 1) : Erdos287Counterexample := by
  classical
  refine ⟨Finset.Icc aM M \ Zf, ?_, hval, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    have := (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hn).1
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at this
    omega
  · intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hnI, hnZ⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hn
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hnI
    by_cases hnM : n = M
    · left
      intro m hm
      have := (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hm).1
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at this
      omega
    · right
      have hlt : n < M := by omega
      by_cases h1 : n + 1 ∈ Zf
      · have h1I := hZ h1
        simp only [Finset.mem_Ioo] at h1I
        have h2 : n + 2 ∉ Zf := hna (n + 1) h1
        refine ⟨n + 2, Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨?_, h2⟩, by omega, by omega⟩
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
        omega
      · refine ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨?_, h1⟩, by omega, by omega⟩
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
        omega

/-- **The bridge applied to the conditional endgame.**  ENTRY together with the two supply
hypotheses would produce an actual #287 counterexample.  Both supplies are open, so nothing is
claimed about #287 here; the theorem records exactly what a future proof of the supplies would
buy. -/
theorem conditional_entry_gives_counterexample {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (haM : 1 < aM)
    (e : Entry M aM Q Y) (hdesc : DescentSupply aM M Q Y e.mask)
    (habs : AbsorberSupply aM M Q Y e.mask) : Erdos287Counterexample := by
  obtain ⟨Zf, -, hsub, hna, -, -, hval⟩ := conditional_entry_to_exact_one e hdesc habs
  exact final_configuration_is_counterexample haM hsub hna hval

/-- **Contrapositive reading.**  If Erdős #287 is true (no counterexample exists), then no ENTRY
admits both supplies.  This is the precise sense in which the V4 endgame is a *test* of the
conjecture rather than a proof of it. -/
theorem no_entry_supply_of_no_counterexample (hno : ¬ Erdos287Counterexample)
    {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (haM : 1 < aM) (e : Entry M aM Q Y) :
    ¬ (DescentSupply aM M Q Y e.mask ∧ AbsorberSupply aM M Q Y e.mask) := by
  rintro ⟨hd, ha⟩
  exact hno (conditional_entry_gives_counterexample haM e hd ha)

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4631 sha256=bf734d18008e436982e21f3b13cb9edafd0873a4b98e011f65b0a7ec93aaa510 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/PrimePowerDescent.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.DescentState

/-!
# Anchored V4 — well-founded prime-power descent

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`DescentSupply aM M Q y mask` is the **explicit hypothesis** that a valid descent move exists at
every state whose height exceeds `y`.  It is a `Prop` about data, not an axiom, and it is the
honest owner `SAFE_DESCENT_SUPPLY`: nothing in this layer inhabits it.

Given that supply, `descent_terminates` proves — by genuine `Nat` descent on the height, not by
appeal to intuition — that iterated descent reaches a state of height `≤ y`, and that the reached
state still satisfies **all** exact invariants:

* the interval and the `no-00` guard;
* the mask discipline (odd omissions only inside the mask);
* every newly omitted position is even and was previously selected (no reuse);
* the doubled denominator condition `den (word value) ∣ 2 * L y`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

variable {aM M Q y : ℕ} {mask : Finset ℕ}

/-- **Descent supply** (explicit hypothesis, never inhabited here): a valid descent move exists at
every state above the floor height `y`. -/
def DescentSupply (aM M Q y : ℕ) (mask : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : DescentState aM M Q mask, y < s.height → Nonempty (DescentStep aM M Q mask s)

private theorem descent_aux (hmask : ∀ n ∈ mask, Q < normHeight n)
    (hsupply : DescentSupply aM M Q y mask) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : DescentState aM M Q mask), s.height ≤ n →
      ∃ t : DescentState aM M Q mask, t.height ≤ y ∧ s.Z ⊆ t.Z ∧
        (∀ z ∈ t.Z, z ∉ s.Z → Even z) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro s hs
      exact ⟨s, le_trans hs (Nat.zero_le y), Finset.Subset.refl _, by intro z hz hz'; exact absurd hz hz'⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro s hs
      by_cases hy : s.height ≤ y
      · exact ⟨s, hy, Finset.Subset.refl _, by intro z hz hz'; exact absurd hz hz'⟩
      · obtain ⟨d⟩ := hsupply s (not_le.1 hy)
        have hlt : d.newHeight < s.height := d.newHeight_lt
        have hle : (d.next hmask).height ≤ n := by
          simp only [DescentStep.next_height]
          omega
        obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht2, ht3⟩ := ih (d.next hmask) hle
        refine ⟨t, ht1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact Finset.Subset.trans (by simp [DescentStep.next_Z]) ht2
        · intro z hz hzs
          by_cases hmem : z ∈ (d.next hmask).Z
          · exact d.next_new_even hmask z hmem hzs
          · exact ht3 z hz hmem

/-- **Well-founded prime-power descent.**  If a valid descent move exists at every height above
`y`, iterated descent terminates at a state of height `≤ y`, preserving every exact invariant of
the descent state, and the terminal word value lies in the `2 * L y` lattice. -/
theorem descent_terminates (hmask : ∀ n ∈ mask, Q < normHeight n)
    (hsupply : DescentSupply aM M Q y mask) (s : DescentState aM M Q mask) :
    ∃ t : DescentState aM M Q mask,
      t.height ≤ y ∧ s.Z ⊆ t.Z ∧ (∀ z ∈ t.Z, z ∉ s.Z → Even z) ∧
      t.Z ⊆ Finset.Ioo aM M ∧ NoAdjacent t.Z ∧
      (∀ z ∈ t.Z, ¬ Even z → z ∈ mask) ∧ t.value.den ∣ 2 * L y := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht2, ht3⟩ := descent_aux hmask hsupply s.height s le_rfl
  exact ⟨t, ht1, ht2, ht3, t.Z_subset, t.Z_noAdjacent, t.Z_odd_mask,
    dvd_two_L_mono ht1 t.den_ok⟩

/-- Height form of the descent conclusion: the terminal normalized prime-power height is at most
the floor `y`. -/
theorem descent_normHeight_le (hmask : ∀ n ∈ mask, Q < normHeight n)
    (hsupply : DescentSupply aM M Q y mask) (hy : 1 ≤ y) (s : DescentState aM M Q mask) :
    ∃ t : DescentState aM M Q mask, s.Z ⊆ t.Z ∧ normHeight t.value.den ≤ y := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht2, -, -, -, -, hden⟩ := descent_terminates hmask hsupply s
  exact ⟨t, ht2, (normalizedHeight_le_iff_dvd_two_lcm t.value.den_nz hy).1 hden⟩

/-- The `ENTRY` datum is a descent state at height `Q`. -/
def Entry.toDescentState {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (e : Entry M aM Q Y) :
    DescentState aM M Q e.mask where
  height := Q
  Z := e.Z
  Z_subset := e.Z_subset
  Z_noAdjacent := e.Z_noAdjacent
  Z_odd_mask := e.Z_odd_mask
  den_ok := e.den_init

@[simp] lemma Entry.toDescentState_height {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (e : Entry M aM Q Y) :
    e.toDescentState.height = Q := rfl

@[simp] lemma Entry.toDescentState_Z {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (e : Entry M aM Q Y) :
    e.toDescentState.Z = e.Z := rfl

lemma Entry.toDescentState_value {M aM Q Y : ℕ} (e : Entry M aM Q Y) :
    e.toDescentState.value = e.Sinit := rfl

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=8597 sha256=84a0f468fcd4ae7eb90631e9b4096b7c921e9ece65529a09221c95c15f3b7c87 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/PrimePowerHeight.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Anchored V4 — normalized prime-power height and the `2·lcm` lattice

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Strictly append-only V4 layer.  Anchored V2 and Anchored V3 are frozen: nothing in this layer
edits, renames, re-proves or weakens any statement of those layers.

This module defines

* `L t = lcm (1, …, t)` (`Nat.lcm` over `Finset.Icc 1 t`);
* the **normalized prime-power height**
  `normHeight n = max 1 (sup over p ∣ n of heightAt n p)` where
  `heightAt n 2 = 2 ^ (v₂ n - 1)` and `heightAt n p = p ^ (v_p n)` for odd `p`;

and proves the exact characterization

`normalizedHeight_le_iff_dvd_two_lcm : n ∣ 2 * L t ↔ normHeight n ≤ t`   (`n ≠ 0`, `1 ≤ t`).

The factor `2` is essential and is *not* cosmetic: `two_factor_essential` exhibits `32 ∣ 2 * L 16`
together with `¬ (32 ∣ L 16)`, and `normalizedHeight_not_le_iff_dvd_lcm` records that the
un-doubled variant `n ∣ L t ↔ normHeight n ≤ t` is **false**.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- `L t = lcm (1, 2, …, t)`. -/
def L (t : ℕ) : ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 t).lcm id

@[simp] lemma L_zero : L 0 = 1 := by decide

lemma L_ne_zero (t : ℕ) : L t ≠ 0 := by simp [L, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff]

lemma L_pos (t : ℕ) : 0 < L t := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (L_ne_zero t)

/-- `L` is monotone for divisibility. -/
lemma L_dvd_L {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : L a ∣ L b := by
  refine Finset.lcm_dvd ?_
  intro j hj
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
  exact Finset.dvd_lcm (by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega)

/-- Every `j ∈ [1, t]` divides `L t`. -/
lemma dvd_L {j t : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ j) (h2 : j ≤ t) : j ∣ L t :=
  Finset.dvd_lcm (by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩)

/-- A prime power divides `Nat.lcm a b` iff it divides one of the two arguments. -/
lemma pow_dvd_lcm_iff {p k a b : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    p ^ k ∣ Nat.lcm a b ↔ p ^ k ∣ a ∨ p ^ k ∣ b := by
  rw [hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization ha, hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hb,
    hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization (Nat.lcm_ne_zero ha hb), Nat.factorization_lcm ha hb]
  simp

/-- A nontrivial prime power divides a finite `lcm` iff it divides one of the members. -/
lemma prime_pow_dvd_finset_lcm_iff {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (s : Finset ℕ)
    (h0 : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ 0) : p ^ k ∣ s.lcm id ↔ ∃ j ∈ s, p ^ k ∣ j := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simpa using ⟨hp.ne_one, by omega⟩
  | insert a s ha ih =>
      have hane : a ≠ 0 := h0 a (by simp)
      have hs0 : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ 0 := fun j hj => h0 j (by simp [hj])
      have hlcm0 : s.lcm id ≠ 0 := by
        simp only [ne_eq, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff, id_eq,
          not_exists, not_and]
        intro j hj
        exact hs0 j hj
      rw [Finset.lcm_insert]
      have hcast : (lcm (id a) (s.lcm id) : ℕ) = Nat.lcm a (s.lcm id) := rfl
      rw [hcast, pow_dvd_lcm_iff hp hane hlcm0, ih hs0]
      simp

/-- **Exact `p`-adic description of `L t`**: a nontrivial prime power divides `lcm (1, …, t)`
exactly when it is at most `t`. -/
lemma prime_pow_dvd_L_iff {p k t : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    p ^ k ∣ L t ↔ p ^ k ≤ t := by
  rw [L, prime_pow_dvd_finset_lcm_iff hp hk _ (by intro j hj; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj; omega)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, hdvd⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
    exact le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd) hj.2
  · intro h
    exact ⟨p ^ k, by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hp.pos, h⟩, dvd_rfl⟩

/-- The normalized prime-power component of `n` at the prime `p`: the full component `p ^ v_p n`
at an odd prime, and the **halved** component `2 ^ (v₂ n - 1)` at `p = 2`. -/
def heightAt (n p : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if p = 2 then 2 ^ (n.factorization 2 - 1) else p ^ (n.factorization p)

/-- The **normalized prime-power height** of `n`. -/
def normHeight (n : ℕ) : ℕ := max 1 (n.primeFactors.sup (heightAt n))

@[simp] lemma heightAt_two (n : ℕ) : heightAt n 2 = 2 ^ (n.factorization 2 - 1) := by
  simp [heightAt]

lemma heightAt_odd {n p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 2) : heightAt n p = p ^ (n.factorization p) := by
  simp [heightAt, hp]

lemma one_le_normHeight (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ normHeight n := le_max_left _ _

@[simp] lemma normHeight_one : normHeight 1 = 1 := by simp [normHeight]

/-- The normalized height is the maximum of `1` and the normalized prime-power components. -/
lemma normHeight_le_iff {n t : ℕ} :
    normHeight n ≤ t ↔ 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, heightAt n p ≤ t := by
  simp [normHeight, Finset.sup_le_iff]

lemma factorization_two_mul_L (p t : ℕ) :
    (2 * L t).factorization p = (if p = 2 then 1 else 0) + (L t).factorization p := by
  rw [Nat.factorization_mul (by norm_num) (L_ne_zero t)]
  simp [Nat.Prime.factorization Nat.prime_two, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

/-- Componentwise form of the main theorem at one prime divisor. -/
lemma factorization_le_two_mul_L_iff {n p t : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n)
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    n.factorization p ≤ (2 * L t).factorization p ↔ heightAt n p ≤ t := by
  have ha1 : 1 ≤ n.factorization p := Nat.Prime.factorization_pos_of_dvd hp hn hpn
  rw [factorization_two_mul_L]
  by_cases hp2 : p = 2
  · subst hp2
    rw [heightAt_two, if_pos rfl]
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le ha1 with h1 | h2
    · rw [← h1]; simp [ht]
    · have hk : 1 ≤ n.factorization 2 - 1 := by omega
      rw [← prime_pow_dvd_L_iff Nat.prime_two hk,
        Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization Nat.prime_two (L_ne_zero t)]
      omega
  · rw [heightAt_odd hp2, if_neg hp2, Nat.zero_add, ← prime_pow_dvd_L_iff hp ha1,
      Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hp (L_ne_zero t)]

/-- **Main theorem of the module.**  For `n ≠ 0` and `1 ≤ t`,

`n ∣ 2 * L t ↔ normHeight n ≤ t`.

The factor `2` on the right of the divisibility is essential; see `two_factor_essential`. -/
theorem normalizedHeight_le_iff_dvd_two_lcm {n t : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    n ∣ 2 * L t ↔ normHeight n ≤ t := by
  rw [← Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hn (Nat.mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (L_ne_zero t)), Finsupp.le_iff]
  simp only [Nat.support_factorization, normHeight, max_le_iff, Finset.sup_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨ht, fun p hp => (factorization_le_two_mul_L_iff hn (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)
      (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp) ht).1 (h p hp)⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩ p hp
    exact (factorization_le_two_mul_L_iff hn (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)
      (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp) ht).2 (h p hp)

/-- Monotonicity of the `2 L`-lattice in the height parameter. -/
lemma dvd_two_L_mono {n a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (h : n ∣ 2 * L a) : n ∣ 2 * L b :=
  h.trans (mul_dvd_mul_left 2 (L_dvd_L hab))

/-! ## The factor of two is essential -/

lemma L_sixteen_factorization_two : (L 16).factorization 2 = 4 := by
  have h1 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 4 ∣ L 16 := (prime_pow_dvd_L_iff Nat.prime_two (by norm_num)).2 (by norm_num)
  have h2 : ¬ ((2 : ℕ) ^ 5 ∣ L 16) := by
    intro h
    have := (prime_pow_dvd_L_iff Nat.prime_two (by norm_num)).1 h
    norm_num at this
  have h1' := (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization Nat.prime_two (L_ne_zero 16)).1 h1
  have h2' : ¬ (5 ≤ (L 16).factorization 2) := fun h =>
    h2 ((Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization Nat.prime_two (L_ne_zero 16)).2 h)
  omega

/-- **The factor `2` is essential.**  `32 = 2 ^ 5` has normalized height `16` and divides
`2 * L 16`, but it does not divide `L 16`. -/
theorem two_factor_essential : (32 : ℕ) ∣ 2 * L 16 ∧ ¬ ((32 : ℕ) ∣ L 16) := by
  constructor
  · have h16 : (16 : ℕ) ∣ L 16 := dvd_L (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have : (2 : ℕ) * 16 ∣ 2 * L 16 := mul_dvd_mul_left 2 h16
    simpa using this
  · intro h
    have : (2 : ℕ) ^ 5 ∣ L 16 := by norm_num at h ⊢; exact h
    have := (prime_pow_dvd_L_iff Nat.prime_two (by norm_num)).1 this
    norm_num at this

/-- **The un-doubled statement is false.**  There is no valid variant of the main theorem with
`n ∣ L t` in place of `n ∣ 2 * L t`. -/
theorem normalizedHeight_not_le_iff_dvd_lcm :
    ¬ (∀ n t : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ t → (n ∣ L t ↔ normHeight n ≤ t)) := by
  intro h
  have hmain := (normalizedHeight_le_iff_dvd_two_lcm (n := 32) (t := 16) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num)).1 two_factor_essential.1
  exact two_factor_essential.2 ((h 32 16 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).2 hmain)

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4863 sha256=f9a828caaf4c55bd7e368a4eedf5cd81f5edaed3ae41ff54fe4eb7089384bb43 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/AnchoredV4/Reconciliation.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV4.EntryObstructions
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnchoredV3

/-!
# Anchored V4 — reconciliation with the frozen Anchored V3 bank

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Anchored V2 and Anchored V3 are frozen: this module only *uses* them.  It answers the
reconciliation questions with theorems whose types line up exactly, and records the questions
whose interfaces do **not** line up as open items (`OpenOwners.lean`) rather than pretending a
bridge exists.

Established bridges:

* `mobility_preserves_doubled_lattice` — every V3 target-mobility state satisfies the V4
  normalized-height condition as soon as the V3 core modulus lies in the `2 L Y` lattice
  (reconciliation question 2);
* `absorber_is_sumset_membership` — V4 exact absorption is membership of the target numerator in
  the subset-sum set of the reservoir weights, the same shape as the V3 alignment sumset
  (reconciliation question 3);
* `noAdjacent_to_V3_no00` — the V4 `no-00` guard implies the frozen V3 `No00` predicate with the
  successor guard (reconciliation question 1);
* `dvd_iff_forall_component` — the exact prime-power component splitting, which is what reduces a
  global ENTRY congruence to one constraint per active component (reconciliation question 4);
* the V3 firewalls are re-checked below and remain in force (reconciliation question 5).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace AnchoredV4

/-- **Reconciliation 2.**  A V3 mobility state keeps the V4 doubled-denominator condition: if the
V3 core modulus is inside the `2 L Y` lattice, then every moved baseline has normalized
prime-power height at most `Y`. -/
theorem mobility_preserves_doubled_lattice {H : ℕ} (M : AnchoredV3.MobilityData H) {Y : ℕ}
    (hY : 1 ≤ Y) (hcore : M.Dcore ∣ 2 * L Y) (y : Finset (Fin H)) :
    normHeight (M.S y).den ≤ Y :=
  (normalizedHeight_le_iff_dvd_two_lcm (M.S y).den_nz hY).1 ((M.den_dvd_Dcore y).trans hcore)

/-- **Reconciliation 3.**  Exact absorption by a guarded reservoir is exactly membership of the
target numerator in the subset-sum set of the reservoir weights — the finite coefficient shape
used by the V3 alignment sumset. -/
theorem absorber_is_sumset_membership {aM M Q : ℕ} {Zcur : Finset ℕ}
    (R : GuardedReservoir aM M Q Zcur) {P k : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hdvd : ∀ n ∈ R.positions, n ≠ 0 ∧ n ∣ P) {Δ : ℚ} (hΔ : Δ * P = k) :
    R.AbsorbsExactly Δ ↔ ∃ E ⊆ R.positions, ∑ n ∈ E, weight P n = k :=
  exact_absorption_iff_weight_subsetSum hP hdvd hΔ

/-- **Reconciliation 1.**  The V4 guard implies the frozen V3 `No00` predicate for the successor
guard on any set of positions whose successors stay inside the interval. -/
theorem noAdjacent_to_V3_no00 {aM M : ℕ} {Z positions : Finset ℕ}
    (hZ : NoAdjacent Z) (hpos : ∀ p ∈ positions, p ∈ Finset.Icc aM M ∧ p + 1 ∈ Finset.Icc aM M) :
    AnchoredV3.No00 (fun p => p + 1) positions (Finset.Icc aM M \ Z) := by
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpZ : p ∈ Z
  · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(hpos p hp).2, hZ p hpZ⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨(hpos p hp).1, hpZ⟩)

/-- **Reconciliation 4.**  A divisibility by the transition modulus is exactly the conjunction of
its prime-power component constraints: the number of independent ENTRY constraints is the number
of active prime-power components, no more. -/
theorem dvd_iff_forall_component {r x : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    r ∣ x ↔ ∀ p ∈ r.primeFactors, p ^ r.factorization p ∣ x := by
  constructor
  · intro h p _
    exact (Nat.ordProj_dvd r p).trans h
  · intro h
    rw [← Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hr hx, Finsupp.le_iff]
    intro p hp
    have hpp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (by simpa using hp)
    have := h p (by simpa using hp)
    exact (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hpp hx).1 this

/-! ## The frozen V3 firewalls remain in force

These are referenced, never re-proved, re-stated or weakened. -/

#check @Erdos287.AnchoredV3.rowwise_sufficient_not_necessary
#check @Erdos287.AnchoredV3.ColumnPackets.manyNeutralPackets_not_exactTarget
#check @Erdos287.AnchoredV3.OldEmptyNewHit.same_bank_old_empty_new_global_hit
#check @Erdos287.AnchoredV3.ColumnLattice.sharpness_witness_two
#check @Erdos287.AnchoredV3.AlignedBank.alignment_coefficient

/-- The V4 firewalls added on top of the frozen V3 ones. -/
theorem v4_firewalls_in_force :
    (¬ (∀ (q : ℚ) (P : ℕ), (2 * q).den ∣ P → q.den ∣ P)) ∧
      (¬ singletonReservoir.AbsorbsExactly (1 / 8)) ∧
      (¬ gcdWitnessSystem.Solvable) ∧
      (Disjoint mobilityTargets columnImage) :=
  ⟨den_dvd_not_iff_den_two_mul_dvd, positive_mass_not_exact_coverage.2.2,
    gcdWitnessSystem_unsolvable, mobility_targets_not_hit.2⟩

end AnchoredV4
end Erdos287
