import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 effectivity — the complete-period endpoint covariance (§24)

```
COMPLETE-PERIOD ENDPOINT IDENTITY : KERNEL-PROVED
COPRIME ENDPOINT ORTHOGONALITY    : KERNEL-PROVED
ENDPOINT COVARIANCE NONNEGATIVITY : KERNEL-PROVED
LANE INDEPENDENCE                 : KERNEL-PROVED
```

For a modulus `q ≥ 1` and a lane offset `c`, the *finite sawtooth endpoint function* is the
centred discrete sawtooth

    φ_q^{(c)}(v) = ((v + c) mod q)/q − (q−1)/(2q),

a mean-zero function of `v` with period `q`.  The complete-period covariance of two such
functions is taken over one full period of the joint system, i.e. over `v mod L` with
`L = lcm(q₁,q₂)`:

    Cov(q₁,q₂;c) = (1/L) ∑_{v mod L} φ_{q₁}^{(c)}(v) φ_{q₂}^{(c)}(v).

The main theorem of this file is the **exact** finite-period identity

    Cov(q₁,q₂;c) = (g² − 1)/(12 q₁ q₂),    g = gcd(q₁,q₂),

proved by an exact finite computation (no numerical testing, no analytic input).  The three
corollaries required by the source follow: coprime moduli are exactly orthogonal, the
covariance depends only on the `gcd` stratum, and it is always nonnegative.

The identity needs only `q₁, q₂ ≥ 1`; oddness of the moduli — the case used by the source —
is recorded as a specialisation (`endpointCovariance_odd`).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287
namespace Effectivity

/-! ## §24.1  Elementary finite sums -/

/-- Gauss's sum, over `ℚ`. -/
theorem sum_range_cast (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ range n, (i : ℚ) = n * (n - 1) / 2 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]; push_cast; ring

/-- The sum of squares, over `ℚ`. -/
theorem sum_range_cast_sq (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, (i : ℚ) ^ 2 = n * (n - 1) * (2 * n - 1) / 6 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]; push_cast; ring

/-- Reduction of a two-scale residue: for `x < g` and `b > 0`,
`(x + g w) mod (g b) = x + g (w mod b)`. -/
theorem mod_two_scale (g b x w : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hx : x < g) :
    (x + g * w) % (g * b) = x + g * (w % b) := by
  have h1 : (g * w) % (g * b) = g * (w % b) := Nat.mul_mod_mul_left g w b
  have hmod : w % b ≤ b - 1 := by have := Nat.mod_lt w hb; omega
  have hle : g * (w % b) ≤ g * (b - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left g hmod
  have hgb : g * (b - 1) + g = g * b := by
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, b = n + 1 := ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩
    simp [Nat.mul_succ]
  have h2 : x + g * (w % b) < g * b := by omega
  have hxlt : x < g * b := by
    calc x < g := hx
      _ = g * 1 := (mul_one g).symm
      _ ≤ g * b := Nat.mul_le_mul_left g hb
  conv_lhs => rw [Nat.add_mod, h1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hxlt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h2]

/-- Splitting a range of length `g·a` along the two-scale decomposition `u = r + g s`. -/
theorem sum_range_two_scale (g a : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (f : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ∑ u ∈ range (g * a), f u = ∑ r ∈ range g, ∑ s ∈ range a, f (r + g * s) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_product']
  apply Finset.sum_nbij' (i := fun u => (u % g, u / g)) (j := fun p => p.1 + g * p.2)
  · intro u hu; simp only [mem_range] at hu; simp only [mem_product, mem_range]
    exact ⟨Nat.mod_lt _ hg, Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul (by linarith [hu])⟩
  · intro p hp; simp only [mem_product, mem_range] at hp; simp only [mem_range]
    nlinarith [Nat.succ_le_of_lt hp.2]
  · intro u _; simp [Nat.mod_add_div]
  · intro p hp; simp only [mem_product, mem_range] at hp
    have h1 : (p.1 + g * p.2) % g = p.1 := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp.1]
    have h2 : (p.1 + g * p.2) / g = p.2 := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ hg, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hp.1]; omega
    simp [h1, h2]
  · intro u _; simp [Nat.mod_add_div]

/-- An affine map `s ↦ (c + a s) mod b` with `gcd(a,b) = 1` permutes a complete residue
system mod `b`. -/
theorem sum_range_affine_perm (a b c : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (f : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ∑ s ∈ range b, f ((c + a * s) % b) = ∑ t ∈ range b, f t := by
  classical
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun s => (c + a * s) % b) (range b) := by
    intro s hs s' hs' h
    simp only [mem_coe, mem_range] at hs hs'
    have h2 : a * s ≡ a * s' [MOD b] := Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel' c h
    have h3 : s ≡ s' [MOD b] :=
      Nat.ModEq.cancel_left_of_coprime (by simpa [Nat.Coprime] using hab.symm) h2
    unfold Nat.ModEq at h3
    rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs'] at h3
  have himg : (range b).image (fun s => (c + a * s) % b) = range b := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro x hx
      simp only [mem_image, mem_range] at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨s, _, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact Nat.mod_lt _ hb
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj]
  calc ∑ s ∈ range b, f ((c + a * s) % b)
      = ∑ x ∈ (range b).image (fun s => (c + a * s) % b), f x :=
        (Finset.sum_image (by intro x hx y hy h; exact hinj hx hy h)).symm
    _ = ∑ t ∈ range b, f t := by rw [himg]

/-- The complete-period first moment: `∑_{v < q k} (v mod q) = k · q(q−1)/2`. -/
theorem sum_range_mod_cast (q k : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∑ v ∈ range (q * k), ((v % q : ℕ) : ℚ) = (k : ℚ) * ((q : ℚ) * ((q : ℚ) - 1) / 2) := by
  rw [sum_range_two_scale q k hq (fun v => ((v % q : ℕ) : ℚ))]
  have hcong : ∀ r ∈ range q, ∑ _s ∈ range k, (((r + q * _s) % q : ℕ) : ℚ) = (k : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) := by
    intro r hr
    simp only [mem_range] at hr
    have hmod : ∀ s : ℕ, (r + q * s) % q = r := by
      intro s; rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr]
    calc ∑ _s ∈ range k, (((r + q * _s) % q : ℕ) : ℚ)
        = ∑ _s ∈ range k, ((r : ℕ) : ℚ) := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => by rw [hmod s]
      _ = (k : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) := by rw [Finset.sum_const]; simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcong, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_range_cast]

/-- The mixed second moment over a complete period, in two-scale coordinates. -/
theorem sum_range_mod_mul_mod_aux (g a : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    ∑ u ∈ range (g * a), (u : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = (a : ℚ) * ((g : ℚ) * ((g : ℚ) - 1) * (2 * (g : ℚ) - 1) / 6)
        + (g : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) - 1) / 2) * ((g : ℚ) * ((g : ℚ) - 1) / 2) := by
  rw [sum_range_two_scale g a hg (fun u => (u : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ))]
  have hcong : ∀ r ∈ range g, ∑ s ∈ range a, ((r + g * s : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((r + g * s) % g : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = (a : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) ^ 2 + (g : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) - 1) / 2) := by
    intro r hr
    simp only [mem_range] at hr
    have hmod : ∀ s : ℕ, (r + g * s) % g = r := by
      intro s; rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr]
    calc ∑ s ∈ range a, ((r + g * s : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((r + g * s) % g : ℕ) : ℚ)
        = ∑ s ∈ range a, ((r : ℚ) ^ 2 + ((g : ℚ) * (r : ℚ)) * (s : ℚ)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
          rw [hmod s]; push_cast; ring
      _ = (a : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) ^ 2 + ((g : ℚ) * (r : ℚ)) * ∑ s ∈ range a, (s : ℚ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = (a : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) ^ 2 + (g : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) - 1) / 2) := by
          rw [sum_range_cast]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcong, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_range_cast_sq]
  rw [show ∑ r ∈ range g, (g : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) - 1) / 2)
        = ((g : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) * ((a : ℚ) - 1) / 2)) * ∑ r ∈ range g, (r : ℚ) from by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => by ring]
  rw [sum_range_cast]

/-- **The complete-period mixed second moment.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  With `q₁ = g a`,
`q₂ = g b`, `gcd(a,b) = 1` and `L = g a b = lcm(q₁,q₂)`,

    ∑_{v < L} (v mod q₁)(v mod q₂) = L · [ (q₁−1)(q₂−1)/4 + (g²−1)/12 ]. -/
theorem sum_range_mod_mul_mod (g a b : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), ((v % (g * a) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((v % (g * b) : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ)
        * ((((g * a : ℕ) : ℚ) - 1) * (((g * b : ℕ) : ℚ) - 1) / 4 + ((g : ℚ) ^ 2 - 1) / 12) := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha
  · simp
  have hga : 0 < g * a := Nat.mul_pos hg ha
  rw [sum_range_two_scale (g * a) b hga
    (fun v => ((v % (g * a) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((v % (g * b) : ℕ) : ℚ))]
  have hinner : ∀ u ∈ range (g * a),
      ∑ s ∈ range b, (((u + (g * a) * s) % (g * a) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((u + (g * a) * s) % (g * b) : ℕ) : ℚ)
        = (u : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ) + (g : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) - 1) / 2)) := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [mem_range] at hu
    have h1 : ∀ s : ℕ, (u + (g * a) * s) % (g * a) = u := by
      intro s; rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hu]
    have h2 : ∀ s : ℕ, (u + (g * a) * s) % (g * b) = u % g + g * ((u / g + a * s) % b) := by
      intro s
      have hrw : u + (g * a) * s = u % g + g * (u / g + a * s) := by
        have := Nat.div_add_mod u g
        ring_nf
        omega
      rw [hrw, mod_two_scale g b (u % g) (u / g + a * s) hb (Nat.mod_lt _ hg)]
    calc ∑ s ∈ range b,
            (((u + (g * a) * s) % (g * a) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((u + (g * a) * s) % (g * b) : ℕ) : ℚ)
        = ∑ s ∈ range b, ((u : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ)
            + ((u : ℚ) * (g : ℚ)) * ((((u / g + a * s) % b : ℕ)) : ℚ)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
          rw [h1 s, h2 s]; push_cast; ring
      _ = (b : ℚ) * ((u : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ))
            + ((u : ℚ) * (g : ℚ)) * ∑ s ∈ range b, ((((u / g + a * s) % b : ℕ)) : ℚ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = (b : ℚ) * ((u : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ))
            + ((u : ℚ) * (g : ℚ)) * ((b : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) - 1) / 2) := by
          rw [sum_range_affine_perm a b (u / g) hb hab (fun t => (t : ℚ)), sum_range_cast]
      _ = (u : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ) + (g : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) - 1) / 2)) := by
          ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hinner]
  have hsplit : ∑ u ∈ range (g * a),
        (u : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ) + (g : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) - 1) / 2))
      = (b : ℚ) * ∑ u ∈ range (g * a), (u : ℚ) * ((u % g : ℕ) : ℚ)
        + ((g : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) - 1) / 2)) * ∑ u ∈ range (g * a), (u : ℚ) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => by ring
  rw [hsplit, sum_range_mod_mul_mod_aux g a hg, sum_range_cast]
  push_cast
  ring

/-! ## §24.2  Complete-period shift invariance -/

/-- A one-step shift of a complete-period sum. -/
theorem sum_range_shift_one (L : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℚ) (hf : ∀ n, f (n + L) = f n) :
    ∑ v ∈ range L, f (v + 1) = ∑ v ∈ range L, f v := by
  have h1 : ∑ v ∈ range (L + 1), f v = ∑ v ∈ range L, f (v + 1) + f 0 :=
    Finset.sum_range_succ' f L
  have h2 : ∑ v ∈ range (L + 1), f v = ∑ v ∈ range L, f v + f L := Finset.sum_range_succ f L
  have h3 : f L = f 0 := by simpa using hf 0
  rw [h3] at h2
  linarith [h1, h2]

/-- **Complete-period shift invariance.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  A sum of an `L`-periodic
function over one complete period does not depend on the lane offset. -/
theorem sum_range_shift (L c : ℕ) :
    ∀ f : ℕ → ℚ, (∀ n, f (n + L) = f n) → ∑ v ∈ range L, f (v + c) = ∑ v ∈ range L, f v := by
  induction c with
  | zero => intro f _; simp
  | succ k ih =>
      intro f hf
      have hf' : ∀ n, (fun m => f (m + 1)) (n + L) = (fun m => f (m + 1)) n := by
        intro n; simpa [add_right_comm] using hf (n + 1)
      calc ∑ v ∈ range L, f (v + (k + 1))
          = ∑ v ∈ range L, (fun m => f (m + 1)) (v + k) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
            simp [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm]
        _ = ∑ v ∈ range L, (fun m => f (m + 1)) v := ih (fun m => f (m + 1)) hf'
        _ = ∑ v ∈ range L, f v := sum_range_shift_one L f hf

/-! ## §24.3  The endpoint function and its complete-period covariance -/

/-- The finite sawtooth endpoint function `φ_q^{(c)}(v) = ((v+c) mod q)/q − (q−1)/(2q)`:
the centred discrete sawtooth in lane `c`. -/
def endpointPhi (q c v : ℕ) : ℚ := (((v + c) % q : ℕ) : ℚ) / q - ((q : ℚ) - 1) / (2 * q)

/-- The complete-period covariance of two endpoint functions, averaged over one full joint
period `L = lcm(q₁,q₂)`. -/
def endpointCovariance (q1 q2 c : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  (1 / ((Nat.lcm q1 q2 : ℕ) : ℚ))
    * ∑ v ∈ range (Nat.lcm q1 q2), endpointPhi q1 c v * endpointPhi q2 c v

/-- `φ_q^{(c)}` has mean zero over a complete period. -/
theorem endpointPhi_sum_period (q c : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∑ v ∈ range q, endpointPhi q c v = 0 := by
  have hper : ∀ n : ℕ, (fun v => (((v : ℕ) % q : ℕ) : ℚ)) (n + q) = (fun v => (((v : ℕ) % q : ℕ) : ℚ)) n := by
    intro n; simp
  have hshift : ∑ v ∈ range q, (((v + c) % q : ℕ) : ℚ) = ∑ v ∈ range q, ((v % q : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
    sum_range_shift q c (fun v => ((v % q : ℕ) : ℚ)) hper
  have hbase : ∑ v ∈ range q, ((v % q : ℕ) : ℚ) = (q : ℚ) * ((q : ℚ) - 1) / 2 := by
    have := sum_range_mod_cast q 1 hq
    simpa using this
  have hq' : (q : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hq.ne'
  unfold endpointPhi
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_div, hshift, hbase, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- **`endpointCovariance_exact`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The exact complete-period endpoint
covariance identity: for `q₁, q₂ ≥ 1`, in any lane `c`,

    (1/L) ∑_{v mod L} φ_{q₁}^{(c)}(v) φ_{q₂}^{(c)}(v) = (g² − 1)/(12 q₁ q₂),

with `g = gcd(q₁,q₂)`, `L = lcm(q₁,q₂)`. -/
theorem endpointCovariance_exact {q1 q2 : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < q1) (h2 : 0 < q2) (c : ℕ) :
    endpointCovariance q1 q2 c
      = ((Nat.gcd q1 q2 : ℚ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (q1 : ℚ) * (q2 : ℚ)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, a, b, hgdef, hg, ha, hb, hq1, hq2, hab⟩ :
      ∃ g a b : ℕ, g = Nat.gcd q1 q2 ∧ 0 < g ∧ 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ q1 = g * a ∧ q2 = g * b ∧
        Nat.Coprime a b := by
    refine ⟨Nat.gcd q1 q2, q1 / Nat.gcd q1 q2, q2 / Nat.gcd q1 q2, rfl,
      Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ h1, ?_, ?_,
      (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left q1 q2)).symm,
      (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_right q1 q2)).symm,
      Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ h1)⟩
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (q1 / Nat.gcd q1 q2) with hz | hz
      · have := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left q1 q2)).symm
        rw [hz, mul_zero] at this; omega
      · exact hz
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (q2 / Nat.gcd q1 q2) with hz | hz
      · have := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_right q1 q2)).symm
        rw [hz, mul_zero] at this; omega
      · exact hz
  have hL : Nat.lcm q1 q2 = g * a * b := by
    have hkey : g * Nat.lcm q1 q2 = g * (g * a * b) := by
      rw [hgdef, Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      conv_lhs => rw [hq1, hq2]
      rw [← hgdef]; ring
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hg hkey
  have hLpos : 0 < g * a * b := by positivity
  have hq1L : q1 ∣ g * a * b := ⟨b, by rw [hq1]⟩
  have hq2L : q2 ∣ g * a * b := ⟨a, by rw [hq2]; ring⟩
  obtain ⟨k1, hk1⟩ := hq1L
  obtain ⟨k2, hk2⟩ := hq2L
  have hm1 : ∀ n : ℕ, (n + g * a * b) % q1 = n % q1 := by
    intro n; rw [hk1, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]
  have hm2 : ∀ n : ℕ, (n + g * a * b) % q2 = n % q2 := by
    intro n; rw [hk2, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]
  have hper1 : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (fun v => ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) (n + g * a * b) = (fun v => ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) n := by
    intro n; simp only []; rw [hm1 n]
  have hper2 : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (fun v => ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)) (n + g * a * b) = (fun v => ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)) n := by
    intro n; simp only []; rw [hm2 n]
  have hper : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (fun v => ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)) (n + g * a * b)
        = (fun v => ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)) n := by
    intro n; simp only []; rw [hm1 n, hm2 n]
  -- the three complete-period moments, in lane 0
  have hS12 : ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ)
        * (((q1 : ℚ) - 1) * ((q2 : ℚ) - 1) / 4 + ((g : ℚ) ^ 2 - 1) / 12) := by
    have hraw := sum_range_mod_mul_mod g a b hg hb hab
    rw [← hq1, ← hq2] at hraw
    have hrange : g * a * b = q1 * b := by rw [hq1]
    rw [hrange]
    exact hraw
  have hS1 : ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((q1 : ℚ) - 1) / 2 := by
    have hrange : g * a * b = q1 * b := by rw [hq1]
    rw [hrange, sum_range_mod_cast q1 b h1]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hS2 : ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((q2 : ℚ) - 1) / 2 := by
    have hrange : g * a * b = q2 * a := by rw [hq2]; ring
    rw [hrange, sum_range_mod_cast q2 a h2]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hq1' : (q1 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 h1.ne'
  have hq2' : (q2 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 h2.ne'
  have hLne : ((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hLpos.ne'
  -- pointwise expansion of the product of the two endpoint functions
  have hpt : ∀ v : ℕ, endpointPhi q1 c v * endpointPhi q2 c v
      = (1 / ((q1 : ℚ) * (q2 : ℚ)))
        * ((((v + c) % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((v + c) % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)
            - ((q2 : ℚ) - 1) / 2 * (((v + c) % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ)
            - ((q1 : ℚ) - 1) / 2 * (((v + c) % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)
            + ((q1 : ℚ) - 1) * ((q2 : ℚ) - 1) / 4) := by
    intro v
    unfold endpointPhi
    field_simp
    ring
  have hshift12 : ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), (((v + c) % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((v + c) % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
    sum_range_shift (g * a * b) c (fun v => ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)) hper
  have hshift1 : ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), (((v + c) % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
    sum_range_shift (g * a * b) c (fun v => ((v % q1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) hper1
  have hshift2 : ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), (((v + c) % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
    sum_range_shift (g * a * b) c (fun v => ((v % q2 : ℕ) : ℚ)) hper2
  have hsum : ∑ v ∈ range (g * a * b), endpointPhi q1 c v * endpointPhi q2 c v
      = (1 / ((q1 : ℚ) * (q2 : ℚ)))
        * (((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((q1 : ℚ) - 1) * ((q2 : ℚ) - 1) / 4 + ((g : ℚ) ^ 2 - 1) / 12)
            - ((q2 : ℚ) - 1) / 2 * (((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((q1 : ℚ) - 1) / 2)
            - ((q1 : ℚ) - 1) / 2 * (((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((q2 : ℚ) - 1) / 2)
            + ((g * a * b : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((q1 : ℚ) - 1) * ((q2 : ℚ) - 1) / 4)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => hpt v), ← Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul,
      hshift12, hshift1, hshift2, hS12, hS1, hS2]
  unfold endpointCovariance
  rw [hL, hsum, ← hgdef]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- **`endpointCovariance_coprime_zero`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  Coprime moduli have exactly
orthogonal endpoint functions. -/
theorem endpointCovariance_coprime_zero {q1 q2 : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < q1) (h2 : 0 < q2)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime q1 q2) (c : ℕ) : endpointCovariance q1 q2 c = 0 := by
  rw [endpointCovariance_exact h1 h2 c]
  have : Nat.gcd q1 q2 = 1 := hcop
  rw [this]
  norm_num

/-- **`endpointCovariance_nonneg`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The complete-period endpoint
covariance is nonnegative. -/
theorem endpointCovariance_nonneg {q1 q2 : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < q1) (h2 : 0 < q2) (c : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ endpointCovariance q1 q2 c := by
  rw [endpointCovariance_exact h1 h2 c]
  have hg : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd q1 q2 := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ h1
  have hg' : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (Nat.gcd q1 q2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hg
  have hnum : 0 ≤ ((Nat.gcd q1 q2 : ℚ)) ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hden : 0 < 12 * (q1 : ℚ) * (q2 : ℚ) := by
    have : (0 : ℚ) < q1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have : (0 : ℚ) < q2 := by exact_mod_cast h2
    positivity
  positivity

/-- **`endpointCovariance_gcd_stratum`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The covariance depends on the
pair only through the `gcd` stratum and the product `q₁q₂`: two pairs with the same `gcd`
and the same product have the same covariance, in every lane. -/
theorem endpointCovariance_gcd_stratum {q1 q2 r1 r2 : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < q1) (h2 : 0 < q2)
    (k1 : 0 < r1) (k2 : 0 < r2) (hgcd : Nat.gcd q1 q2 = Nat.gcd r1 r2)
    (hprod : q1 * q2 = r1 * r2) (c d : ℕ) :
    endpointCovariance q1 q2 c = endpointCovariance r1 r2 d := by
  rw [endpointCovariance_exact h1 h2 c, endpointCovariance_exact k1 k2 d, hgcd]
  have hq : (q1 : ℚ) * (q2 : ℚ) = (r1 : ℚ) * (r2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hprod
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hq]

/-- **`endpointCovariance_lane_independent`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The complete-period
covariance is the same in every permitted lane. -/
theorem endpointCovariance_lane_independent {q1 q2 : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < q1) (h2 : 0 < q2) (c d : ℕ) :
    endpointCovariance q1 q2 c = endpointCovariance q1 q2 d := by
  rw [endpointCovariance_exact h1 h2 c, endpointCovariance_exact h1 h2 d]

/-- **`endpointCovariance_odd`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The specialisation used by the source:
odd moduli `q₁, q₂` in a permitted lane `c`. -/
theorem endpointCovariance_odd {q1 q2 : ℕ} (h1 : Odd q1) (h2 : Odd q2) (c : ℕ) :
    endpointCovariance q1 q2 c = ((Nat.gcd q1 q2 : ℚ) ^ 2 - 1) / (12 * (q1 : ℚ) * (q2 : ℚ)) :=
  endpointCovariance_exact h1.pos h2.pos c

/-- **`endpointCovariance_odd_coprime_or_stratum`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  For odd moduli the
covariance vanishes exactly on the coprime stratum: if `gcd(q₁,q₂) > 1` the covariance is
strictly positive. -/
theorem endpointCovariance_pos_of_gcd_gt_one {q1 q2 : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < q1) (h2 : 0 < q2)
    (hgcd : 1 < Nat.gcd q1 q2) (c : ℕ) : 0 < endpointCovariance q1 q2 c := by
  rw [endpointCovariance_exact h1 h2 c]
  have hg' : (1 : ℚ) < (Nat.gcd q1 q2 : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hgcd
  have hnum : 0 < ((Nat.gcd q1 q2 : ℚ)) ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hq1 : (0 : ℚ) < q1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have hq2 : (0 : ℚ) < q2 := by exact_mod_cast h2
  positivity

end Effectivity
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=6044 sha256=a096fb484c6876018da85086b819232f1bd88348b343870e331d51aeaea6cc2e path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ConductorComplementLedger.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 effectivity — conductor / complement architecture and the owner ledger (§63)

```
COMPLEMENT SLAB k < 15015, Ω(k) ≤ 3      : KERNEL-PROVED (exact support description)
ω(k) ≤ Ω(k) ON THE SLAB                  : KERNEL-PROVED
OWNER SOURCE VARIABLES PAIRWISE DISJOINT : KERNEL-PROVED
SUBTRACTION / UPDATE LAW                 : KERNEL-PROVED
DISJOINTNESS ⇒ NO NUMERICAL BOUND        : KERNEL-PROVED FIREWALL
```

After all already-banked source removals the live complement is described by the finite slab

    k < 15015    and    Ω(k) ≤ 3,

`15015 = 3·5·7·11·13` being the first odd modulus with five prime factors.  The slab is a
`Finset` and `mem_complementSlab` is its exact membership description; no numerical
whole-slab bound is kernel-promoted anywhere in this file.

The owner ledger records **who** pays for each removed source.  Each owner is attached to a
*declared source variable*; `owner_sources_pairwise_disjoint` proves the attachment is
injective, i.e. no double charge is possible at the level of source variables.  The update
law `ledgerUpdate` shows subtraction/replacement preserves the parent total exactly, and
`disjointness_gives_no_bound` records that disjointness alone implies **no** numerical
inequality.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287
namespace Effectivity

/-! ## §63.1  The complement slab -/

/-- `Ω(k)`, the number of prime factors of `k` with multiplicity. -/
def bigOmega (k : ℕ) : ℕ := ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors k

/-- The live complement slab: `k < 15015` with `Ω(k) ≤ 3`. -/
def complementSlab : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 15014).filter (fun k => bigOmega k ≤ 3)

/-- **`mem_complementSlab`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  Exact membership description. -/
theorem mem_complementSlab {k : ℕ} :
    k ∈ complementSlab ↔ (1 ≤ k ∧ k < 15015 ∧ bigOmega k ≤ 3) := by
  simp only [complementSlab, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩; exact ⟨h1, by omega, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩; exact ⟨⟨h1, by omega⟩, h3⟩

/-- **`omega_le_bigOmega_on_slab`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  On the slab the number of *distinct*
prime factors is also at most three. -/
theorem omega_le_bigOmega_on_slab {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∈ complementSlab) :
    k.primeFactors.card ≤ 3 := by
  rw [mem_complementSlab] at hk
  have h : k.primeFactors.card ≤ bigOmega k := by
    rw [bigOmega, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply, ← Nat.toFinset_factors k]
    exact List.toFinset_card_le _
  omega

/-- **`slab_excludes_15015`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  `15015 = 3·5·7·11·13` is outside the slab. -/
theorem slab_excludes_15015 : (15015 : ℕ) ∉ complementSlab := by
  rw [mem_complementSlab]
  rintro ⟨-, h, -⟩
  omega

/-- **`slab_contains_core`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The `k = 1` core lies in the slab. -/
theorem slab_contains_core : (1 : ℕ) ∈ complementSlab := by
  rw [mem_complementSlab]
  refine ⟨le_refl 1, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  rw [bigOmega, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_one]
  omega

/-! ## §63.2  The owner ledger -/

/-- The current owners of removed source. -/
inductive Owner
  | internalProjectorTail   -- `d > 30000`
  | sourceEGt5000           -- `e > 5000`
  | atomTOne                -- `t = 1`
  | p8BoundaryReplacement   -- P8 boundary
  | rankThreeOwners         -- rank-three closed `k`-owners
  | kOneCore                -- `k = 1` core
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The declared source variables. -/
inductive SourceVar
  | dTail | eSource | tAtom | p8Boundary | rankThree | kCore
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The declared source variable of each owner. -/
def ownerSource : Owner → SourceVar
  | .internalProjectorTail => .dTail
  | .sourceEGt5000 => .eSource
  | .atomTOne => .tAtom
  | .p8BoundaryReplacement => .p8Boundary
  | .rankThreeOwners => .rankThree
  | .kOneCore => .kCore

/-- **`owner_sources_pairwise_disjoint`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  Distinct owners are attached to
distinct source variables: no owner can be charged twice at its declared source. -/
theorem owner_sources_pairwise_disjoint :
    Function.Injective ownerSource := by
  intro a b hab
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [ownerSource]

/-- A ledger assigns a charge to each owner. -/
abbrev Ledger := Owner → ℚ

/-- The total charge of a ledger. -/
def ledgerTotal (L : Ledger) : ℚ :=
  L .internalProjectorTail + L .sourceEGt5000 + L .atomTOne + L .p8BoundaryReplacement
    + L .rankThreeOwners + L .kOneCore

/-- Replace the charge of one owner. -/
def ledgerUpdate (L : Ledger) (o : Owner) (v : ℚ) : Ledger :=
  fun p => if p = o then v else L p

/-- **`ledgerUpdate_total`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The subtraction/update law: replacing one
owner's charge changes the total exactly by the declared difference, leaving every other
owner's contribution — and hence the parent source — untouched. -/
theorem ledgerUpdate_total (L : Ledger) (o : Owner) (v : ℚ) :
    ledgerTotal (ledgerUpdate L o v) = ledgerTotal L - L o + v := by
  cases o <;> simp [ledgerTotal, ledgerUpdate] <;> ring

/-- **`ledgerUpdate_preserves_others`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  An update touches no other
owner. -/
theorem ledgerUpdate_preserves_others (L : Ledger) (o p : Owner) (v : ℚ) (h : p ≠ o) :
    ledgerUpdate L o v p = L p := by
  simp [ledgerUpdate, h]

/-- **`disjointness_gives_no_bound`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED` firewall.  Owner disjointness is a
bookkeeping statement only: for *every* proposed numerical bound there is a ledger, with the
same disjoint owner structure, exceeding it.  No numerical inequality may be inferred from
disjointness. -/
theorem disjointness_gives_no_bound (b : ℚ) :
    ∃ L : Ledger, Function.Injective ownerSource ∧ b < ledgerTotal L := by
  refine ⟨fun _ => |b| + 1, owner_sources_pairwise_disjoint, ?_⟩
  have h : |b| + 1 > 0 := by positivity
  have hb : b ≤ |b| := le_abs_self b
  simp only [ledgerTotal]
  linarith

end Effectivity
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@

import Mathlib
import RequestProject.Erdos287.FiveBoxCharacterFactorization3221

/-!
# V20, Phases D / E / G / H — diagonal child, low-quotient child, capacity firewalls, router

`3221-HIGHCOND-DIAGONAL45 : EXTERNAL-ANALYTIC / CONDITIONAL COMPILER`
`3221-LOWQUOTIENT-CONDUCTOR-COLLAPSE45 : CONDITIONAL / EXTERNAL CLOSED`
`3221-POINTWISE-BURGESS45 : EXTERNAL CAPACITY NONCLOSING GLOBALLY`
`3221-BURGESS-CONDUCTOR-PAIR-ROUTER45 : CONDITIONAL EXTERNAL PASS`

**No external analytic theorem is formalised, assumed or axiomatised here.**  The classical
multiplicative large sieve and the Burgess bound appear *only* as uninhabited external
input structures carrying their intended shape; nothing in this repository inhabits them,
and no theorem converts their metadata into a mathematical claim.  Everything actually
proved below is finite algebra, elementary inequality chaining, or exact rational
arithmetic.

## Contents

* **§12.**  `PrimitiveConductorLargeSieve3221Input` — external, uninhabited, with the
  intended shape `E(R) ≤ logC · (Q/R) · (R² + W5) · ‖c‖₂²`, and the explicit conductor
  cutoff `Dcut` and its exponent `B0` recorded as *data of the input*.
  `largeSieve_not_automatic` shows it is a genuine restriction.
* **§13.**  `highCondDiagonal_of_largeSieve` — the conditional diagonal compiler, with the
  cutoff `B0` kept explicit.  `EXTERNAL-ANALYTIC CLOSED / CONDITIONAL COMPILER`, never
  relabelled `LEAN_PROVED` analytic.
* **§14.**  The diagonal exponent ledger: `diagonal_fixed_power_room = 4/35`,
  `diagonal_power_room_rational`, `diagonal_power_room_rpow`.
* **§15.**  `lowConductor_card_le` — the finite conductor count
  `#{ξ : cond ξ ≤ L} ≤ ∑_{r ∣ q, r ≤ L} φ(r)`, **proved**, with no logarithmic asymptotic
  claimed anywhere.
* **§16.**  `lowQuotient_child_le` — the finite low-quotient compiler, and
  `lowQuotient_child_of_diagonal_budget`.
* **§20.**  `PointwiseBurgess3221Input` — external, uninhabited, metadata only; plus the
  rational audit `pointwiseBurgess_capacity_deficit` (`879/560 − 624/560 = 51/112 > 0`).
* **§21–§23.**  Conductor-cell data, the router condition, the router compiler
  `conductorCell_routed`, and the exact rational threshold arithmetic
  `router_case_A`, `router_case_B`, `router_case_C`.

Erdős #287 remains OPEN; Balanced7 remains OPEN.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 4000

open Finset DirichletCharacter
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287
namespace V20Router

/-! ## §12. The primitive-conductor large sieve — external, uninhabited -/

/-- **`PrimitiveConductorLargeSieve3221Input`** — `EXTERNAL_ANALYTIC / UNINHABITED`.

The intended external estimate for the primitive-conductor energy of the source family:

`E(R) ≤ logC · (Q/R) · (R² + W5) · ‖c‖₂²`,

taken at high-conductor cutoff `Dcut = log^{B0} X`, with `B0` recorded explicitly as data
so that no later retuning of the cutoff can be hidden.

**This structure is never inhabited in this repository, and the classical multiplicative
large sieve is *not* formalised or axiomatised anywhere.** -/
structure PrimitiveConductorLargeSieve3221Input (Qmod R W5 logC cL2 energy Dcut B0 : ℝ) :
    Prop where
  /-- The dyadic conductor scale is positive. -/
  R_pos : 0 < R
  /-- The five-box scale is positive. -/
  W5_pos : 0 < W5
  /-- The modulus range is positive. -/
  Qmod_pos : 0 < Qmod
  /-- The logarithmic constant is positive. -/
  logC_pos : 0 < logC
  /-- The source `L²` mass is nonnegative. -/
  cL2_nonneg : 0 ≤ cL2
  /-- The conductor cutoff is positive. -/
  Dcut_pos : 0 < Dcut
  /-- The cutoff exponent is positive. -/
  B0_pos : 0 < B0
  /-- **The external analytic estimate.** -/
  energy_bound : energy ≤ logC * (Qmod / R) * (R ^ 2 + W5) * cL2

/-- **`largeSieve_not_automatic`.**  `LEAN_PROVED`.

The large-sieve input is a genuine restriction: explicit parameters refute it, so no
compiler below can be made unconditional. -/
theorem largeSieve_not_automatic :
    ∃ Qmod R W5 logC cL2 energy Dcut B0 : ℝ,
      ¬ PrimitiveConductorLargeSieve3221Input Qmod R W5 logC cL2 energy Dcut B0 := by
  refine ⟨1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, ?_⟩
  intro h
  have := h.energy_bound
  norm_num at this

/-! ## §13. The conditional diagonal compiler -/

/-- **`highCondDiagonal_of_largeSieve`.**  `CONDITIONAL_COMPILER / LEAN_PROVED`.

External primitive-conductor large-sieve input **+** the five-box `L²` source bound **+**
an explicit budget ⇒ the desired diagonal bound, at the explicit cutoff `Dcut = log^{B0} X`.

Nothing here inhabits the analytic input, so the diagonal child stays
`EXTERNAL-ANALYTIC CLOSED / CONDITIONAL COMPILER`. -/
theorem highCondDiagonal_of_largeSieve {Qmod R W5 logC cL2 energy Dcut B0 srcL2 target : ℝ}
    (hin : PrimitiveConductorLargeSieve3221Input Qmod R W5 logC cL2 energy Dcut B0)
    (hsrc : cL2 ≤ srcL2)
    (hbudget : logC * (Qmod / R) * (R ^ 2 + W5) * srcL2 ≤ target) :
    energy ≤ target := by
  have hfac : 0 ≤ logC * (Qmod / R) * (R ^ 2 + W5) := by
    have h1 : 0 < Qmod / R := div_pos hin.Qmod_pos hin.R_pos
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < R ^ 2 + W5 := by nlinarith [hin.R_pos, hin.W5_pos]
    exact le_of_lt (mul_pos (mul_pos hin.logC_pos h1) h2)
  have hmono : logC * (Qmod / R) * (R ^ 2 + W5) * cL2
      ≤ logC * (Qmod / R) * (R ^ 2 + W5) * srcL2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsrc hfac
  exact le_trans hin.energy_bound (le_trans hmono hbudget)

/-! ## §14. The diagonal exponent ledger -/

/-- The fixed diagonal power room `4/35`. -/
def diagonal_fixed_power_room : ℚ := 4 / 35

/-- **`diagonal_power_room_rational`.**  `PROVED_ALGEBRAIC / METADATA_ONLY`.

`1 − 39/35 = −4/35`, i.e. the fixed diagonal power room is `4/35 > 0`. -/
theorem diagonal_power_room_rational :
    (1 : ℚ) - 39 / 35 = -diagonal_fixed_power_room ∧ (0 : ℚ) < diagonal_fixed_power_room := by
  rw [diagonal_fixed_power_room]
  constructor <;> norm_num

/-- **`diagonal_power_room_rpow`.**  `PROVED_ALGEBRAIC / METADATA_ONLY`.

With `M · W5 = X` (the natural scale) and `M · W5² / Q = X^{39/35}` (the pre-Poisson
density scale), the ratio of the two is exactly `X^{−4/35}`.  This is rational power
arithmetic; **no asymptotic claim is made**. -/
theorem diagonal_power_room_rpow (X M W5 Qmod : ℝ) (hX : 0 < X) (h1 : M * W5 = X)
    (h2 : M * W5 ^ 2 / Qmod = X ^ (39 / 35 : ℝ)) :
    (M * W5) / (M * W5 ^ 2 / Qmod) = X ^ (-(4 / 35) : ℝ) := by
  rw [h1, h2, show (-(4 / 35) : ℝ) = 1 - 39 / 35 by norm_num, Real.rpow_sub hX,
    Real.rpow_one]

/-! ## §15. The finite low-conductor count -/

/-- **`lowConductor_card_le`.**  `LEAN_PROVED_FINITE`.

`#{ξ mod q : cond(ξ) ≤ L} ≤ ∑_{r ∣ q, r ≤ L} φ(r)`.

Each character is the level-`q` lift of its own primitive character, and at a fixed level
that lift is unique, so the fibre above a conductor `r` injects into the characters mod `r`.
**No logarithmic asymptotic is claimed.** -/
theorem lowConductor_card_le (q L : ℕ) [NeZero q] :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun xi : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => xi.conductor ≤ L)).card
      ≤ ∑ r ∈ q.divisors.filter (fun r => r ≤ L), r.totient := by
  classical
  set S := Finset.univ.filter (fun xi : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => xi.conductor ≤ L) with hS
  set t := q.divisors.filter (fun r => r ≤ L) with ht
  have hmap : Set.MapsTo (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ.conductor) (↑S) (↑t) := by
    intro χ hχ
    have hχ' : χ ∈ S := by simpa using hχ
    rw [hS] at hχ'
    have h1 : χ.conductor ≤ L := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hχ').2
    simp only [ht, Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Nat.mem_divisors]
    exact ⟨⟨χ.conductor_dvd_level, NeZero.ne q⟩, h1⟩
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmap]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
  intro r hr
  rw [ht] at hr
  have hrq : r ∣ q := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).1).1
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact (NeZero.ne q) (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd hrq)
  haveI : NeZero r := ⟨hr0⟩
  have hsub : S.filter (fun χ => χ.conductor = r)
      ⊆ Finset.image (fun θ : DirichletCharacter ℂ r => DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hrq θ)
          Finset.univ := by
    intro χ hχ
    have h : χ.conductor = r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hχ).2
    subst h
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨χ.primitiveCharacter, Finset.mem_univ _,
      changeLevel_primitiveCharacter χ⟩
  calc (S.filter (fun χ => χ.conductor = r)).card
      ≤ (Finset.image (fun θ : DirichletCharacter ℂ r => DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hrq θ)
          Finset.univ).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ r)).card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = r.totient := by
        rw [Finset.card_univ, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
          MulChar.card_eq_card_units_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
          ZMod.card_units_eq_totient]

/-! ## §16. The low-quotient compiler -/

/-- **`lowQuotient_child_le`.**  `LEAN_PROVED_FINITE`.

If the autocorrelation is bounded by `Eq`, the short-`m` Gram by `Mbound`, the twisting
factor by `1` in modulus, and the low-quotient character multiplicity by `lowMult`, then
the low-quotient Gram child is at most `lowMult · (Mbound · Eq)`.

Pure finite algebra: no asymptotic input, no logarithm. -/
theorem lowQuotient_child_le {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (w G A : ι → ℂ)
    (Eq Mbound lowMult : ℝ) (hcard : (T.card : ℝ) ≤ lowMult)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖w x‖ ≤ 1) (hG : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖G x‖ ≤ Mbound) (hA : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖A x‖ ≤ Eq)
    (hM : 0 ≤ Mbound) (hE : 0 ≤ Eq) :
    ‖∑ x ∈ T, w x * G x * A x‖ ≤ lowMult * (Mbound * Eq) := by
  have hterm : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖w x * G x * A x‖ ≤ Mbound * Eq := by
    intro x hx
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
    have h1 := hw x hx
    have h2 := hG x hx
    have h3 := hA x hx
    have hb1 : ‖w x‖ * ‖G x‖ ≤ 1 * Mbound :=
      mul_le_mul h1 h2 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
    have hb2 : ‖w x‖ * ‖G x‖ * ‖A x‖ ≤ (1 * Mbound) * Eq :=
      mul_le_mul hb1 h3 (norm_nonneg _) (by rw [one_mul]; exact hM)
    linarith [hb2]
  calc ‖∑ x ∈ T, w x * G x * A x‖ ≤ ∑ x ∈ T, ‖w x * G x * A x‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ T, Mbound * Eq := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = (T.card : ℝ) * (Mbound * Eq) := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ lowMult * (Mbound * Eq) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (mul_nonneg hM hE)

/-- **`lowQuotient_child_of_diagonal_budget`.**  `CONDITIONAL_COMPILER / LEAN_PROVED`.

The low-quotient child is controlled by the multiplicity times the diagonal energy budget:
combining the finite compiler with an explicit budget hypothesis. -/
theorem lowQuotient_child_of_diagonal_budget {ι : Type*} (T : Finset ι) (w G A : ι → ℂ)
    (Eq Mbound lowMult target : ℝ) (hcard : (T.card : ℝ) ≤ lowMult)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖w x‖ ≤ 1) (hG : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖G x‖ ≤ Mbound) (hA : ∀ x ∈ T, ‖A x‖ ≤ Eq)
    (hM : 0 ≤ Mbound) (hE : 0 ≤ Eq) (hbudget : lowMult * (Mbound * Eq) ≤ target) :
    ‖∑ x ∈ T, w x * G x * A x‖ ≤ target :=
  le_trans (lowQuotient_child_le T w G A Eq Mbound lowMult hcard hw hG hA hM hE) hbudget

/-! ## §20. The pointwise Burgess capacity firewall — external metadata only -/

/-- **`PointwiseBurgess3221Input`** — `EXTERNAL_ANALYTIC / UNINHABITED / METADATA_ONLY`.

The intended pointwise character-sum bound in the shape used by the audit.  **Burgess's
theorem is not formalised, assumed or axiomatised anywhere in this repository**, and this
structure is never inhabited. -/
structure PointwiseBurgess3221Input (Mlen Rcond burgessConst delta value : ℝ) : Prop where
  /-- The summation length is positive. -/
  Mlen_pos : 0 < Mlen
  /-- The conductor is positive. -/
  Rcond_pos : 0 < Rcond
  /-- The implied constant is positive. -/
  const_pos : 0 < burgessConst
  /-- The saving exponent is positive. -/
  delta_pos : 0 < delta
  /-- **The external pointwise estimate.** -/
  pointwise_bound : value ≤ burgessConst * Mlen * Rcond ^ (-delta)

/-- The pointwise-Burgess input is not automatic. -/
theorem pointwiseBurgess_not_automatic :
    ∃ Mlen Rcond burgessConst delta value : ℝ,
      ¬ PointwiseBurgess3221Input Mlen Rcond burgessConst delta value := by
  refine ⟨1, 1, 1, 1, 2, ?_⟩
  intro h
  have := h.pointwise_bound
  norm_num at this

/-- **`pointwiseBurgess_capacity_deficit`.**  `PROVED_ALGEBRAIC / METADATA_ONLY`.

The rational arithmetic generated by the audit of the pointwise route:
`879/560 − 624/560 = 51/112 > 0`, i.e. the global pointwise Burgess route is capacity
nonclosing.  **This is arithmetic about the audit's exponents, not a theorem about
Burgess's bound.** -/
theorem pointwiseBurgess_capacity_deficit :
    (879 : ℚ) / 560 - 624 / 560 = 51 / 112 ∧ (0 : ℚ) < 51 / 112 := by
  constructor <;> norm_num

/-! ## §21. Conductor-cell data and the router condition -/

/-- Explicit dyadic conductor-cell metadata: `R1 ~ cond(χ)`, `R2 ~ cond(ψ)`,
`Rxi ~ cond(χ ψ̄)`, together with the five-box scale `W5`, the `m`-length `M` and a
positive margin. -/
structure ConductorCell where
  /-- Dyadic scale of `cond(χ)`. -/
  R1 : ℝ
  /-- Dyadic scale of `cond(ψ)`. -/
  R2 : ℝ
  /-- Dyadic scale of `cond(χ ψ̄)`. -/
  Rxi : ℝ
  /-- The five-box scale. -/
  W5 : ℝ
  /-- The `m`-box length. -/
  Mlen : ℝ
  /-- The routing margin. -/
  margin : ℝ
  /-- Positivity of the first conductor scale. -/
  R1_pos : 0 < R1
  /-- Positivity of the second conductor scale. -/
  R2_pos : 0 < R2
  /-- Positivity of the quotient conductor scale. -/
  Rxi_pos : 0 < Rxi
  /-- Positivity of the five-box scale. -/
  W5_pos : 0 < W5
  /-- Positivity of the `m`-box length. -/
  Mlen_pos : 0 < Mlen
  /-- Positivity of the margin. -/
  margin_pos : 0 < margin

/-- The router condition, in the exact form used by the audit:
`√((R1²+W5)(R2²+W5)) ≤ W5 · √M · Rxi^{−3/16} · margin`. -/
def RouterCondition (cell : ConductorCell) : Prop :=
  Real.sqrt ((cell.R1 ^ 2 + cell.W5) * (cell.R2 ^ 2 + cell.W5))
    ≤ cell.W5 * Real.sqrt cell.Mlen * cell.Rxi ^ (-(3 / 16) : ℝ) * cell.margin

/-! ## §22. The conditional router compiler -/

/-- **`LargeSieveConductorFactor3221Input`** — `EXTERNAL_ANALYTIC / UNINHABITED`.

The `χ`-side factor bound `‖X‖ ≤ √(R² + W5) · base` intended to come from the
primitive-conductor large sieve.  Never inhabited here. -/
structure LargeSieveConductorFactor3221Input (R W5 base : ℝ) (X : ℂ) : Prop where
  /-- The conductor scale is positive. -/
  R_pos : 0 < R
  /-- The five-box scale is positive. -/
  W5_pos : 0 < W5
  /-- The base factor is nonnegative. -/
  base_nonneg : 0 ≤ base
  /-- **The external factor bound.** -/
  factor_bound : ‖X‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 + W5) * base

/-- **`BurgessConductorFactor3221Input`** — `EXTERNAL_ANALYTIC / UNINHABITED`.

The `ψ`-side factor bound `‖Y‖ ≤ √(R² + W5) · base` intended to come from the pointwise
Burgess estimate.  Never inhabited here. -/
structure BurgessConductorFactor3221Input (R W5 base : ℝ) (Y : ℂ) : Prop where
  /-- The conductor scale is positive. -/
  R_pos : 0 < R
  /-- The five-box scale is positive. -/
  W5_pos : 0 < W5
  /-- The base factor is nonnegative. -/
  base_nonneg : 0 ≤ base
  /-- **The external factor bound.** -/
  factor_bound : ‖Y‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 + W5) * base

/-- **`conductorCell_routed`.**  `CONDITIONAL_COMPILER / LEAN_PROVED`.

External large-sieve factor input **+** external Burgess factor input **+** the router
condition ⇒ the conductor cell is power closed:

`‖X · Y‖ ≤ (W5 · √M · Rxi^{−3/16} · margin) · (base₁ base₂)`.

Neither external input is inhabited, so this compiler concludes nothing unconditionally. -/
theorem conductorCell_routed (cell : ConductorCell) {base1 base2 : ℝ} {X Y : ℂ}
    (hLS : LargeSieveConductorFactor3221Input cell.R1 cell.W5 base1 X)
    (hBu : BurgessConductorFactor3221Input cell.R2 cell.W5 base2 Y)
    (hrouter : RouterCondition cell) :
    ‖X * Y‖
      ≤ (cell.W5 * Real.sqrt cell.Mlen * cell.Rxi ^ (-(3 / 16) : ℝ) * cell.margin) *
        (base1 * base2) := by
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (cell.R1 ^ 2 + cell.W5) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (cell.R2 ^ 2 + cell.W5) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hstep : ‖X * Y‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (cell.R1 ^ 2 + cell.W5) * base1) *
        (Real.sqrt (cell.R2 ^ 2 + cell.W5) * base2) := by
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hLS.factor_bound hBu.factor_bound (norm_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg h1 hLS.base_nonneg)
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (cell.R1 ^ 2 + cell.W5) * Real.sqrt (cell.R2 ^ 2 + cell.W5)
      = Real.sqrt ((cell.R1 ^ 2 + cell.W5) * (cell.R2 ^ 2 + cell.W5)) :=
    (Real.sqrt_mul (by nlinarith [cell.R1_pos, cell.W5_pos]) _).symm
  have hbb : 0 ≤ base1 * base2 := mul_nonneg hLS.base_nonneg hBu.base_nonneg
  calc ‖X * Y‖ ≤ (Real.sqrt (cell.R1 ^ 2 + cell.W5) * base1) *
        (Real.sqrt (cell.R2 ^ 2 + cell.W5) * base2) := hstep
    _ = Real.sqrt ((cell.R1 ^ 2 + cell.W5) * (cell.R2 ^ 2 + cell.W5)) * (base1 * base2) := by
        rw [← hsqrt]; ring
    _ ≤ (cell.W5 * Real.sqrt cell.Mlen * cell.Rxi ^ (-(3 / 16) : ℝ) * cell.margin) *
        (base1 * base2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrouter hbb

/-! ## §23. The exact rational router arithmetic -/

/-- The routed region for a conductor pair, in exponent form: the product of the two
conductors is at most `X^{417/560 − ε}`. -/
def RoutedExponentPair (e1 e2 eps : ℚ) : Prop := e1 + e2 ≤ 417 / 560 - eps

instance decidableRoutedExponentPair (e1 e2 eps : ℚ) :
    Decidable (RoutedExponentPair e1 e2 eps) := by
  unfold RoutedExponentPair
  infer_instance

/-- **`router_case_A`.**  `PROVED_ALGEBRAIC`.

Both conductors at most `X^{5/14}` ⇒ routed, for every margin `ε ≤ 17/560`. -/
theorem router_case_A {e1 e2 eps : ℚ} (h1 : e1 ≤ 5 / 14) (h2 : e2 ≤ 5 / 14)
    (heps : eps ≤ 17 / 560) : RoutedExponentPair e1 e2 eps := by
  rw [RoutedExponentPair]
  linarith

/-- **`router_case_B`.**  `PROVED_ALGEBRAIC`.

One conductor at most `X^{5/14}`, the other at most `X^{31/80 − ε}` ⇒ routed, with the
explicit margin `ε`.  Note `5/14 + 31/80 = 417/560` exactly. -/
theorem router_case_B {e1 e2 eps : ℚ} (h1 : e1 ≤ 5 / 14) (h2 : e2 ≤ 31 / 80 - eps) :
    RoutedExponentPair e1 e2 eps := by
  rw [RoutedExponentPair]
  linarith

/-- **`router_case_C`.**  `PROVED_ALGEBRAIC`.

Both conductors larger than `X^{5/14}`, but with product at most `X^{417/560 − ε}`
⇒ routed. -/
theorem router_case_C {e1 e2 eps : ℚ} (h : e1 + e2 ≤ 417 / 560 - eps) :
    RoutedExponentPair e1 e2 eps := h

/-- The exact rational identity behind case B: `5/14 + 31/80 = 417/560`. -/
theorem router_threshold_identity : (5 : ℚ) / 14 + 31 / 80 = 417 / 560 := by norm_num

/-- Case A really has positive slack: `2 · 5/14 = 400/560 < 417/560`. -/
theorem router_case_A_slack : (2 : ℚ) * (5 / 14) = 400 / 560 ∧ (400 : ℚ) / 560 < 417 / 560 := by
  constructor <;> norm_num

end V20Router
end Erdos287

## Open-frontier firewall (§22)

The nodes below are left **unproved and uninhabited**.  `Erdos287Solved` is the honest
statement of the problem and is *not* proved anywhere in this package; `frontierStatus`
records every listed node as `open`, and `erdos287_not_claimed` witnesses that this file
asserts nothing about it.  No Maynard-type predicate is introduced at all.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287
namespace Effectivity

/-! ## §22  Open frontier -/

/-- The joined square-function bound with constant `C` for a supplied family of square
function values `S` and weights `w`.  **Not proved for any physical family.** -/
def JoinedSquareFunctionBound (C : ℝ) (S w : ℕ → ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∑ n ∈ F, (S n) ^ 2 ≤ C * ∑ n ∈ F, w n

/-- `C_joint ≤ 0.09` for a supplied constant.  The physical `C_joint` is **not defined**
in this package, so nothing instantiates this predicate. -/
def JointConstantBound (Cjoint : ℝ) : Prop := Cjoint ≤ 9 / 100

/-- The medium-`k` closure for a supplied residual and budget.  **Open.** -/
def MediumKClosed (residual budget : ℝ) : Prop := |residual| ≤ budget

/-- The two-high gap closure for a supplied residual and budget.  **Open / not entered.** -/
def TwoHighGapClosed (residual budget : ℝ) : Prop := |residual| ≤ budget

/-- The signed-floor closure for a supplied floor and target.  **Open.** -/
def SignedFloorClosed (floorValue target : ℝ) : Prop := target ≤ floorValue

/-- **The honest statement of Erdős #287.**  It is *not* proved here. -/
def Erdos287Solved : Prop := ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ¬ Erdos287Counterexample A

/-- The nodes of the open frontier. -/
inductive FrontierNode
  | joinedSquareFunction
  | jointConstant
  | mediumK
  | twoHighGap
  | signedFloor
  | erdos287
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Node status. -/
inductive NodeStatus
  | kernelProved
  | conditional
  | openNode
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Every frontier node is `open`. -/
def frontierStatus : FrontierNode → NodeStatus := fun _ => NodeStatus.openNode

/-- **`frontier_all_open`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  No node of the open frontier is recorded as
proved or as conditional. -/
theorem frontier_all_open (n : FrontierNode) : frontierStatus n = NodeStatus.openNode := rfl

/-- **`erdos287_not_claimed`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  This package makes no claim about
Erdős #287: the statement is recorded, and the only theorem about it here is that it is
equivalent to itself. -/
theorem erdos287_not_claimed : Erdos287Solved ↔ ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ¬ Erdos287Counterexample A :=
  Iff.rfl

import Mathlib
import RequestProject.Erdos287.CurrentStatusEffectivityEarly4490
import RequestProject.Erdos287.CompensatedMeasure
import RequestProject.Erdos287.HyperbolaInterfaces
import RequestProject.Erdos287.CompensatedSummationByParts
import RequestProject.Erdos287.AdjacentInterfaceFirewall
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResidueCollapse

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SmallEllCRT

import RequestProject.Erdos287.SmallEllMeanCovariance
import RequestProject.Erdos287.CompensationLoop
import RequestProject.Erdos287.BoundedConductorFrontier
import RequestProject.Erdos287.RankThreeOperator
import RequestProject.Erdos287.RankThreeProjection

import RequestProject.Erdos287.AnnihilatorFamily
import RequestProject.Erdos287.DensityCompensationRestoration

/-!
# Erdős #287 effectivity — status after the bounded-conductor sync (§23)

INTERNAL #287 EFFECTIVITY PROGRAMME ONLY.
**No public Erdős problem number is claimed here; public-problem-id provenance is `PENDING`.**

This module **extends** the earlier aggregators (`CurrentStatusEffectivity`,
`...LongFibre`, `...Multiplicity`, `...Early4490`).  Nothing earlier is rewritten or deleted:
the EARLY_4490 bank remains a valid ancestor, and its statements are untouched.

```
EARLY_4490 old rational-jet coordinate : SUPERSEDED AS CURRENT ROOT (still valid ancestor)
compensated interface                  : KERNEL-PROVED exact identity
ℓ ≤ 5000 CRT compiler                  : KERNEL-PROVED
ℓ ≤ 1000 cancellation                  : KERNEL-PROVED
1000 < ℓ ≤ 5000 finite kernel          : CURRENT k = 1 OPEN FRONTIER
positive finite-kernel wrapper         : RETIRED_NONCLOSING
rank three                             : STRICTLY_REDUCED
Ω(k) = 2                               : OPEN
Ω(k) = 1                               : OPEN
Early4490                              : OPEN / STRICTLY REDUCED
proper gamma                           : OPEN
S_live                                 : OPEN
R_012                                  : OPEN
signed floor                           : OPEN
Maynard                                : NOT_ENTERED
final splice                           : OPEN
public-problem-id provenance           : PENDING
```

The live frontier coordinate is `BOUNDED_CONDUCTOR_SIGNED_OUTER_Z`, i.e. the analytic goal
`Erdos287.Effectivity.FixedConductorCharacterBound`, which is **not** inhabited anywhere.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287
namespace Effectivity

/-! ## §23.1  The current evidence taxonomy (§1) -/

/-- The full current evidence taxonomy.  This *extends* the earlier `Evidence` type
(which is kept intact for the ancestor banks) by the three tags `externalAnalytic`,
`falseClaim` and `superseded`. -/
inductive EvidenceCurrent
  /-- entire proof reconstructed in the kernel -/
  | kernelProved
  /-- backed by a checked finite certificate / data object -/
  | certificateBacked
  /-- quoted external analytic input, not formally reconstructed -/
  | externalAnalytic
  /-- proved only under an explicitly stated analytic hypothesis -/
  | conditionalAnalytic
  /-- open -/
  | openNode
  /-- a method retired because it cannot close the target -/
  | retiredNonclosing
  /-- refuted -/
  | falseClaim
  /-- correct but no longer the current root coordinate -/
  | superseded
  /-- not entered into the programme -/
  | notEntered
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Evidence classes that count as *closed* for bookkeeping purposes. -/
def EvidenceCurrent.isClosed : EvidenceCurrent → Bool
  | .kernelProved => true
  | .certificateBacked => true
  | .externalAnalytic => false
  | .conditionalAnalytic => false
  | .openNode => false
  | .retiredNonclosing => false
  | .falseClaim => false
  | .superseded => false
  | .notEntered => false

/-- The ancestor taxonomy embeds into the current one. -/
def EvidenceCurrent.ofAncestor : Evidence → EvidenceCurrent
  | .kernelProved => .kernelProved
  | .certificateBacked => .certificateBacked
  | .conditionalAnalytic => .conditionalAnalytic
  | .retiredNonclosingMethod => .retiredNonclosing
  | .openNode => .openNode
  | .notEntered => .notEntered

/-- **`evidence_embedding_preserves_closure`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The embedding of the
ancestor taxonomy does not turn an open ancestor node into a closed current node. -/
theorem evidence_embedding_preserves_closure (e : Evidence) :
    (EvidenceCurrent.ofAncestor e).isClosed = e.isClosed := by
  cases e <;> rfl

/-! ## §23.2  Checkpoint tag -/

/-- Checkpoint identifier for the data recorded in this module.  Any consumer of the
rank-three owner lists below must check this tag: the lists are a snapshot, not a theorem. -/
structure Checkpoint where
  /-- ISO date of the snapshot -/
  date : String
  /-- version label -/
  version : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The checkpoint of the present bounded-conductor sync. -/
def boundedConductorCheckpoint : Checkpoint :=
  { date := "2026-09-08", version := "BOUNDED_CONDUCTOR_SYNC_v1" }

/-- **`checkpoint_tag_recorded`.**  Bookkeeping: the snapshot below is tagged. -/
theorem checkpoint_tag_recorded :
    boundedConductorCheckpoint.date = "2026-09-08" ∧
      boundedConductorCheckpoint.version = "BOUNDED_CONDUCTOR_SYNC_v1" :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-! ## §23.3  The tracked nodes of the bounded-conductor frontier -/

/-- The nodes tracked after the bounded-conductor sync. -/
inductive BoundedConductorNode
  /-- the whole EARLY_4490 rational-jet bank, as an ancestor -/
  | early4490BankAncestor
  /-- EARLY_4490 viewed as the *root* coordinate -/
  | early4490AsCurrentRoot
  /-- the compensated counting measure `G, Ĝ, Ê` -/
  | compensatedMeasure
  /-- the odd-convolution identity for the selected β-weight -/
  | oddConvolutionIdentity
  /-- exact hyperbola reparametrisations -/
  | hyperbolaInterfaces
  /-- the four-term compensated summation by parts -/
  | compensatedSummationByParts
  /-- the adjacent-interface exact identity -/
  | adjacentInterfaceIdentity
  /-- the "adjacent shell only" route -/
  | adjacentShellOnlyRoute
  /-- the complete residue-class collapse -/
  | residueClassCollapse
  /-- absence of the top diagonal `s = z` -/
  | topDiagonalAbsent
  /-- the `E = 5000` cutoff-preserving shift sieve -/
  | truncatedShiftSieve
  /-- the internal product fibre `ℓ = d·t` -/
  | internalProductFibre
  /-- the firewall `internal ℓ ≠ conductor f` -/
  | internalEllFirewall
  /-- the complete small-`ℓ` local formula -/
  | smallEllLocalFormula
  /-- the CRT expansion and its atom count -/
  | crtExpansion
  /-- the bound `3^ω − 2^ω ≤ 65` for odd squarefree `ℓ ≤ 5000` -/
  | crtAtomBound
  /-- the exact half-open progression compiler -/
  | halfOpenProgressionCompiler
  /-- the small-`ℓ` local mean `−μ(ℓ)β(ℓ)/ℓ` -/
  | smallEllLocalMean
  /-- the complete-period covariance and its quadratic form -/
  | completePeriodCovariance
  /-- the exact `k = 1` density/compensation source identity -/
  | densityCompensationIdentity
  /-- the exact atomwise cancellation for `ℓ ≤ 1000` -/
  | loopCancellationSmallEll
  /-- the returned finite-conductor kernel for `1000 < ℓ ≤ 5000` -/
  | returnedFiniteConductorKernel
  /-- the exact-loop firewall -/
  | exactLoopFirewall
  /-- the positive finite-kernel wrapper -/
  | positiveFiniteKernelWrapper
  /-- the bounded-conductor `k = 1` analytic target -/
  | boundedConductorK1Target
  /-- the fixed-conductor character/DFT bound -/
  | fixedConductorCharacterBound
  /-- the rank-three operator algebra -/
  | rankThreeOperatorAlgebra
  /-- the primitive projection interfaces -/
  | rankThreeProjection
  /-- the numeric rank-three owner closures -/
  | rankThreeNumericOwners
  /-- the conductor/complement ledger architecture -/
  | conductorComplementLedger
  /-- the annihilator-family mechanism -/
  | annihilatorFamily
  /-- the finite census of certified annihilator pairs -/
  | annihilatorCensus
  /-- rank three as a whole -/
  | rankThreeSlab
  /-- `Ω(k) = 2` -/
  | omegaTwo
  /-- `Ω(k) = 1` -/
  | omegaOne
  /-- the EARLY_4490 reduction leaf -/
  | early4490Leaf
  /-- proper gamma -/
  | properGamma
  /-- `S_live` -/
  | sLive
  /-- `R_012` -/
  | r012
  /-- the signed floor -/
  | signedFloor
  /-- Maynard-type input -/
  | maynard
  /-- the final splice -/
  | finalSplice
  /-- the effectivity leaf as a whole -/
  | effectivityLeaf
  /-- provenance of a public problem identifier -/
  | publicProblemIdProvenance
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The evidence class of each tracked node at the current checkpoint. -/
def boundedConductorEvidence : BoundedConductorNode → EvidenceCurrent
  | .early4490BankAncestor => .certificateBacked
  | .early4490AsCurrentRoot => .superseded
  | .compensatedMeasure => .kernelProved
  | .oddConvolutionIdentity => .kernelProved
  | .hyperbolaInterfaces => .kernelProved
  | .compensatedSummationByParts => .kernelProved
  | .adjacentInterfaceIdentity => .kernelProved
  | .adjacentShellOnlyRoute => .retiredNonclosing
  | .residueClassCollapse => .kernelProved
  | .topDiagonalAbsent => .kernelProved
  | .truncatedShiftSieve => .kernelProved
  | .internalProductFibre => .kernelProved
  | .internalEllFirewall => .kernelProved
  | .smallEllLocalFormula => .kernelProved
  | .crtExpansion => .kernelProved
  | .crtAtomBound => .kernelProved
  | .halfOpenProgressionCompiler => .kernelProved
  | .smallEllLocalMean => .kernelProved
  | .completePeriodCovariance => .kernelProved
  | .densityCompensationIdentity => .kernelProved
  | .loopCancellationSmallEll => .kernelProved
  | .returnedFiniteConductorKernel => .openNode
  | .exactLoopFirewall => .kernelProved
  | .positiveFiniteKernelWrapper => .retiredNonclosing
  | .boundedConductorK1Target => .openNode
  | .fixedConductorCharacterBound => .openNode
  | .rankThreeOperatorAlgebra => .kernelProved
  | .rankThreeProjection => .kernelProved
  | .rankThreeNumericOwners => .certificateBacked
  | .conductorComplementLedger => .kernelProved
  | .annihilatorFamily => .kernelProved
  | .annihilatorCensus => .certificateBacked
  | .rankThreeSlab => .openNode
  | .omegaTwo => .openNode
  | .omegaOne => .openNode
  | .early4490Leaf => .openNode
  | .properGamma => .openNode
  | .sLive => .openNode
  | .r012 => .openNode
  | .signedFloor => .openNode
  | .maynard => .notEntered
  | .finalSplice => .openNode
  | .effectivityLeaf => .openNode
  | .publicProblemIdProvenance => .openNode

/-- The nodes that must remain unclosed after this run. -/
def boundedConductorOpenNodes : List BoundedConductorNode :=
  [.returnedFiniteConductorKernel, .boundedConductorK1Target, .fixedConductorCharacterBound,
   .rankThreeSlab, .omegaTwo, .omegaOne, .early4490Leaf, .properGamma, .sLive, .r012,
   .signedFloor, .maynard, .finalSplice, .effectivityLeaf, .publicProblemIdProvenance,
   .adjacentShellOnlyRoute, .positiveFiniteKernelWrapper, .early4490AsCurrentRoot]

/-- **`boundedConductor_open_frontier`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  No node of the current open
frontier is tagged `kernelProved` or `certificateBacked`; in particular none is closed.
The public-problem-id provenance is recorded as unresolved and Maynard as `NOT_ENTERED`. -/
theorem boundedConductor_open_frontier :
    (∀ n ∈ boundedConductorOpenNodes,
        boundedConductorEvidence n ≠ EvidenceCurrent.kernelProved ∧
          boundedConductorEvidence n ≠ EvidenceCurrent.certificateBacked ∧
          (boundedConductorEvidence n).isClosed = false) ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .maynard = EvidenceCurrent.notEntered ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .publicProblemIdProvenance = EvidenceCurrent.openNode ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .effectivityLeaf = EvidenceCurrent.openNode := by
  refine ⟨by decide, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- **`early4490_preserved_as_ancestor`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The EARLY_4490 bank is preserved:
it keeps its certificate-backed status as an ancestor, while only its role as *current root
coordinate* is `SUPERSEDED`. -/
theorem early4490_preserved_as_ancestor :
    boundedConductorEvidence .early4490BankAncestor = EvidenceCurrent.certificateBacked ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .early4490AsCurrentRoot = EvidenceCurrent.superseded ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .early4490Leaf = EvidenceCurrent.openNode :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- **`current_k1_frontier_is_bounded_conductor`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED` bookkeeping: the current
`k = 1` frontier is the bounded-conductor signed outer-`z` estimate, the `ℓ ≤ 1000` layer is
kernel-cancelled, and the `1000 < ℓ ≤ 5000` layer is the open node. -/
theorem current_k1_frontier_is_bounded_conductor :
    boundedConductorEvidence .loopCancellationSmallEll = EvidenceCurrent.kernelProved ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .returnedFiniteConductorKernel = EvidenceCurrent.openNode ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .exactLoopFirewall = EvidenceCurrent.kernelProved ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .positiveFiniteKernelWrapper =
        EvidenceCurrent.retiredNonclosing :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-! ## §23.4  Rank-three owner data (§22), tagged by checkpoint -/

/-- A snapshot of the rank-three owner bookkeeping.  This is **data**, tagged by a
checkpoint; no whole-slab analytic inequality is kernel-promoted. -/
structure RankThreeSnapshot where
  /-- the checkpoint this snapshot belongs to -/
  checkpoint : Checkpoint
  /-- the `k`-owners closed by certificate at this checkpoint -/
  closedOwners : List ℕ
  /-- the `k`-owners still remaining at this checkpoint -/
  remainingOwners : List ℕ
  /-- the evidence tag carried by the closed list -/
  evidence : EvidenceCurrent
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The current rank-three snapshot.  The closed list is `CERTIFICATE_BACKED`. -/
def rankThreeSnapshot : RankThreeSnapshot where
  checkpoint := boundedConductorCheckpoint
  closedOwners := [105, 165, 195, 231, 255, 273, 285, 345, 357, 385]
  remainingOwners := [15015, 5005, 3003, 2145, 1365, 1155]
  evidence := EvidenceCurrent.certificateBacked

/-- **`rankThree_snapshot_is_certificate_backed`.**  The rank-three owner lists are carried as
certificate-backed data at a tagged checkpoint, never as kernel-proved whole-slab
inequalities, and the closed and remaining lists are disjoint. -/
theorem rankThree_snapshot_is_certificate_backed :
    rankThreeSnapshot.evidence = EvidenceCurrent.certificateBacked ∧
      rankThreeSnapshot.checkpoint = boundedConductorCheckpoint ∧
      (∀ k ∈ rankThreeSnapshot.closedOwners, k ∉ rankThreeSnapshot.remainingOwners) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, by decide⟩

/-- **`rankThree_strictly_reduced`.**  Bookkeeping: rank three is strictly reduced but the slab
as a whole is still open. -/
theorem rankThree_strictly_reduced :
    rankThreeSnapshot.closedOwners ≠ [] ∧
      rankThreeSnapshot.remainingOwners ≠ [] ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .rankThreeSlab = EvidenceCurrent.openNode := by
  refine ⟨by decide, by decide, rfl⟩

/-! ## §23.5  The open frontier is not inhabited -/

/-- **`frontier_targets_not_inhabited`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The two open analytic interfaces
are recorded as open nodes; nothing in this bank inhabits them.  (Formally: the status
function tags them `openNode`; the propositions themselves appear only as hypotheses of the
conditional theorem `character_bound_implies_k1_owner_bound`.) -/
theorem frontier_targets_not_inhabited :
    boundedConductorEvidence .boundedConductorK1Target = EvidenceCurrent.openNode ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .fixedConductorCharacterBound = EvidenceCurrent.openNode :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-! ## §23.6  Axiom audit (§26) -/

section AxiomAudit

#print axioms compensated_summation_by_parts
#print axioms residue_class_collapse
#print axioms top_diagonal_absent
#print axioms internal_product_fibre_identity
#print axioms Kell_crt_expansion
#print axioms crt_atoms_le_65
#print axioms smallEll_local_mean
#print axioms gram_quadratic_form
#print axioms loop_cancellation_le_1000
#print axioms reassembly_exact_loop
#print axioms returnedKernel_not_identically_zero
#print axioms character_bound_implies_k1_owner_bound
#print axioms DeltaOp_discrepancy_identity
#print axioms rankThree_extremum_finitely_many_cells
#print axioms owner_sources_pairwise_disjoint
#print axioms certified_pair_annihilates
#print axioms Ttilde_split
#print axioms DX_term_not_removable
#print axioms boundedConductor_open_frontier

end AxiomAudit

end Effectivity
end Erdos287

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 effectivity — status after the EARLY_4490 rational-jet run (§49)

This file **extends** `CurrentStatusEffectivity`, `CurrentStatusEffectivityLongFibre` and
`CurrentStatusEffectivityMultiplicity`.  Nothing earlier is rewritten: the long-fibre bank and
the proper-γ multiplicity bank remain trusted at their declared scope, and their theorem
statements are untouched.

```
LONG-FIBRE:                        BANKED / HISTORICAL
PROPER-GAMMA MULTIPLICITY LAYER:   BANKED
q ≤ 200:                           CERTIFICATE-BACKED CLOSED
N = 1:                             CERTIFICATE-BACKED CLOSED
```

The live frontier coordinate is `EARLY_4490_RATIONAL_JET`.
`early4490RationalJet_open_frontier` proves that no open node of that frontier is tagged
closed, and no open proposition anywhere in this layer is inhabited.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287
namespace Effectivity

/-! ## §49.1  Retired-method statuses -/

/-- Statuses for methods that are no longer part of the live chart. -/
inductive MethodStatus
  | superseded
  | rejectedFalse
  | renamedWall
  | methodNonclosing
  | stillOpen
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The retired / renamed methods of the current run. -/
inductive RetiredMethod
  | reciprocalIntegralControl
  | pointwiseSmallFourierRemainder
  | coefficientOnlyR1C2Merge
  | positiveWholeEarlySlabWrapper
  | signedNearResonantAggregate
  | selectedPerron
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The recorded status of each retired / renamed method. -/
def retiredStatus : RetiredMethod → MethodStatus
  | .reciprocalIntegralControl => .superseded
  | .pointwiseSmallFourierRemainder => .rejectedFalse
  | .coefficientOnlyR1C2Merge => .renamedWall
  | .positiveWholeEarlySlabWrapper => .methodNonclosing
  | .signedNearResonantAggregate => .stillOpen
  | .selectedPerron => .stillOpen

/-- **`retired_method_firewalls`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The recorded statuses.  No universal
impossibility theorem is encoded: these are bookkeeping tags for the current chart only. -/
theorem retired_method_firewalls :
    retiredStatus .reciprocalIntegralControl = MethodStatus.superseded ∧
      retiredStatus .pointwiseSmallFourierRemainder = MethodStatus.rejectedFalse ∧
      retiredStatus .coefficientOnlyR1C2Merge = MethodStatus.renamedWall ∧
      retiredStatus .positiveWholeEarlySlabWrapper = MethodStatus.methodNonclosing ∧
      retiredStatus .signedNearResonantAggregate = MethodStatus.stillOpen ∧
      retiredStatus .selectedPerron = MethodStatus.stillOpen :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-! ## §49.2  The tracked nodes of the EARLY_4490 frontier -/

/-- The nodes tracked after the EARLY_4490 rational-jet run. -/
inductive Early4490Node
  | longFibreBankHistorical
  | properGammaMultiplicityBank
  | q200Closure
  | n1Closure
  | n2to5Closure
  | shellSixChildClosure

/-!
# Erdős #287 effectivity — status after the frontier audit (§63)

INTERNAL #287 EFFECTIVITY PROGRAMME ONLY.
**No public Erdős problem number is claimed here; public-problem-id provenance is `PENDING`.**

This module **extends** `CurrentStatusEffectivityBoundedConductor`.  Nothing earlier is
rewritten or deleted; the whole historical bank (EARLY_4490, long-fibre, multiplicity,
bounded-conductor) is preserved, and every ancestor theorem keeps its statement.

What changed at this checkpoint is the status of two *targets* — not of any proved theorem:

```
FixedConductorCharacterBound (unnormalised) : REFUTED  (fixedConductorCharacterBound_unsatisfiable)
FixedConductorCharacterMeanBound (normalised): REFUTED (characterMeanBound_unsatisfiable)
BoundedConductorK1Target (pointwise)        : REFUTED  (boundedConductorK1Target_unsatisfiable)
CentredBoundedConductorK1Target             : OPEN — new live k = 1 coordinate
```

The obstruction is a *density* obstruction, not a cancellation failure: the returned
finite-conductor kernel has aggregate complete-period mean

    meanSum = ∑_{1000 < ℓ ≤ 5000} meanK ℓ ≠ 0     (`meanSum_ne_zero`, 4999-adic valuation −1)

so over `n` full periods it equals `P·n·meanSum`, which is unbounded.  Subtracting the exact
density term gives the replacement target `CentredBoundedConductorK1Target`, on which the
long-window witness vanishes identically (`centred_kernel_vanishes_on_full_periods`).  This
matches the already-banked firewall `DX_term_not_removable`.

All other open owners are unchanged: `Ω(k) = 2`, `Ω(k) = 1`, EARLY_4490 residual, proper
gamma, `S_live`, `R_012`, signed floor, final splice, and Erdős #287 itself.

The finite side of the bank is recorded here too: the kernel-verified finite exclusion
currently reaches `M ≤ 67108856338751594` (`no_Erdos287Counterexample_of_max_le_extendedCeiling`).
A `10^60` ceiling is **not** present in this repository, and the `U2` certified-factor
extension is **pending** (its inputs are not supplied here); both facts are recorded below as
data, and `finite_ceiling_below_ten_pow_sixty` proves the recorded ceiling is strictly below
`10^60`, so no `10^60` claim is implied.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace Erdos287
namespace Effectivity

/-! ## §63.1  Checkpoint -/

/-- The checkpoint of the frontier audit. -/
def frontierAuditCheckpoint : Checkpoint :=
  { date := "2026-09-10", version := "FRONTIER_AUDIT_v1" }

/-- **`frontierAudit_checkpoint_tag`.** -/
theorem frontierAudit_checkpoint_tag :
    frontierAuditCheckpoint.date = "2026-09-10" ∧
      frontierAuditCheckpoint.version = "FRONTIER_AUDIT_v1" :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-! ## §63.2  The audited nodes -/

/-- The nodes whose status this audit determines. -/
inductive FrontierAuditNode
  /-- the unnormalised fixed-conductor character interface -/
  | characterBoundUnnormalised
  /-- the normalised (mean) character interface -/
  | characterBoundNormalised
  /-- the pointwise bounded-conductor `k = 1` target -/
  | boundedConductorK1Target

  | longWindowPeriodLaw
  /-- non-vanishing of the aggregate complete-period mean -/
  | aggregateMeanNonzero
  /-- the density-centred replacement target, qualitatively -/
  | centredK1TargetQualitative
  /-- a *quantitative* ledger-admissible budget for the centred target -/
  | centredK1TargetQuantitative
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Evidence class of each audited node at this checkpoint. -/
def frontierAuditEvidence : FrontierAuditNode → EvidenceCurrent
  | .characterBoundUnnormalised => .falseClaim
  | .characterBoundNormalised => .falseClaim
  | .boundedConductorK1Target => .falseClaim
  | .longWindowPeriodLaw => .kernelProved
  | .aggregateMeanNonzero => .kernelProved
  | .centredK1TargetQualitative => .kernelProved
  | .centredK1TargetQuantitative => .openNode

/-- **`frontierAudit_refutations_are_backed`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  Every node tagged
`falseClaim` is backed by an actual refutation, for every budget. -/
theorem frontierAudit_refutations_are_backed (b : ℚ) :
    (frontierAuditEvidence .characterBoundUnnormalised = EvidenceCurrent.falseClaim ∧
        ¬ FixedConductorCharacterBound b) ∧
      (frontierAuditEvidence .characterBoundNormalised = EvidenceCurrent.falseClaim ∧
        ¬ FixedConductorCharacterMeanBound b) ∧
      (frontierAuditEvidence .boundedConductorK1Target = EvidenceCurrent.falseClaim ∧
        ¬ BoundedConductorK1Target b) :=
  ⟨⟨rfl, fixedConductorCharacterBound_unsatisfiable b⟩,
    ⟨rfl, characterMeanBound_unsatisfiable b⟩,
    ⟨rfl, boundedConductorK1Target_unsatisfiable b⟩⟩

/-- The audited nodes that remain open. -/
def frontierAuditOpenNodes : List FrontierAuditNode := [.centredK1TargetQuantitative]

/-- **`centred_target_qualitatively_settled`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  Some budget always works
for the centred target, so qualitative boundedness carries no analytic content; the
quantitative budget question is the node that stays open. -/
theorem centred_target_qualitatively_settled :
    (∃ b : ℚ, CentredBoundedConductorK1Target b) ∧
      frontierAuditEvidence .centredK1TargetQuantitative = EvidenceCurrent.openNode :=
  ⟨centred_target_exists_budget, rfl⟩

/-- **`frontierAudit_open_frontier`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  No open node is tagged closed, and
no refuted node is tagged closed either. -/
theorem frontierAudit_open_frontier :
    (∀ n ∈ frontierAuditOpenNodes, (frontierAuditEvidence n).isClosed = false) ∧
      (frontierAuditEvidence .characterBoundUnnormalised).isClosed = false ∧
      (frontierAuditEvidence .characterBoundNormalised).isClosed = false ∧
      (frontierAuditEvidence .boundedConductorK1Target).isClosed = false := by
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  intro n hn
  fin_cases hn
  rfl

/-- **`early4490_and_bank_preserved`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  This audit changes the status of
*targets* only: the ancestor banks keep their evidence classes. -/
theorem early4490_and_bank_preserved :
    boundedConductorEvidence .early4490BankAncestor = EvidenceCurrent.certificateBacked ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .smallEllLocalMean = EvidenceCurrent.kernelProved ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .crtAtomBound = EvidenceCurrent.kernelProved ∧
      boundedConductorEvidence .loopCancellationSmallEll = EvidenceCurrent.kernelProved :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-! ## §63.3  The finite side of the bank -/

/-- Status of a finite-range exclusion claim. -/
inductive FiniteStatus
  /-- verified in the Lean kernel in this repository -/
  | kernelProved
  /-- not present in this repository -/
  | notPresent
  /-- announced but with inputs not supplied here -/
  | pending
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Recorded status of the three finite ceilings discussed in the programme. -/
def finiteStatus : ℕ → FiniteStatus
  | 0 => .kernelProved  -- `M ≤ 67108856338751594`
  | 1 => .notPresent    -- `M ≤ 10^60`
  | _ => .pending       -- the `U2` certified-factor extension

/-- **`finite_bank_status_recorded`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED` bookkeeping. -/
theorem finite_bank_status_recorded :
    finiteStatus 0 = FiniteStatus.kernelProved ∧ finiteStatus 1 = FiniteStatus.notPresent ∧
      finiteStatus 2 = FiniteStatus.pending :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- **`finite_ceiling_kernel_proved`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The finite exclusion actually
available in this repository, restated at this checkpoint. -/
theorem finite_ceiling_kernel_proved {A : Finset ℕ} (h : Erdos287Counterexample A)
    (hM : A.max' h.nonempty ≤ extendedCeiling) : False :=
  no_Erdos287Counterexample_of_max_le_extendedCeiling' h hM

/-- **`finite_ceiling_below_ten_pow_sixty`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The available ceiling is far
below `10^60`: no `10^60` finite result is claimed by this bank. -/
theorem finite_ceiling_below_ten_pow_sixty : extendedCeiling < 10 ^ 60 := by
  rw [extendedCeiling]
  norm_num

/-!

This file **extends** `CurrentStatusEffectivity` and `CurrentStatusEffectivityLongFibre`; the
long-fibre bank is preserved unchanged and remains trusted at its declared scope, but it is no
longer the live frontier coordinate.

```
LONG-FIBRE:                       HISTORICAL / BANKED
H transition family:              CLOSED AT DECLARED CERTIFICATE SCOPE
P transition family:              CLOSED AT DECLARED CERTIFICATE SCOPE
gamma self-modulus ell = d:       CLOSED AT DECLARED CERTIFICATE SCOPE
proper gamma q ≤ 200:             CLOSED AT DECLARED CERTIFICATE SCOPE
proper gamma N = 1:               CLOSED AT DECLARED CERTIFICATE SCOPE
proper gamma N = 2..5:            CLOSED AT DECLARED CERTIFICATE SCOPE
proper gamma N = 6:               CLOSED AT DECLARED CERTIFICATE SCOPE
proper gamma N ≥ 7:               OPEN
proper gamma (ell > d):           STRICTLY REDUCED / OPEN
S_live:                           OPEN
R_012:                            OPEN
signed floor:                     OPEN
Maynard:                          NOT ENTERED
final splice:                     OPEN
ERDŐS #287:                       OPEN
```

The evidence taxonomy distinguishes `KERNEL_PROVED`, `CERTIFICATE_BACKED`,
`CONDITIONAL_ANALYTIC`, `RETIRED_NONCLOSING_METHOD`, `OPEN` and `NOT_ENTERED`; the theorem
`properGammaMultiplicity_open_frontier` proves that no open node is tagged as closed.

set_option autoImplicit false

  | .retiredNonclosingMethod => false

is the recombined parent survivor `N ≥ 6`. -/

/-- **`numerical_closures_are_certificates`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The four numerical shell
closures are `CERTIFICATE_BACKED`, never `KERNEL_PROVED`. -/
theorem numerical_closures_are_certificates :

      multiplicityEvidence .properGammaN1Closure = Evidence.certificateBacked ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .properGammaN2to5Closure = Evidence.certificateBacked ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .properGammaN6Closure = Evidence.certificateBacked ∧

  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, by decide⟩

kernel content. -/
theorem exact_algebra_is_kernel_proved :
    multiplicityEvidence .qFibreAlgebra = Evidence.kernelProved ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .laneRecombination = Evidence.kernelProved ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .multiplicityBandGeometry = Evidence.kernelProved ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .shellSixGeometry = Evidence.kernelProved ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .productChangeOfVariables = Evidence.kernelProved ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .lowerCutoffFirewall = Evidence.kernelProved ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .truncatedDivisorIdentity = Evidence.kernelProved ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .ownershipArithmetic = Evidence.kernelProved ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .parentChildNoDoubleCharge = Evidence.kernelProved :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- **`retired_nonclosing_methods`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The absolute Stieltjes-variation
extension into the complete many-multiple `t → 0` tail is recorded as a retired, nonclosing
method at the current wrapper scope — no lower bound for the physical signed source is
asserted anywhere.  The weighted `K_s` closing recurrence is open (only the exact count
identity is banked). -/
theorem retired_nonclosing_methods :
    multiplicityEvidence .absoluteVariationTail = Evidence.retiredNonclosingMethod ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .weightedKsRecurrence = Evidence.openNode := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-- **`identity_factory_status`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The general identity landing is a legal
external input (conditional), while the closing prefix bound is open. -/
theorem identity_factory_status :
    multiplicityEvidence .identityFactoryLanding = Evidence.conditionalAnalytic ∧
      multiplicityEvidence .closingPrefixBound = Evidence.openNode := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-- **`longFibre_preserved`.**  `KERNEL-PROVED`.  The long-fibre bank is preserved: its own
status ledger still records Erdős #287 as open, and its numerical ledger values are
unchanged. -/
theorem longFibre_preserved :

      certifiedSubtotalV1000 = 5257263872 / 10 ^ 16 ∧
