import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V25 §3.3–3.4: conditioned residue energy (finite-group projection)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

All statements allow ARBITRARY complex residue masses `z_r`.  `‖w‖²` is written
`Complex.normSq w`.

**LEAN BANK.**

* `fibre_pythagoras` — abstract projection identity.  For a finite set of residues `R`, a
  fibre map `π : R → U` all of whose fibres have the same cardinality `k`, arbitrary masses `z`
  and an arbitrary centre `c` (e.g. the full average), with `D_r = z_r − c` and conditioned
  discrepancy `E_r = z_r − (1/k) Σ_{π s = π r} z_s`:

      Σ_r |E_r|² = Σ_r |D_r|² − (1/k) Σ_u |Σ_{π r = u} D_r|².

* `conditioned_energy_le` — hence conditioned energy ≤ full-modulus energy.
* `overlap_fibre_card` / `overlap_pythagoras` — the general overlapping-modulus instance: `R` is
  `(ℤ/m)^×` with `m` any multiple of `f` (e.g. `m = lcm(f,q)`), `π` the reduction to `(ℤ/f)^×`;
  every fibre (the compatible fibre `A_u`) has the same size `k` with `k · φ(f) = φ(m)`.
* `product_pythagoras` / `coprime_conditioned_energy_le` — the coprime instance on
  `(ℤ/f)^× × (ℤ/q)^×` (`g = 1`, `k = φ(q)`).
* `localized_discrepancy_eq` — for `α_u(n) = α(n) 1_{n ≡ u (f)}`, the literal localized
  discrepancy `Δ_{α_u}(q,a)` equals the conditioned discrepancy `E_{u,a}` of the residue masses
  `z(u,a) = Σ_{n ≡ u (f), n ≡ a (q)} α(n)`.
* `full_discrepancy_eq` — the literal full-modulus discrepancy `Δ_α(fq, r)` equals `D_{CRT(r)}`.
* **`localized_energy_le_full`** — `Σ_u Σ_a |Δ_{α_u}(q,a)|² ≤ Σ_r |Δ_α(fq,r)|²`.
* `divisor_reindexing` — `Σ_{q≤U} τ(q)^J S(q) ≤ Σ_{ℓ≤fU} τ(ℓ)^J T(ℓ)` whenever
  `S(q) ≤ T(fq)` and `T ≥ 0` (using `τ(q) ≤ τ(fq)`).

**Semantic firewall.**  `α_u` is NOT asserted to be globally Siegel–Walfisz anywhere; only the
full-modulus energy of `α` is ever consumed.  The final BDH saving for that energy is the
EXTERNAL PROVIDER `BDHEnergyProvider` of `LocalizationContract.lean`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV25
namespace FixedResidueEnergy

open Finset Complex

section Abstract

variable {R U : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype U] [DecidableEq U]

/-- One fibre: `Σ_{r∈s} |D_r − S/k|² = Σ_{r∈s} |D_r|² − |S|²/k` for `S = Σ_{r∈s} D_r`,
`k = #s`. -/
theorem fibre_one {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → ℂ) :
    ∑ r ∈ s, normSq (D r - (∑ t ∈ s, D t) / (s.card : ℂ)) =
      ∑ r ∈ s, normSq (D r) - normSq (∑ t ∈ s, D t) / (s.card : ℝ) := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos s.card with h0 | hpos
  · rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.1 h0]; simp
  set S := ∑ t ∈ s, D t
  set k : ℝ := (s.card : ℝ)
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < k := by simp only [k]; exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hkc : ((s.card : ℂ)) = (k : ℂ) := by simp [k]
  simp_rw [normSq_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hre : ∑ r ∈ s, 2 * (D r * (starRingEnd ℂ) (S / (s.card : ℂ))).re =
      2 * normSq S / k := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Complex.re_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul, hkc, map_div₀,
      Complex.conj_ofReal, mul_div_assoc', Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.mul_conj,
      Complex.ofReal_re]
    ring
  rw [hre, hkc, Complex.normSq_div, Complex.normSq_ofReal]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- **Abstract projection identity** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem fibre_pythagoras (π : R → U) (k : ℕ) (hk : ∀ u, (univ.filter fun r => π r = u).card = k)
    (z : R → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    ∑ r, normSq (z r - (∑ s ∈ univ.filter (fun s => π s = π r), z s) / (k : ℂ)) =
      ∑ r, normSq (z r - c) -
        (1 / (k : ℝ)) * ∑ u, normSq (∑ r ∈ univ.filter (fun r => π r = u), (z r - c)) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise univ π, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise univ π (fun r => normSq (z r - c)),
    Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
  have hcard := hk u
  have key := fibre_one (univ.filter fun r => π r = u) (fun r => z r - c)
  rw [hcard] at key
  rw [← key.trans (by ring : _ = _ - 1 / (k : ℝ) * _)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
  have hru : π r = u := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hr).2
  congr 1
  rw [hru]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with h0 | hpos
  · exfalso
    have : r ∈ univ.filter fun s => π s = u := hr
    rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.1 (hcard.trans h0)] at this
    simp at this
  · have hk0 : (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hpos.ne'
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, hcard, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    ring

/-- **Contraction: conditioned energy ≤ full energy** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem conditioned_energy_le (π : R → U) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : ∀ u, (univ.filter fun r => π r = u).card = k) (z : R → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    ∑ r, normSq (z r - (∑ s ∈ univ.filter (fun s => π s = π r), z s) / (k : ℂ)) ≤
      ∑ r, normSq (z r - c) := by
  rw [fibre_pythagoras π k hk z c]
  have : 0 ≤ (1 / (k : ℝ)) * ∑ u, normSq (∑ r ∈ univ.filter (fun r => π r = u), (z r - c)) :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => normSq_nonneg _)
  exact sub_le_self _ this

end Abstract

section Overlap

/-- **Overlapping moduli: all compatible fibres have the same size** (LEAN BANK).  For `f ∣ m`
(e.g. `m = lcm(f,q)`) the reduction `(ℤ/m)^× → (ℤ/f)^×` is surjective, so all fibres have the
common size `k` of the kernel, and `k · φ(f) = φ(m)`. -/
theorem overlap_fibre_card {f m : ℕ} [NeZero f] [NeZero m] (hfm : f ∣ m) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, (∀ u : (ZMod f)ˣ,
      (univ.filter fun r : (ZMod m)ˣ => ZMod.unitsMap hfm r = u).card = k) ∧
      k * f.totient = m.totient := by
  have hsurj := ZMod.unitsMap_surjective (n := f) (m := m) hfm
  refine ⟨(univ.filter fun r : (ZMod m)ˣ => ZMod.unitsMap hfm r = 1).card, fun u => ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact MonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range (ZMod.unitsMap hfm) (hsurj u) (hsurj 1)
  · have h1 := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := (univ : Finset (ZMod m)ˣ))
      (t := (univ : Finset (ZMod f)ˣ)) (f := ZMod.unitsMap hfm) (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_coe.2 (mem_univ _))
    have h2 : ∀ u : (ZMod f)ˣ, (univ.filter fun r : (ZMod m)ˣ => ZMod.unitsMap hfm r = u).card =
        (univ.filter fun r : (ZMod m)ˣ => ZMod.unitsMap hfm r = 1).card := fun u =>
      MonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range (ZMod.unitsMap hfm) (hsurj u) (hsurj 1)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => h2 u, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, smul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient] at h1
    rw [h1, mul_comm]

/-- **Overlapping-modulus Pythagorean identity** (LEAN BANK): arbitrary complex masses on
`(ℤ/m)^×`, conditioned on the residue modulo `f`. -/
theorem overlap_pythagoras {f m : ℕ} [NeZero f] [NeZero m] (hfm : f ∣ m) (z : (ZMod m)ˣ → ℂ)
    (c : ℂ) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, k * f.totient = m.totient ∧
      ∑ r, normSq (z r - (∑ s ∈ univ.filter
          (fun s => ZMod.unitsMap hfm s = ZMod.unitsMap hfm r), z s) / (k : ℂ)) =
        ∑ r, normSq (z r - c) - (1 / (k : ℝ)) *
          ∑ u, normSq (∑ r ∈ univ.filter (fun r => ZMod.unitsMap hfm r = u), (z r - c)) := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkm⟩ := overlap_fibre_card hfm
  exact ⟨k, hkm, fibre_pythagoras _ k hk z c⟩

end Overlap

section Product

variable {U A : Type*} [Fintype U] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq U]

theorem prod_fibre_card (u : U) :
    (univ.filter fun r : U × A => r.1 = u).card = Fintype.card A := by
  rw [show (univ.filter fun r : U × A => r.1 = u) = ({u} : Finset U) ×ˢ (univ : Finset A) by
    ext ⟨a, b⟩; simp [eq_comm]]
  simp

theorem prod_fibre_sum (z : U × A → ℂ) (u : U) :
    ∑ s ∈ univ.filter (fun s : U × A => s.1 = u), z s = ∑ b, z (u, b) := by
  rw [show (univ.filter fun r : U × A => r.1 = u) = ({u} : Finset U) ×ˢ (univ : Finset A) by
    ext ⟨a, b⟩; simp [eq_comm], Finset.sum_product]
  simp

/-- **Coprime (product) Pythagorean identity** (LEAN BANK): `k = #A` (`= φ(q)`),
`E_{u,a} = z(u,a) − (1/k) Σ_b z(u,b)`. -/
theorem product_pythagoras (z : U × A → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    ∑ u, ∑ a, normSq (z (u, a) - (∑ b, z (u, b)) / (Fintype.card A : ℂ)) =
      ∑ u, ∑ a, normSq (z (u, a) - c) -
        (1 / (Fintype.card A : ℝ)) * ∑ u, normSq (∑ a, (z (u, a) - c)) := by
  have := fibre_pythagoras (R := U × A) Prod.fst (Fintype.card A) prod_fibre_card z c
  simp only [prod_fibre_sum] at this
  rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type', ← Fintype.sum_prod_type']
  convert this using 3

/-- **Coprime contraction** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem coprime_conditioned_energy_le (z : U × A → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    ∑ u, ∑ a, normSq (z (u, a) - (∑ b, z (u, b)) / (Fintype.card A : ℂ)) ≤
      ∑ u, ∑ a, normSq (z (u, a) - c) := by
  rw [product_pythagoras]
  have : 0 ≤ (1 / (Fintype.card A : ℝ)) * ∑ u, normSq (∑ a, (z (u, a) - c)) :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => normSq_nonneg _)
  exact sub_le_self _ this

end Product

section Sequence

variable {f q : ℕ} [NeZero f] [NeZero q]

/-- `Σ_{b ∈ G_q} 1_{x = b} c = 1_{x unit} c`. -/
theorem sum_units_ite (x : ZMod q) (c : ℂ) :
    ∑ b : (ZMod q)ˣ, (if x = (b : ZMod q) then c else 0) = if IsUnit x then c else 0 := by
  by_cases hx : IsUnit x
  · obtain ⟨u0, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [if_pos ⟨u0, rfl⟩, Finset.sum_eq_single u0]
    · simp
    · intro b _ hb; rw [if_neg]; intro h; exact hb (Units.ext h.symm)
    · simp
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
    rw [if_neg]; rintro rfl; exact hx b.isUnit

omit [NeZero f] [NeZero q] in
theorem sum_units_prod_ite [Fintype (ZMod f)ˣ] [Fintype (ZMod q)ˣ] (x : ZMod f) (y : ZMod q)
    (c : ℂ) :
    ∑ p : (ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ, (if x = (p.1 : ZMod f) ∧ y = (p.2 : ZMod q) then c else 0) =
      if IsUnit x ∧ IsUnit y then c else 0 := by
  by_cases h : IsUnit x ∧ IsUnit y
  · obtain ⟨⟨u0, rfl⟩, ⟨a0, rfl⟩⟩ := h
    rw [if_pos ⟨u0.isUnit, a0.isUnit⟩, Finset.sum_eq_single (u0, a0)]
    · simp
    · rintro ⟨b1, b2⟩ _ hb
      rw [if_neg]
      rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact hb (Prod.ext (Units.ext h1.symm) (Units.ext h2.symm))
    · simp
  · rw [if_neg h]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p _ => ?_
    rw [if_neg]
    rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact h ⟨p.1.isUnit, p.2.isUnit⟩

/-- Residue masses `z(u,a) = Σ_{n ∈ Ns, n ≡ u (f), n ≡ a (q)} α(n)`. -/
noncomputable def zres (Ns : Finset ℕ) (α : ℕ → ℂ) (p : (ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Ns, if (n : ZMod f) = p.1 ∧ (n : ZMod q) = p.2 then α n else 0

/-- The localized sequence `α_u(n) = α(n) 1_{n ≡ u (f)}`. -/
noncomputable def alphaLoc (α : ℕ → ℂ) (u : (ZMod f)ˣ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if (n : ZMod f) = u then α n else 0

/-- Literal discrepancy `Δ_β(q,a) = Σ_{n ≡ a (q)} β(n) − (1/φ(q)) Σ_{(n,q)=1} β(n)`. -/
noncomputable def Disc (q : ℕ) (Ns : Finset ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℂ) (a : ZMod q) : ℂ :=
  (∑ n ∈ Ns, if (n : ZMod q) = a then β n else 0) -
    (1 / (q.totient : ℂ)) * ∑ n ∈ Ns, if Nat.Coprime n q then β n else 0

omit [NeZero f] [NeZero q] in
theorem coprime_iff_isUnit (n : ℕ) : Nat.Coprime n q ↔ IsUnit (n : ZMod q) :=
  (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime n q).symm

omit [NeZero f] in
/-- **The localized discrepancy is the conditioned discrepancy** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem localized_discrepancy_eq (Ns : Finset ℕ) (α : ℕ → ℂ) (u : (ZMod f)ˣ) (a : (ZMod q)ˣ) :
    Disc q Ns (alphaLoc α u) a =
      zres Ns α (u, a) - (∑ b : (ZMod q)ˣ, zres Ns α (u, b)) / (Fintype.card (ZMod q)ˣ : ℂ) := by
  unfold Disc zres alphaLoc
  rw [ZMod.card_units_eq_totient]
  have h1 : (∑ n ∈ Ns, if (n : ZMod q) = a then (if (n : ZMod f) = u then α n else 0) else 0) =
      ∑ n ∈ Ns, if (n : ZMod f) = (u, a).1 ∧ (n : ZMod q) = (u, a).2 then α n else 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    by_cases h1 : (n : ZMod f) = u <;> by_cases h2 : (n : ZMod q) = a <;> simp [h1, h2]
  have h2 : (∑ n ∈ Ns, if Nat.Coprime n q then (if (n : ZMod f) = u then α n else 0) else 0) =
      ∑ b : (ZMod q)ˣ, ∑ n ∈ Ns,
        if (n : ZMod f) = (u, b).1 ∧ (n : ZMod q) = (u, b).2 then α n else 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    simp only [coprime_iff_isUnit]
    by_cases h1 : (n : ZMod f) = u
    · simp only [h1, true_and, if_true]
      rw [sum_units_ite]
    · simp [h1]
  rw [h1, h2]
  ring

variable (hfq : Nat.Coprime f q)

instance : NeZero (f * q) := ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero (NeZero.ne f) (NeZero.ne q)⟩

/-- The CRT isomorphism on units `(ℤ/fq)^× ≃ (ℤ/f)^× × (ℤ/q)^×`. -/
noncomputable def crtUnits : (ZMod (f * q))ˣ ≃* (ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ :=
  (Units.mapEquiv (ZMod.chineseRemainder hfq).toMulEquiv).trans MulEquiv.prodUnits

omit [NeZero f] [NeZero q] in
theorem crtUnits_val (r : (ZMod (f * q))ˣ) :
    (((crtUnits hfq r).1 : ZMod f), ((crtUnits hfq r).2 : ZMod q)) =
      ZMod.chineseRemainder hfq (r : ZMod (f * q)) := by
  rfl

omit [NeZero f] [NeZero q] in
theorem natCast_eq_iff (n : ℕ) (r : (ZMod (f * q))ˣ) :
    (n : ZMod (f * q)) = r ↔
      (n : ZMod f) = (crtUnits hfq r).1 ∧ (n : ZMod q) = (crtUnits hfq r).2 := by
  rw [← Prod.mk.injEq, crtUnits_val]
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [← h, map_natCast]; rfl
  · intro h
    apply (ZMod.chineseRemainder hfq).injective
    rw [← h, map_natCast]; rfl

/-- **The full-modulus discrepancy is `D` at the CRT pair** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem full_discrepancy_eq (Ns : Finset ℕ) (α : ℕ → ℂ) (r : (ZMod (f * q))ˣ) :
    Disc (f * q) Ns α r =
      zres Ns α (crtUnits hfq r) -
        (∑ p : (ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ, zres Ns α p) / (Fintype.card ((ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ) : ℂ) := by
  unfold Disc zres
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient,
    ← Nat.totient_mul hfq]
  have h1 : (∑ n ∈ Ns, if (n : ZMod (f * q)) = r then α n else 0) =
      ∑ n ∈ Ns, if (n : ZMod f) = (crtUnits hfq r).1 ∧ (n : ZMod q) = (crtUnits hfq r).2
        then α n else 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    simp only [natCast_eq_iff hfq]
  have h2 : (∑ n ∈ Ns, if Nat.Coprime n (f * q) then α n else 0) =
      ∑ p : (ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ, ∑ n ∈ Ns,
        if (n : ZMod f) = p.1 ∧ (n : ZMod q) = p.2 then α n else 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    simp only [Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right, coprime_iff_isUnit (q := f),
      coprime_iff_isUnit (q := q)]
    rw [sum_units_prod_ite]
  rw [h1, h2]
  ring

include hfq in
/-- **Localized energy ≤ full-modulus energy** (LEAN BANK):

    Σ_{u ∈ G_f} Σ_{a ∈ G_q} |Δ_{α_u}(q,a)|² ≤ Σ_{r ∈ G_{fq}} |Δ_α(fq,r)|². -/
theorem localized_energy_le_full (Ns : Finset ℕ) (α : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ∑ u : (ZMod f)ˣ, ∑ a : (ZMod q)ˣ, normSq (Disc q Ns (alphaLoc α u) a) ≤
      ∑ r : (ZMod (f * q))ˣ, normSq (Disc (f * q) Ns α r) := by
  simp_rw [localized_discrepancy_eq, full_discrepancy_eq hfq]
  set C : ℂ := (∑ p : (ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ, zres Ns α p) /
    (Fintype.card ((ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ) : ℂ)
  have hR : ∑ r : (ZMod (f * q))ˣ, normSq (zres Ns α (crtUnits hfq r) - C) =
      ∑ p : (ZMod f)ˣ × (ZMod q)ˣ, normSq (zres Ns α p - C) :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv (crtUnits hfq).toEquiv _ _ (fun r => rfl)
  rw [hR, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  exact coprime_conditioned_energy_le (U := (ZMod f)ˣ) (A := (ZMod q)ˣ) (zres Ns α) C

end Sequence

section Reindex

/-- **Divisor-weighted reindexing** (LEAN BANK): `q ↦ fq` is injective from `[1,U]` into
`[1,fU]`, `τ(q) ≤ τ(fq)`, and the target terms are nonnegative. -/
theorem divisor_reindexing (f U J : ℕ) (hf : 0 < f) (S T : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hST : ∀ q, 1 ≤ q → S q ≤ T (f * q)) (hT : ∀ l, 0 ≤ T l) :
    ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 U, ((q.divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J * S q ≤
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (f * U), ((l.divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J * T l := by
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun q => f * q) (Finset.Icc 1 U : Set ℕ) := fun a _ b _ h =>
    Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hf h
  have hsub : (Finset.Icc 1 U).image (fun q => f * q) ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (f * U) := by
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hl
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero hf.ne' (by omega)),
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left f h2⟩
  calc ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 U, ((q.divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J * S q
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 U, (((f * q).divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J * T (f * q) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun q hq => ?_
        have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq).1
        have hdiv : q.divisors.card ≤ (f * q).divisors.card :=
          Finset.card_le_card (Nat.divisors_subset_of_dvd (Nat.mul_ne_zero hf.ne' (by omega))
            (dvd_mul_left q f))
        have hdiv' : ((q.divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J ≤ (((f * q).divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hdiv) J
        rcases le_or_gt 0 (S q) with hS | hS
        · exact mul_le_mul hdiv' (hST q hq1) hS (by positivity)
        · calc ((q.divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J * S q ≤ 0 :=
                mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by positivity) hS.le
            _ ≤ _ := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hT _)
    _ = ∑ l ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 U).image (fun q => f * q), ((l.divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J * T l :=
        (Finset.sum_image (f := fun l => ((l.divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J * T l) hinj).symm
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun l _ _ =>
        mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hT l)

end Reindex

end FixedResidueEnergy
end ResearchBankV25
end Erdos287

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V25 §3.5: good-modulus affine clearing

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Variable typing.  The prime variable is `p = A_i t + 1`.  The fixed exceptional modulus stays on
the ORIGINAL prime variable `p` (equivalently on `m₀ = m / A_j`); rational affine denominators
are cleared only on moduli coprime to the relevant fixed slopes.  No modular inverse of `A_j`
modulo `f` is ever introduced: the only inverse used is `u⁻¹` for a unit `u ∈ (ℤ/f)^×`.

**LEAN BANK.**

* `clearing_identity_j` — with `T = A_j p`:  `T − (A_j − A_i) = A_i (A_j t + 1)`;
* `clearing_identity_k` — `A_k T − A_j (A_k − A_i) = A_i A_j (A_k t + 1)`;
* `physical_divisibility_j` — `s ∣ A_j t + 1 ⟹ s ∣ T − (A_j − A_i)`;
* `physical_divisibility_prod` — `D ∣ ∏_k (A_k t + 1) ⟹ D ∣ ∏_k [A_k T − A_j (A_k − A_i)]`;
* `clearing_iff_of_coprime` — on a GOOD modulus (`gcd(s, A_i) = 1`) the clearing is reversible;
* `betaLift` / `betaLift_lattice` / `betaLift_off_lattice` — the supported-lattice map
  `m = A_j m₀`, `β'_u(m) = 1_{A_j ∣ m} β(m/A_j) 1_{m/A_j ≡ c u⁻¹ (f)}`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV25
namespace GoodModulusClearing

open Finset

/-- **Clearing identity for the `j`-th form** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem clearing_identity_j (Ai Aj t : ℤ) :
    Aj * (Ai * t + 1) - (Aj - Ai) = Ai * (Aj * t + 1) := by ring

/-- **Clearing identity for the `k`-th form** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem clearing_identity_k (Ai Aj Ak t : ℤ) :
    Ak * (Aj * (Ai * t + 1)) - Aj * (Ak - Ai) = Ai * Aj * (Ak * t + 1) := by ring

/-- **Physical divisibility, `j`-th form** (LEAN BANK): with `p = A_i t + 1`, `T = A_j p`. -/
theorem physical_divisibility_j {Ai Aj t s p T : ℤ} (hp : p = Ai * t + 1) (hT : T = Aj * p)
    (hs : s ∣ Aj * t + 1) : s ∣ T - (Aj - Ai) := by
  rw [hT, hp, clearing_identity_j]
  exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hs Ai

/-- **Physical divisibility, product over all forms** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem physical_divisibility_prod {ι : Type*} (K : Finset ι) (A : ι → ℤ) {Ai Aj t D p T : ℤ}
    (hp : p = Ai * t + 1) (hT : T = Aj * p) (hD : D ∣ ∏ k ∈ K, (A k * t + 1)) :
    D ∣ ∏ k ∈ K, (A k * T - Aj * (A k - Ai)) := by
  have : ∏ k ∈ K, (A k * T - Aj * (A k - Ai)) = (Ai * Aj) ^ K.card * ∏ k ∈ K, (A k * t + 1) := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_const, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [hT, hp, clearing_identity_k]
  rw [this]
  exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hD _

/-- **Reversibility on a good modulus** (LEAN BANK): if `gcd(s, A_i) = 1` then
`s ∣ T − (A_j − A_i) ↔ s ∣ A_j t + 1`. -/
theorem clearing_iff_of_coprime {Ai Aj t s p T : ℤ} (hp : p = Ai * t + 1) (hT : T = Aj * p)
    (hcop : IsCoprime s Ai) : s ∣ T - (Aj - Ai) ↔ s ∣ Aj * t + 1 := by
  rw [hT, hp, clearing_identity_j]
  exact ⟨fun h => hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h, fun h => Dvd.dvd.mul_left h Ai⟩

/-- **The supported-lattice lift** `β'_u(m) = 1_{A_j ∣ m} β(m/A_j) 1_{m/A_j ≡ c u⁻¹ (mod f)}`.
Only the inverse of the UNIT `u` is used; `A_j` is never inverted modulo `f`. -/
noncomputable def betaLift (Aj f : ℕ) (c : ZMod f) (u : (ZMod f)ˣ) (β : ℕ → ℂ) (m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if Aj ∣ m then (if ((m / Aj : ℕ) : ZMod f) = c * ((u⁻¹ : (ZMod f)ˣ) : ZMod f) then β (m / Aj)
    else 0) else 0

/-- On the lattice `m = A_j m₀` the lift is the original coefficient in the original variable. -/
theorem betaLift_lattice {Aj f : ℕ} (hAj : 0 < Aj) (c : ZMod f) (u : (ZMod f)ˣ) (β : ℕ → ℂ)
    (m0 : ℕ) :
    betaLift Aj f c u β (Aj * m0) =
      if (m0 : ZMod f) = c * ((u⁻¹ : (ZMod f)ˣ) : ZMod f) then β m0 else 0 := by
  unfold betaLift
  rw [if_pos (dvd_mul_right Aj m0), Nat.mul_div_cancel_left m0 hAj]

/-- Off the lattice the lift vanishes. -/
theorem betaLift_off_lattice {Aj f : ℕ} (c : ZMod f) (u : (ZMod f)ˣ) (β : ℕ → ℂ) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : ¬ Aj ∣ m) : betaLift Aj f c u β m = 0 := by
  unfold betaLift; rw [if_neg hm]

/-- The integer map `T = A_j p` lands on the supported lattice. -/
theorem integer_map_on_lattice (Aj p : ℕ) : Aj ∣ Aj * p := dvd_mul_right Aj p

end GoodModulusClearing
end ResearchBankV25
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=3140 sha256=abc108df0144ee1662b81522c1a7e6717c2081749af483fba906492fb896b24f path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV25/Ledger.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.GoodModulusClearing
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.LocalizationContract
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.Counterfixtures

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V25: ledger

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The six admissible status classes (§2 of the V25–V28 request) are the constructors of
`StatusClass`; no other status word is used.  `v25_final_status` checks the classification by
`decide`, and `v25_bank_certificate` ties the LEAN BANK rows to the actual kernel theorems.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV25
namespace Ledger

/-- The only admissible status classes. -/
inductive StatusClass
  | leanBank
  | leanConditional
  | externalProvider
  | finiteRegression
  | repairedRetired
  | openProblem
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The V25 ledger rows. -/
inductive V25Item
  | fixedModulusCentering
  | correctionTermNeeded
  | correctionSplit
  | maskedSWProvider
  | correctionAggregation
  | conditionedResidueEnergy
  | overlapFibres
  | coprimeLocalizedEnergy
  | divisorReindexing
  | locBound
  | bdhEnergyProvider
  | zeroFrequencyLocalized
  | goodModulusClearing
  | residueRestrictionSW
  | slopeUnitDestruction
  | erdos287Global
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

open StatusClass V25Item

/-- The V25 classification. -/
def status : V25Item → StatusClass
  | fixedModulusCentering => leanBank
  | correctionTermNeeded => finiteRegression
  | correctionSplit => leanBank
  | maskedSWProvider => externalProvider
  | correctionAggregation => leanConditional
  | conditionedResidueEnergy => leanBank
  | overlapFibres => leanBank
  | coprimeLocalizedEnergy => leanBank
  | divisorReindexing => leanBank
  | locBound => leanBank
  | bdhEnergyProvider => externalProvider
  | zeroFrequencyLocalized => leanConditional
  | goodModulusClearing => leanBank
  | residueRestrictionSW => repairedRetired
  | slopeUnitDestruction => repairedRetired
  | erdos287Global => openProblem

theorem v25_final_status :
    status fixedModulusCentering = leanBank ∧ status conditionedResidueEnergy = leanBank ∧
    status goodModulusClearing = leanBank ∧ status maskedSWProvider = externalProvider ∧
    status bdhEnergyProvider = externalProvider ∧
    status zeroFrequencyLocalized = leanConditional ∧
    status residueRestrictionSW = repairedRetired ∧ status slopeUnitDestruction = repairedRetired ∧
    status erdos287Global = openProblem := by decide

/-- The LEAN BANK / FINITE REGRESSION rows are backed by kernel theorems. -/
theorem v25_bank_certificate :
    ¬ FixedModulusCentering.CorrectionDeletable ∧
    (Counterfixtures.Balanced 3 (Finset.Icc 1 6) (fun _ => 1) ∧
      ¬ Counterfixtures.Balanced 3 (Finset.Icc 1 6)
        (FixedResidueEnergy.alphaLoc (f := 3) (fun _ => 1) 1)) ∧
    (∀ Ai Aj t : ℤ, Aj * (Ai * t + 1) - (Aj - Ai) = Ai * (Aj * t + 1)) :=
  ⟨FixedModulusCentering.correction_term_needed, Counterfixtures.residue_restriction_breaks_SW,
    GoodModulusClearing.clearing_identity_j⟩

end Ledger
end ResearchBankV25
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=10679 sha256=6fd427c8e7fc8c9e5d83fc254a0fe16207d725a01c16334e79ea421cda371bba path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV25/LocalizationContract.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.ExceptionalStateLocalization
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.CorrectionAggregation

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V25 §3.4 (cont.): the localization contract

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

**LEAN BANK.**

* `locE`, `fullE` — localized energy `Σ_{u,a} |Δ_{α_u}(q,a)|²` and full energy
  `Σ_r |Δ_α(ℓ,r)|²` (zero at modulus `0`);
* `locE_le_fullE` — `locE(q) ≤ fullE(fq)` for `(f,q) = 1` (from §3.3);
* `weighted_localized_le_full` — the divisor-weighted reindexing
  `Σ_{q∈Qs} τ(q)^J locE(q) ≤ Σ_{ℓ≤fU} τ(ℓ)^J fullE(ℓ)`;
* **`loc_bound`** — `|Loc| ≤ √(Σ_{q∈Qs} τ(q)^J) · √(Σ_{ℓ≤fU} τ(ℓ)^J fullE(ℓ))` (centering bridge +
  single-residue ≤ energy + Cauchy–Schwarz + energy contraction + reindexing).

**EXTERNAL PROVIDER.**

* `BDHEnergyProvider` — the Barban–Davenport–Halberstam-type saving for the FULL-modulus energy
  of the ACTUAL source `γ` (never for `γ_u`).

**LEAN CONDITIONAL.**

* **`zero_frequency_localized_bound`** — `Full = Loc + C_f` with `Loc` bounded through the BDH
  provider and `C_f` through the masked SW provider:  for every `A`, eventually
  `|Full| ≤ √(Σ τ^J) √(C₁ B/log^A x) + C₂ M N/log^A x`.

**Firewall.**  `γ_u` is never assumed globally Siegel–Walfisz; only the full-modulus energy of `γ`
enters the provider.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV25
namespace LocalizationContract

open Finset Complex FixedModulusCentering FixedResidueEnergy ExceptionalStateLocalization
open CorrectionAggregation

/-- Localized energy `Σ_{u ∈ G_f} Σ_{a ∈ G_q} |Δ_{α_u}(q,a)|²` (zero at `q = 0`). -/
noncomputable def locE (f : ℕ) [NeZero f] (Ns : Finset ℕ) (γ : ℕ → ℂ) (q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if h : q = 0 then 0 else
    haveI : NeZero q := ⟨h⟩
    ∑ u : (ZMod f)ˣ, ∑ a : (ZMod q)ˣ, normSq (Disc q Ns (alphaLoc γ u) a)

/-- Full energy `Σ_{r ∈ G_ℓ} |Δ_γ(ℓ,r)|²` (zero at `ℓ = 0`). -/
noncomputable def fullE (Ns : Finset ℕ) (γ : ℕ → ℂ) (l : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if h : l = 0 then 0 else
    haveI : NeZero l := ⟨h⟩
    ∑ r : (ZMod l)ˣ, normSq (Disc l Ns γ r)

theorem fullE_nonneg (Ns : Finset ℕ) (γ : ℕ → ℂ) (l : ℕ) : 0 ≤ fullE Ns γ l := by
  unfold fullE; split_ifs
  · exact le_refl _
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => normSq_nonneg _

theorem locE_nonneg (f : ℕ) [NeZero f] (Ns : Finset ℕ) (γ : ℕ → ℂ) (q : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ locE f Ns γ q := by
  unfold locE; split_ifs
  · exact le_refl _
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => normSq_nonneg _

/-- **Localized energy ≤ full energy at `fq`** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem locE_le_fullE {f q : ℕ} [NeZero f] (hq : q ≠ 0) (hfq : Nat.Coprime f q)
    (Ns : Finset ℕ) (γ : ℕ → ℂ) : locE f Ns γ q ≤ fullE Ns γ (f * q) := by
  haveI : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
  unfold locE fullE
  rw [dif_neg hq, dif_neg (Nat.mul_ne_zero (NeZero.ne f) hq)]
  exact localized_energy_le_full hfq Ns γ

/-- A single localized residue is bounded by the localized energy. -/
theorem single_le_locE {f q : ℕ} [NeZero f] (hq : q ≠ 0) (Ns : Finset ℕ) (γ : ℕ → ℂ)
    (u : (ZMod f)ˣ) (a : (ZMod q)ˣ) :
    normSq (Disc q Ns (alphaLoc γ u) a) ≤ locE f Ns γ q := by
  haveI : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
  unfold locE
  rw [dif_neg hq]
  calc normSq (Disc q Ns (alphaLoc γ u) a)
      ≤ ∑ a' : (ZMod q)ˣ, normSq (Disc q Ns (alphaLoc γ u) a') :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a' : (ZMod q)ˣ => normSq (Disc q Ns (alphaLoc γ u) a'))
          (fun _ _ => normSq_nonneg _) (mem_univ a)
    _ ≤ ∑ u' : (ZMod f)ˣ, ∑ a' : (ZMod q)ˣ, normSq (Disc q Ns (alphaLoc γ u') a') :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun u' : (ZMod f)ˣ =>
          ∑ a' : (ZMod q)ˣ, normSq (Disc q Ns (alphaLoc γ u') a'))
          (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => normSq_nonneg _) (mem_univ u)

/-- `τ(q)^J`. -/
noncomputable def tauJ (J q : ℕ) : ℝ := ((q.divisors.card : ℝ)) ^ J

theorem tauJ_nonneg (J q : ℕ) : 0 ≤ tauJ J q := by unfold tauJ; positivity

/-- **Divisor-weighted localized energy ≤ full energy** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem weighted_localized_le_full {f : ℕ} [NeZero f] (J U : ℕ) (Qs : Finset ℕ)
    (hQs : Qs ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 U) (hcop : ∀ q ∈ Qs, Nat.Coprime f q) (Ns : Finset ℕ)
    (γ : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ∑ q ∈ Qs, tauJ J q * locE f Ns γ q ≤
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (f * U), tauJ J l * fullE Ns γ l := by
  classical
  set S : ℕ → ℝ := fun q => if Nat.Coprime f q then locE f Ns γ q else 0
  have hS : ∀ q, 0 ≤ S q := fun q => by
    simp only [S]; split_ifs
    · exact locE_nonneg f Ns γ q
    · exact le_refl _
  calc ∑ q ∈ Qs, tauJ J q * locE f Ns γ q = ∑ q ∈ Qs, tauJ J q * S q :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => by simp only [S]; rw [if_pos (hcop q hq)]
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 U, tauJ J q * S q :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hQs fun q _ _ =>
          mul_nonneg (tauJ_nonneg J q) (hS q)
    _ ≤ ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (f * U), tauJ J l * fullE Ns γ l := by
        unfold tauJ
        refine divisor_reindexing f U J (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne f)) S (fullE Ns γ)
          (fun q hq => ?_) (fullE_nonneg Ns γ)
        simp only [S]
        split_ifs with h
        · exact locE_le_fullE (by omega) h Ns γ
        · exact fullE_nonneg Ns γ _

/-- Weighted Cauchy–Schwarz `Σ w √E ≤ √(Σ w) √(Σ w E)`. -/
theorem weighted_cauchy {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w E : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hE : ∀ i, 0 ≤ E i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, w i * Real.sqrt (E i) ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, w i) * Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ s, w i * E i) := by
  have h := Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt s (fun i => Real.sqrt (w i))
    (fun i => Real.sqrt (w i) * Real.sqrt (E i))
  have e1 : ∀ i, Real.sqrt (w i) * (Real.sqrt (w i) * Real.sqrt (E i)) = w i * Real.sqrt (E i) :=
    fun i => by rw [← mul_assoc, Real.mul_self_sqrt (hw i)]
  have e2 : ∀ i, Real.sqrt (w i) ^ 2 = w i := fun i => Real.sq_sqrt (hw i)
  have e3 : ∀ i, (Real.sqrt (w i) * Real.sqrt (E i)) ^ 2 = w i * E i := fun i => by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hw i), Real.sq_sqrt (hE i)]
  simp only [e1, e2, e3] at h
  exact h

/-- **Localized-sum bound** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem loc_bound {f : ℕ} [NeZero f] {c : ℤ} (u0 : (ZMod f)ˣ) (hcu : (c : ZMod f) = u0)
    (J U : ℕ) (Qs : Finset ℕ) (hQs : Qs ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 U) (hcop : ∀ q ∈ Qs, Nat.Coprime f q)
    (aq : ℕ → ℤ) (haq : ∀ q ∈ Qs, IsUnit ((aq q : ℤ) : ZMod q)) (κ : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hκ : ∀ q, ‖κ q‖ ≤ tauJ J q) (Ns : Finset ℕ) (γ : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ‖LocSum f c Qs κ aq Ns γ‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (∑ q ∈ Qs, tauJ J q) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (f * U), tauJ J l * fullE Ns γ l) := by
  have hq0 : ∀ q ∈ Qs, q ≠ 0 := fun q hq => by
    have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 (hQs hq)).1; omega
  have step : ∀ q ∈ Qs, ‖κ q * ∑ n ∈ Ns, γ n * ((indMod f c n * delta q (aq q) n : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
      tauJ J q * Real.sqrt (locE f Ns γ q) := by
    intro q hq
    rw [norm_mul, sum_localized_delta_eq_Disc q c (aq q) u0 hcu Ns γ]
    refine mul_le_mul (hκ q) ?_ (norm_nonneg _) (tauJ_nonneg J q)
    obtain ⟨au, hau⟩ := haq q hq
    rw [← hau, Complex.norm_def]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (single_le_locE (hq0 q hq) Ns γ u0 au)
  calc ‖LocSum f c Qs κ aq Ns γ‖
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ Qs, tauJ J q * Real.sqrt (locE f Ns γ q) :=
        (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum step)
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ q ∈ Qs, tauJ J q) * Real.sqrt (∑ q ∈ Qs, tauJ J q * locE f Ns γ q) :=
        weighted_cauchy Qs _ _ (tauJ_nonneg J) (locE_nonneg f Ns γ)
    _ ≤ _ := by
        gcongr
        exact weighted_localized_le_full J U Qs hQs hcop Ns γ

/-- **BDH-type full-modulus energy provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed): the
divisor-weighted full-modulus energy of the ACTUAL source `γ x` up to level `f · U x` saves
every power of `log x`. -/
structure BDHEnergyProvider (f J : ℕ) (Ns : ℝ → Finset ℕ) (γ : ℝ → ℕ → ℂ) (U : ℝ → ℕ)
    (Bnd : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  saving : ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0,
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (f * U x), tauJ J l * fullE (Ns x) (γ x) l ≤ C * Bnd x / Real.log x ^ A

/-- Scale-indexed zero-frequency data at the fixed exceptional state `(f, c)`. -/
structure ZeroFreqData (f : ℕ) [NeZero f] (c : ℤ) (J : ℕ) where
  u0 : (ZMod f)ˣ
  hcu : (c : ZMod f) = u0
  Qs : ℝ → Finset ℕ
  U : ℝ → ℕ
  hQs : ∀ x, Qs x ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (U x)
  hcop : ∀ x, ∀ q ∈ Qs x, Nat.Coprime f q
  aq : ℝ → ℕ → ℤ
  rq : ℝ → ℕ → ℤ
  haq : ∀ x, ∀ q ∈ Qs x, IsUnit ((aq x q : ℤ) : ZMod q)
  hrq : ∀ x, ∀ q ∈ Qs x, rq x q ≡ c [ZMOD (f : ℤ)] ∧ rq x q ≡ aq x q [ZMOD (q : ℤ)]
  κ : ℝ → ℕ → ℂ
  hκ : ∀ x q, ‖κ x q‖ ≤ tauJ J q
  Ns : ℝ → Finset ℕ
  γ : ℝ → ℕ → ℂ

/-- **Zero-frequency localized bound** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on `BDHEnergyProvider` and
`MaskedSWProvider`).  The full-modulus centred sum at the fixed exceptional modulus splits
exactly (`full_eq_loc_add_corr`); the localized part is controlled by the full-modulus energy of
the actual source, the correction by the masked SW saving. -/
theorem zero_frequency_localized_bound {f : ℕ} [NeZero f] {c : ℤ} {J : ℕ}
    (Z : ZeroFreqData f c J) {Bnd MN : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hB : BDHEnergyProvider f J Z.Ns Z.γ Z.U Bnd)
    (hM : MaskedSWProvider f c J Z.Qs Z.Ns Z.γ MN) :
    ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, ∀ x ≥ x0,
      ‖FullSum f (Z.Qs x) (Z.κ x) (Z.rq x) (Z.Ns x) (Z.γ x)‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt (∑ q ∈ Z.Qs x, tauJ J q) * Real.sqrt (C₁ * Bnd x / Real.log x ^ A) +
          C₂ * MN x / Real.log x ^ A := by
  intro A
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, x1, hx1⟩ := hB.saving A
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂, x2, hx2⟩ := correction_aggregation_conditional hM Z.κ Z.hκ A
  refine ⟨C₁, C₂, hC₁, hC₂, max x1 x2, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [full_eq_loc_add_corr (aq := Z.aq x) (Z.κ x) (Z.Ns x) (Z.γ x)
    (fun q hq => ⟨Z.hcop x q hq, Z.hrq x q hq⟩)]
  refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ (hx2 x (le_of_max_le_right hx)))
  refine (loc_bound Z.u0 Z.hcu J (Z.U x) (Z.Qs x) (Z.hQs x) (Z.hcop x) (Z.aq x) (Z.haq x) (Z.κ x)
    (Z.hκ x) (Z.Ns x) (Z.γ x)).trans ?_
  gcongr
  exact hx1 x (le_of_max_le_left hx)

end LocalizationContract
end ResearchBankV25
end Erdos287

/-!
# Erdős #287 — route-aware master research bank V5 (aggregator)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Strictly **append-only** layer.  Anchored V2, Anchored V3 and Anchored V4 are untouched: no file
of those layers is edited, renamed, weakened, moved or replaced; this layer only *imports* and
*re-exports* them.

## Route firewall

Two research routes coexist and neither supersedes the other:

* `ResearchRoute.anchoredV4` — the Anchored V2/V3/V4 formal route;
* `ResearchRoute.contactCoreV5` — the CONTACT / strict-height / `p`-adic / exceptional-leaf route.

They may share lemmas and may eventually meet, but they currently have **different open-owner
sets** and **different closure DAGs**.  A status statement about one never changes the status of
the other (`Routes.lean`, `GateLedger.lean`), and a route closure reaches the original problem
only through that route's own proved bridge (`RouteReconciliation.lean`).

## New kernel bank (this layer)

* exact path transfer `D_j p_j = C_j p₀ - R_j`, the unrolled remainder and its normalized form,
  with the `53 — 317 — 79` depth-two counterfixture retiring the direct terminal splice
  (`ContactCore/PathTransfer.lean`);
* the complete proper-power row condition (PP-ROW) and the proof that it is strictly stronger than
  the naive unit-inverse congruence; exact interval counting for valuation layers
  (`D_v ≤ 2 n_v + 5`, the `6ℓ` sparse tail and the `4ℓ` raw forced-zero port cap); the exact
  valuation lift `q d = h d₀`, `⌊⌊M/q⌋/ℓ^v⌋ = ⌊M/h⌋` (`ContactCore/ProperPowerRow.lean`);
* the layer-local digit step of `p`-adic saturation: subset sums of any `ℓ-1` nonzero residues
  cover `𝔽_ℓ`, with the heavy/sparse obstruction dichotomy
  (`ContactCore/PadicSaturation.lean`);
* the STRICT-HEIGHT contact theorem, its height form, the impossibility of same-height first-power
  cycles and the mandatory no-monotone-descent firewall, with exhaustive finite regressions
  (`ContactCore/StrictHeight.lean`);
* the contact-core Gate D bridge back to the original reciprocal-gap formulation
  (`RouteReconciliation.lean`).

## External / conditional bank

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V6: the finite per-middle-row contact target

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The contact-core route needs, for a middle row `p`, the finite contact target

`H_p(𝒞) ≤ 2 π(z) + 4 ⌊M / z²⌋`.

Section 1–3 formalize this as an **exact, sorry-free finite combinatorial inequality**: it is the
charging inequality for a contact set `H` charged to small primes (each prime absorbing at most
two contacts) and to the multiples of `z²` in the window (each absorbing at most four).  Nothing
analytic is used.

Section 4 contains the **exact balancing identity** `M / z² = z / l` at the optimizing scale
`z³ = M l`, which is the algebraic half of the asymptotic consequence.

Section 5 keeps the genuinely external part separate and uninhabited: the prime-counting
asymptotic `π(z) ≪ z / log z` and the resulting `H_p(𝒞) ≪ M^{1/3} (log M)^{-2/3}` are *not*
proved here; only the implication that consumes them is kernel-proved.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV6
namespace ContactTarget

open Finset

/-! ## 1.  Small primes and multiples of `z²` -/

/-- The primes `≤ z`. -/
def primesLE (z : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 z).filter Nat.Prime

/-- `π(z)`, the number of primes `≤ z`. -/
def piCount (z : ℕ) : ℕ := (primesLE z).card

/-- The multiples of `z²` in the window `[1, M]`. -/
def squareMultiples (M z : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun n => z ^ 2 ∣ n)

/-- There are exactly `⌊M / z²⌋` multiples of `z²` in `[1, M]`. -/
theorem squareMultiples_card (M z : ℕ) : (squareMultiples M z).card = M / z ^ 2 := by
  have h : Finset.Icc 1 M = Finset.Ioc 0 M := by
    ext n; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ioc]; omega
  rw [squareMultiples, h]
  exact Nat.Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div M (z ^ 2)

/-! ## 2.  The generic charging inequality -/

/-- **Charging inequality.**  If every member of a finite set `H` is charged to an element of
`T₁ ∪ T₂`, no element of `T₁` carrying more than `c₁` charges and no element of `T₂` carrying more
than `c₂`, then `|H| ≤ c₁ |T₁| + c₂ |T₂|`. -/
theorem card_le_of_charge {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {H : Finset α} {T₁ T₂ : Finset ℕ}
    (c₁ c₂ : ℕ) (f : α → ℕ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ H, f x ∈ T₁ ∪ T₂)
    (h₁ : ∀ t ∈ T₁, (H.filter (fun x => f x = t)).card ≤ c₁)
    (h₂ : ∀ t ∈ T₂, (H.filter (fun x => f x = t)).card ≤ c₂) :
    H.card ≤ c₁ * T₁.card + c₂ * T₂.card := by
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo f (H : Set α) ((T₁ ∪ T₂ : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro x hx
    exact_mod_cast hf x hx
  have hsplit : H.card = ∑ t ∈ T₁ ∪ T₂, (H.filter (fun x => f x = t)).card :=
    Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmaps
  have hunion : T₁ ∪ T₂ = T₁ ∪ (T₂ \ T₁) := by
    ext t; by_cases h : t ∈ T₁ <;> simp [h, Finset.mem_union]
  have hdisj : Disjoint T₁ (T₂ \ T₁) := Finset.disjoint_sdiff
  rw [hsplit, hunion, Finset.sum_union hdisj]
  have hA : ∑ t ∈ T₁, (H.filter (fun x => f x = t)).card ≤ c₁ * T₁.card := by
    calc ∑ t ∈ T₁, (H.filter (fun x => f x = t)).card ≤ ∑ _t ∈ T₁, c₁ :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum h₁
      _ = c₁ * T₁.card := by rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have hB : ∑ t ∈ T₂ \ T₁, (H.filter (fun x => f x = t)).card ≤ c₂ * T₂.card := by
    calc ∑ t ∈ T₂ \ T₁, (H.filter (fun x => f x = t)).card ≤ ∑ _t ∈ T₂ \ T₁, c₂ :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t ht => h₂ t (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 ht).1)
      _ = c₂ * (T₂ \ T₁).card := by rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      _ ≤ c₂ * T₂.card := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.sdiff_subset))
  omega

/-! ## 3.  The finite per-middle-row contact target -/

/-- **Finite contact target (KERNEL).**  Let `H` be the contact set of a middle row and let each
contact be charged either to a prime `≤ z` (each such prime absorbing at most two contacts) or to
a multiple of `z²` in `[1, M]` (each absorbing at most four).  Then

`|H| ≤ 2 π(z) + 4 ⌊M / z²⌋`. -/
theorem contact_target_bound {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {H : Finset α} (M z : ℕ)
    (f : α → ℕ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ H, f x ∈ primesLE z ∪ squareMultiples M z)
    (hprime : ∀ q ∈ primesLE z, (H.filter (fun x => f x = q)).card ≤ 2)
    (hsq : ∀ d ∈ squareMultiples M z, (H.filter (fun x => f x = d)).card ≤ 4) :
    H.card ≤ 2 * piCount z + 4 * (M / z ^ 2) := by
  have h := card_le_of_charge 2 4 f hf hprime hsq
  rw [squareMultiples_card] at h
  exact h

/-! ## 4.  The exact balancing identity at the optimizing scale -/

/-- **Exact balancing identity.**  At the optimizing scale `z³ = M l` the two contributions of the
contact target are equal: `M / z² = z / l`.  This is the exact algebraic content of the choice
`z ≍ (M log M)^{1/3}`; no analytic input is used. -/
theorem balanced_scale {M l z : ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0) (hcube : z ^ 3 = M * l) :
    M / z ^ 2 = z / l := by
  field_simp
  nlinarith [hcube]

/-- Consequently, at the optimizing scale the whole finite target collapses to a single term. -/
theorem contact_target_at_balanced_scale {M l z c₁ c₂ : ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) (hl : l ≠ 0)
    (hcube : z ^ 3 = M * l) :
    c₁ * (z / l) + c₂ * (M / z ^ 2) = (c₁ + c₂) * (z / l) := by
  rw [balanced_scale hz hl hcube]; ring

/-! ## 5.  The external asymptotic adapter (uninhabited) -/

/-- **(PNT-ADAPTER), external analytic input.**  The prime-counting bound `π(z) ≪ z / log z`.
`externalAnalyticBank`: recorded, *not* proved in this project. -/
def PrimeCountingAsymptotic : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ z : ℕ, 2 ≤ z → (piCount z : ℝ) ≤ C * (z : ℝ) / Real.log z

/-- The asymptotic contact target `H_p(𝒞) ≪ M^{1/3} (log M)^{-2/3}`, as a statement about a given
contact-size function `H`. -/
def ContactCubeRootTarget (H : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, ∃ M₀ : ℕ, ∀ M : ℕ, M₀ ≤ M →
    H M ≤ C * (M : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) * (Real.log M) ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3)

/-- **(CONTACT-ASYMPTOTIC-ADAPTER), external analytic input.**  The optimization step which
converts the finite target `H M ≤ 2 π(z) + 4 ⌊M/z²⌋`, uniformly in `z`, together with the
prime-counting bound, into the cube-root asymptotic.  It carries the floor bookkeeping and the
analytic estimates for `log z` at `z ≍ (M log M)^{1/3}`.

`externalAnalyticBank`: recorded, *not* proved in this project. -/
def ContactAsymptoticAdapter (H : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  PrimeCountingAsymptotic →
    (∀ M z : ℕ, 2 ≤ z → H M ≤ 2 * (piCount z : ℝ) + 4 * ((M / z ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) →
      ContactCubeRootTarget H

/-- **CONDITIONAL.**  The cube-root contact bound follows from the finite kernel inequality
*only* through the external adapter; the implication is kernel-proved, its premises are not
inhabited here. -/
theorem contact_cubeRoot_conditional {H : ℕ → ℝ} (hadapt : ContactAsymptoticAdapter H)
    (hpnt : PrimeCountingAsymptotic)
    (hfin : ∀ M z : ℕ, 2 ≤ z → H M ≤ 2 * (piCount z : ℝ) + 4 * ((M / z ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :
    ContactCubeRootTarget H := hadapt hpnt hfin

/-- The real-valued form of the finite kernel inequality, ready for the adapter. -/
theorem contact_target_bound_real {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {H : Finset α} (M z : ℕ)
    (f : α → ℕ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ H, f x ∈ primesLE z ∪ squareMultiples M z)
    (hprime : ∀ q ∈ primesLE z, (H.filter (fun x => f x = q)).card ≤ 2)
    (hsq : ∀ d ∈ squareMultiples M z, (H.filter (fun x => f x = d)).card ≤ 4) :
    (H.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (piCount z : ℝ) + 4 * ((M / z ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  have := contact_target_bound M z f hf hprime hsq
  exact_mod_cast this

end ContactTarget
end ResearchBankV6
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=2384 sha256=697bc830f049bf4a5a21766ab7d20b5b29f2300e4c02016ddabaf8463c74f07c path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV6/FullFrozen.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.Window
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV6.SupportDisjointness

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V6: FULL-FROZEN prime-power precision as denominator entry

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The small-prime denominator-entry mechanism of the canonical frontier is the FULL-FROZEN
prime-power precision already banked in this project: `Erdos287.primePower_window_exclusion`
(itself resting on `Erdos287.topLayer_congruence` and the certified constants `C(1..8)`).

This module contains the single new kernel statement needed to plug that mechanism into the V6
row language: under the window-exclusion hypotheses, the denominator set of a hypothetical
counterexample is **disjoint from the whole physical `q`-row** `q = p^e`, i.e. the prime power
never enters any denominator.  Nothing here is re-proved or weakened; the earlier theorem is used
as an import.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV6
namespace FullFrozen

open Finset

/-- **FULL-FROZEN denominator entry (kernel).**  If `A ⊆ [1, M]` has `∑_{a ∈ A} 1/a = 1`,
`q = p^e ≤ M` and `p > C(⌊M/q⌋)`, then `A` is disjoint from the physical `q`-row: no denominator
of `A` is a multiple of `q`. -/
theorem row_disjoint_of_window_exclusion
    (A : Finset ℕ) (M p e : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a) (hAM : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ M)
    (hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / a = 1) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hqM : p ^ e ≤ M)
    (hpC : Erdos287.C (M / p ^ e) < (p : ℤ)) :
    Disjoint A (UpperGap.rowSupport M (p ^ e)) := by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_right]
  intro n hn hnA
  exact Erdos287.primePower_window_exclusion A M p e hp hpos hAM hsum he hqM hpC n hnA
    (UpperGap.mem_rowSupport.1 hn).2

/-- Equivalently: the number of denominators in the excluded row is zero. -/
theorem row_card_zero_of_window_exclusion
    (A : Finset ℕ) (M p e : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpos : ∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a) (hAM : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ M)
    (hsum : ∑ a ∈ A, (1 : ℚ) / a = 1) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hqM : p ^ e ≤ M)
    (hpC : Erdos287.C (M / p ^ e) < (p : ℤ)) :
    (A ∩ UpperGap.rowSupport M (p ^ e)).card = 0 := by
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, ← Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  exact row_disjoint_of_window_exclusion A M p e hp hpos hAM hsum he hqM hpC

end FullFrozen
end ResearchBankV6
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V6: verdict ledger and route-aware closure DAG

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

This module is strictly bookkeeping plus *proved* implications.  It

* preserves the two-dimensional `ResearchStatus × EvidenceKind` discipline of V5 (imported, not
  re-defined, not weakened);
* adds the acceptance `Verdict` scale
  `KERNEL-BANKED / CONDITIONAL-BANKED / COUNTERFIXTURE / OWNER-OPEN / CLOSED`;
* records the V6 ledger and machine-checks that **no** entry is `CLOSED`;
* adds the new route `upperGapCarryV6` beside `anchoredV4` and `contactCoreV5`, and records that
  the three are **not** asserted equivalent;
* enters closure-DAG edges **only** as Lean-proved implications.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV6
namespace Ledger

open Erdos287.ResearchBankV5

/-! ## 1.  Routes -/

/-- The three coexisting research routes after V6.  `anchoredV4` and `contactCoreV5` are the V5
routes (unchanged); `upperGapCarryV6` is the new carry layer. -/
inductive RouteV6
  | anchoredV4
  | contactCoreV5
  | upperGapCarryV6
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The V5 routes embed into the V6 route set; nothing of V5 is renamed or replaced. -/
def ofV5 : ResearchRoute → RouteV6
  | ResearchRoute.anchoredV4 => RouteV6.anchoredV4
  | ResearchRoute.contactCoreV5 => RouteV6.contactCoreV5

theorem ofV5_injective : Function.Injective ofV5 := by
  intro a b h
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [ofV5]

/-- The three routes are pairwise distinct objects of bookkeeping. -/
theorem routes_pairwise_distinct :
    RouteV6.anchoredV4 ≠ RouteV6.contactCoreV5 ∧
    RouteV6.contactCoreV5 ≠ RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6 ∧
    RouteV6.anchoredV4 ≠ RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6 := by decide

/-! ## 2.  The acceptance verdict scale -/

/-- The acceptance verdict of a V6 item. -/
inductive Verdict
  /-- A new exact sorry-free mathematical theorem of this layer. -/
  | kernelBanked
  /-- A logical implication from an explicitly uninhabited interface. -/
  | conditionalBanked
  /-- An exact finite obstruction to an overstrong proposed theorem. -/
  | counterfixture
  /-- A current uninhabited research target. -/
  | ownerOpen
  /-- Forbidden unless a complete route to the original Erdős #287 statement is inhabited. -/
  | closed
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A ledger row: purely decidable bookkeeping data (no `Prop` payload). -/
structure Row where
  /-- Human-readable item name. -/
  name : String
  /-- Route the item belongs to. -/
  route : RouteV6
  /-- Acceptance verdict. -/
  verdict : Verdict
  /-- V5 research status (imported discipline). -/
  status : ResearchStatus
  /-- V5 evidence kind (imported discipline). -/
  evidence : EvidenceKind
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-! ## 3.  The V6 ledger -/

/-- The V6 ledger.  Every row's verdict is justified by the correspondingly named Lean
declaration of this layer (or, for `FULL-FROZEN`, of the earlier layers it imports). -/
def v6Ledger : List Row :=
  [ { name := "FULL-FROZEN prime-power precision (small-prime denominator entry)"
      route := RouteV6.contactCoreV5
      verdict := Verdict.kernelBanked
      status := ResearchStatus.bank
      evidence := EvidenceKind.kernelProof }
  , { name := "contact-core finite per-middle-row target  H ≤ 2π(z) + 4⌊M/z²⌋"
      route := RouteV6.contactCoreV5
      verdict := Verdict.kernelBanked
      status := ResearchStatus.bank
      evidence := EvidenceKind.kernelProof }
  , { name := "contact-core cube-root asymptotic  H ≪ M^{1/3}(log M)^{-2/3}"
      route := RouteV6.contactCoreV5
      verdict := Verdict.ownerOpen
      status := ResearchStatus.«open»
      evidence := EvidenceKind.externalAnalyticBank }
  , { name := "middle band, same-trace completion"
      route := RouteV6.contactCoreV5
      verdict := Verdict.conditionalBanked
      status := ResearchStatus.«open»
      evidence := EvidenceKind.conditionalInterface }
  , { name := "upper-gap denominator entry  ⇔  p ∣ T_p"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.kernelBanked
      status := ResearchStatus.bank
      evidence := EvidenceKind.kernelProof }
  , { name := "upper-gap carry identity  ∑ ε/(pj) = k_p / L_N"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.kernelBanked
      status := ResearchStatus.bank
      evidence := EvidenceKind.kernelProof }
  , { name := "same-height carry aggregation  ∑ = ∑_N K_N / L_N"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.kernelBanked
      status := ResearchStatus.bank
      evidence := EvidenceKind.kernelProof }
  , { name := "upper-gap support disjointness  (pq > M)"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.kernelBanked
      status := ResearchStatus.bank
      evidence := EvidenceKind.kernelProof }
  , { name := "upper-gap contact relation |pj − qℓ| = 1: exact finite lemmas"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.kernelBanked
      status := ResearchStatus.bank
      evidence := EvidenceKind.kernelProof }
  , { name := "cofactor range substitution 1..N  (overstrong)"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.counterfixture
      status := ResearchStatus.killed
      evidence := EvidenceKind.finiteRegressionOnly }
  , { name := "UpperGapCarryCompression (4 candidate interfaces)"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.ownerOpen
      status := ResearchStatus.«open»
      evidence := EvidenceKind.researchConjecture }
  , { name := "ExactMassIntersection  (S = 1)"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.ownerOpen
      status := ResearchStatus.«open»
      evidence := EvidenceKind.researchConjecture }
  , { name := "Erdős #287"
      route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6
      verdict := Verdict.ownerOpen
      status := ResearchStatus.«open»
      evidence := EvidenceKind.researchConjecture } ]

/-- **No `CLOSED` verdict anywhere in V6.** -/
theorem no_closed_verdict : ∀ r ∈ v6Ledger, r.verdict ≠ Verdict.closed := by decide

/-- Erdős #287 is listed, and listed as `OWNER-OPEN`. -/
theorem erdos287_ownerOpen :
    ∃ r ∈ v6Ledger, r.name = "Erdős #287" ∧ r.verdict = Verdict.ownerOpen ∧
      r.status = ResearchStatus.«open» := by decide

/-- Kernel-banked rows are exactly the rows whose evidence kind is `kernelProof`. -/
theorem kernelBanked_iff_kernelProof :
    ∀ r ∈ v6Ledger, r.verdict = Verdict.kernelBanked ↔ r.evidence = EvidenceKind.kernelProof := by
  decide

/-- Every non-kernel row is open, conditional or a counterfixture — never banked as proved
mathematics. -/
theorem nonKernel_rows_not_proved :
    ∀ r ∈ v6Ledger, r.evidence ≠ EvidenceKind.kernelProof →
      r.verdict = Verdict.conditionalBanked ∨ r.verdict = Verdict.ownerOpen ∨
        r.verdict = Verdict.counterfixture := by decide

/-! ## 4.  The closure DAG: only proved implications -/

/-- A DAG edge carries an actual Lean proof of `src → tgt`. -/
structure ProvedEdge where
  /-- The source statement. -/
  src : Prop
  /-- The target statement. -/
  tgt : Prop
  /-- The proof of the edge.  There is no way to enter an edge without one. -/
  proof : src → tgt

/-- Edge: the fixed-cardinality additive interface gives simultaneous middle-row completion. -/
def edge_middleBand : ProvedEdge :=
  { src := MiddleBand.RestrictedSumsetInput
    tgt := ∀ (A : Finset (ZMod 5)) (r : ZMod 5), 3 ≤ A.card →
            5 ≤ 2 * (A.card - 2) + 1 → ∃ B ⊆ A, B.card = 2 ∧ ∑ x ∈ B, x = r
    proof := by
      intro hin A r hA hlong
      exact MiddleBand.restrictedSumset_covers hin (by norm_num) A 2 (by omega) hlong r }

/-- Edge: granularity compression gives the denominator format required by the mass-intersection
consumer. -/
def edge_granularity : ProvedEdge :=
  { src := OpenOwners.UpperGapCarryCompressionGranularity 12
    tgt := ∀ d : OpenOwners.CarryData, d.admissible →
            (OpenOwners.aggregateMass d).den ∣ UpperGap.lcmUpto 12
    proof := fun h d hd => OpenOwners.mass_den_dvd_of_granularity h d hd }

/-- Edge: the final owner gives the non-existence of unit mass. -/
def edge_exactMass : ProvedEdge :=
  { src := OpenOwners.ExactMassIntersection 0 Set.univ Set.univ
    tgt := ∀ m u : ℚ, (0 : ℚ) + m + u ≠ 1
    proof := fun h m u => OpenOwners.no_unit_mass_of_exactMassIntersection h
      (Set.mem_univ m) (Set.mem_univ u) }

/-- Edge: the external contact adapter, together with the prime-counting input and the finite
kernel bound, gives the cube-root asymptotic — and only that way. -/
def edge_contactAsymptotic (H : ℕ → ℝ) : ProvedEdge :=
  { src := ContactTarget.ContactAsymptoticAdapter H ∧ ContactTarget.PrimeCountingAsymptotic ∧
      (∀ M z : ℕ, 2 ≤ z → H M ≤ 2 * (ContactTarget.piCount z : ℝ) + 4 * ((M / z ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    tgt := ContactTarget.ContactCubeRootTarget H
    proof := fun h => ContactTarget.contact_cubeRoot_conditional h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2 }

/-- The V6 closure DAG: the list of edges currently entered.  Every entry is a proved
implication. -/
def closureDagV6 : List ProvedEdge :=
  [edge_middleBand, edge_granularity, edge_exactMass]

/-- Every DAG edge is inhabited as an implication (this is the only content a DAG edge has). -/
theorem dag_edges_are_proved (e : ProvedEdge) (hs : e.src) : e.tgt := e.proof hs

/-! ## 5.  No collapse, no fake closure -/

/-- **No asserted equivalence.**  The three routes are *not* claimed equivalent: from the fact
that two statements are both recorded in the bank one cannot infer that they imply each other. -/
theorem routes_not_claimed_equivalent : ¬ (∀ P Q : Prop, P ↔ Q) := by
  intro h
  exact (h True False).1 trivial

/-- An `ownerOpen` row does not inhabit anything: the ledger row is data, not a proof. -/
theorem ownerOpen_row_is_not_a_proof :
    ∃ (r : Row) (claim : Prop), r.verdict = Verdict.ownerOpen ∧ ¬ claim :=
  ⟨{ name := "owner-open probe", route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6, verdict := Verdict.ownerOpen,
     status := ResearchStatus.«open», evidence := EvidenceKind.researchConjecture },
   False, rfl, not_false⟩

/-- **The ledger is not a proof.**  Adding rows never inhabits a mathematical statement. -/
theorem ledger_is_not_a_proof : ¬ (∀ (_ : Row) (claim : Prop), claim) := by
  intro h
  exact h { name := "probe", route := RouteV6.upperGapCarryV6, verdict := Verdict.ownerOpen,
            status := ResearchStatus.«open», evidence := EvidenceKind.researchConjecture } False

/-- **Erdős #287 is not closed here.**  The V6 layer contains no row with verdict `closed`, and
in particular none for the original problem. -/
theorem erdos287_not_closed_in_v6 :
    ¬ ∃ r ∈ v6Ledger, r.name = "Erdős #287" ∧ r.verdict = Verdict.closed := by decide

end Ledger
end ResearchBankV6
end Erdos287

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V6: the middle-band same-trace theorem (CONDITIONAL)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The canonical middle-band statement is the *same-trace* statement: a feasible frozen-core/top trace
can be preserved while completing all relevant middle rows.

It is **not** manufactured here from weaker interfaces.  Completing a middle row at a *fixed
cardinality* and a *prescribed residue* requires a fixed-cardinality additive theorem of
Dias da Silva–Hamidoune type.  That theorem is neither in this project nor used from Mathlib here,
so it is recorded as the **uninhabited** interface `RestrictedSumsetInput`, and every statement of
this file that depends on it is an implication consuming it as a hypothesis.

Classification: `conditionalInterface`.  **Not** `kernelProof`.

Kernel-proved without any interface:

* `completion_preserves_trace`, `completion_agrees_on_middle` — the trace-preservation bookkeeping
  of a completion supported on coordinates disjoint from the frozen core/top trace.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV6
namespace MiddleBand

open Finset

/-! ## 1.  The required fixed-cardinality additive interface (uninhabited) -/

/-- **(DDS-H-INTERFACE), required external additive input.**  For a prime `p`, a set `A` of
residues and a cardinality `h ≤ |A|`, the set of sums of `h`-element subsets of `A` has at least
`min (p, h(|A| − h) + 1)` elements.

This is the exact fixed-cardinality (restricted sumset) input the middle band needs.  It is
**uninhabited here**: no proof is supplied, in this project or from Mathlib. -/
def RestrictedSumsetInput : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (A : Finset (ZMod p)) (h : ℕ), h ≤ A.card →
    min p (h * (A.card - h) + 1) ≤ ((A.powersetCard h).image (fun B => ∑ x ∈ B, x)).card

/-! ## 2.  Consequences of the interface (all conditional) -/

/-- **CONDITIONAL.**  If the fixed-cardinality additive interface holds and the row is long enough
(`p ≤ h(|A| − h) + 1`), then every prescribed residue `r` is realized by an `h`-element subset of
the available cofactor residues. -/
theorem restrictedSumset_covers (hin : RestrictedSumsetInput) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (A : Finset (ZMod p)) (h : ℕ) (hh : h ≤ A.card) (hlong : p ≤ h * (A.card - h) + 1)
    (r : ZMod p) : ∃ B ⊆ A, B.card = h ∧ ∑ x ∈ B, x = r := by
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  have hcard := hin p hp A h hh
  rw [min_eq_left hlong] at hcard
  have huniv : ((A.powersetCard h).image (fun B => ∑ x ∈ B, x)) = Finset.univ := by
    refine Finset.eq_univ_of_card _ ?_
    have hle : ((A.powersetCard h).image (fun B => ∑ x ∈ B, x)).card ≤ Fintype.card (ZMod p) :=
      Finset.card_le_univ _
    rw [ZMod.card p] at hle ⊢
    omega
  have hr : r ∈ ((A.powersetCard h).image (fun B => ∑ x ∈ B, x)) := by rw [huniv]; exact mem_univ r
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hsum⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hr
  obtain ⟨hBsub, hBcard⟩ := Finset.mem_powersetCard.1 hB
  exact ⟨B, hBsub, hBcard, hsum⟩

/-- **CONDITIONAL (middle rows completable).**  Under the fixed-cardinality additive interface,
all relevant middle rows can be completed simultaneously at their prescribed cardinalities and
prescribed residues. -/
theorem middleRows_completable {ι : Type*} (hin : RestrictedSumsetInput) (rows : Finset ι)
    (p : ι → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i ∈ rows, (p i).Prime)
    (A : (i : ι) → Finset (ZMod (p i))) (h : ι → ℕ)
    (hh : ∀ i ∈ rows, h i ≤ (A i).card)
    (hlong : ∀ i ∈ rows, p i ≤ h i * ((A i).card - h i) + 1)
    (r : (i : ι) → ZMod (p i)) :
    ∃ B : (i : ι) → Finset (ZMod (p i)),
      ∀ i ∈ rows, B i ⊆ A i ∧ (B i).card = h i ∧ ∑ x ∈ B i, x = r i := by
  have key : ∀ i : ι, ∃ Bi : Finset (ZMod (p i)),
      i ∈ rows → (Bi ⊆ A i ∧ Bi.card = h i ∧ ∑ x ∈ Bi, x = r i) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ rows
    · obtain ⟨Bi, h1, h2, h3⟩ :=
        restrictedSumset_covers hin (hp i hi) (A i) (h i) (hh i hi) (hlong i hi) (r i)
      exact ⟨Bi, fun _ => ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨∅, fun hcon => absurd hcon hi⟩
  choose B hB using key
  exact ⟨B, fun i hi => hB i hi⟩

/-! ## 3.  Trace preservation (kernel) -/

/-- A completion supported on the middle coordinates leaves the frozen core/top trace untouched. -/
theorem completion_preserves_trace {frozen mid : Finset ℕ} (hdisj : Disjoint frozen mid)
    (ε₀ ε₁ : ℕ → Bool) :
    ∀ n ∈ frozen, (fun n => if n ∈ mid then ε₁ n else ε₀ n) n = ε₀ n := by
  intro n hn
  have : n ∉ mid := Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hn
  simp [this]

/-- …and realizes the chosen completion on the middle coordinates. -/
theorem completion_agrees_on_middle {mid : Finset ℕ} (ε₀ ε₁ : ℕ → Bool) :
    ∀ n ∈ mid, (fun n => if n ∈ mid then ε₁ n else ε₀ n) n = ε₁ n := by
  intro n hn
  simp [hn]

/-! ## 4.  The conditional middle-band same-trace theorem -/

/-- **CONDITIONAL-BANKED: middle band, same trace.**  Under the fixed-cardinality additive
interface, the middle rows can be completed at the prescribed cardinalities and residues *while
preserving the frozen core/top trace exactly*: the completed selection agrees with the frozen
trace on every frozen coordinate.

This theorem is **conditional**: its first hypothesis is the uninhabited interface
`RestrictedSumsetInput`.  It is not a kernel theorem and does not close the middle band. -/
theorem middleBand_sameTrace_conditional {ι : Type*} (hin : RestrictedSumsetInput)
    (rows : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i ∈ rows, (p i).Prime)
    (A : (i : ι) → Finset (ZMod (p i))) (h : ι → ℕ)
    (hh : ∀ i ∈ rows, h i ≤ (A i).card)
    (hlong : ∀ i ∈ rows, p i ≤ h i * ((A i).card - h i) + 1)
    (r : (i : ι) → ZMod (p i))
    {frozen mid : Finset ℕ} (hdisj : Disjoint frozen mid) (ε₀ ε₁ : ℕ → Bool) :
    (∃ B : (i : ι) → Finset (ZMod (p i)),
        ∀ i ∈ rows, B i ⊆ A i ∧ (B i).card = h i ∧ ∑ x ∈ B i, x = r i) ∧
      (∀ n ∈ frozen, (fun n => if n ∈ mid then ε₁ n else ε₀ n) n = ε₀ n) :=
  ⟨middleRows_completable hin rows p hp A h hh hlong r,
    completion_preserves_trace hdisj ε₀ ε₁⟩

end MiddleBand
end ResearchBankV6
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=8649 sha256=967292c027e86f783dfc7818c23870688605b11b53183eb1c7bb1b7ddd61abe5 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV6/OpenOwners.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV6.UpperGapCarry

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V6: the two new open owners

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Two owners are introduced here, both **uninhabited**:

* `UpperGapCarryCompression*` — the quantitatively explicit compression/lattice statement for
  admissible aggregate carries `K_N`, conditioned on the same physical no-00 trace.  Because the
  current mathematics does not yet single out the strongest useful quantitative form, **four**
  clearly labelled candidate interfaces are recorded (support, window, size, granularity).  All
  four are uninhabited; only their exact logical consequences are proved.
* `ExactMassIntersection` — the unresolved step from denominator-entry / aggregate-carry
  information plus the available middle mass spectrum to the exact equation `S = 1`.

The firewall `den_dvd_does_not_close` is machine-checked: knowing `den(S) ∣ J` is **not** closure.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV6
namespace OpenOwners

open Finset
open Erdos287.ResearchBankV6.UpperGap

/-! ## 1.  Admissible carry data -/

/-- The data consumed by the compression owner: a finite set of heights, the aggregate carries
`K_N`, and the physical `no-00` trace admissibility predicate (kept abstract, since it is a
property of the *physical* selection, not of the numbers `K_N`). -/
structure CarryData where
  /-- The finite set of heights occurring in the current upper gap. -/
  heights : Finset ℕ
  /-- The aggregate carry at each height. -/
  K : ℕ → ℕ
  /-- The physical `no-00` trace admissibility of the underlying selection. -/
  admissible : Prop

/-- The set of *active* heights, i.e. those carrying a nonzero aggregate carry. -/
def activeHeights (d : CarryData) : Finset ℕ := d.heights.filter (fun N => d.K N ≠ 0)

/-- The aggregate upper-gap mass `∑_N K_N / L_N`. -/
def aggregateMass (d : CarryData) : ℚ := ∑ N ∈ d.heights, (d.K N : ℚ) / lcmUpto N

/-- Only active heights contribute to the aggregate mass (kernel). -/
theorem aggregateMass_eq_active (d : CarryData) :
    aggregateMass d = ∑ N ∈ activeHeights d, (d.K N : ℚ) / lcmUpto N := by
  rw [aggregateMass, activeHeights]
  refine (Finset.sum_filter_of_ne ?_).symm
  intro N _ hne hK
  apply hne
  rw [hK]
  simp

/-! ## 2.  Candidate interfaces for UPPER-GAP CARRY COMPRESSION (all uninhabited) -/

/-- **Candidate A — support compression.**  Every admissible carry configuration has at most `c`
active heights.  Quantitative target of the next consumer: `c` absolute (independent of `M`). -/
def UpperGapCarryCompressionSupport (c : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : CarryData, d.admissible → (activeHeights d).card ≤ c

/-- **Candidate B — window compression.**  All active heights of an admissible configuration lie
in a window of explicit width `w` above the smallest active height. -/
def UpperGapCarryCompressionWindow (w : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : CarryData, d.admissible → ∀ N ∈ activeHeights d, ∀ N' ∈ activeHeights d, N ≤ N' + w

/-- **Candidate C — size compression.**  The aggregate carry at each height is bounded by
`c · L_N / N`: the carry cannot use the whole residue range of its height. -/
def UpperGapCarryCompressionSize (c : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : CarryData, d.admissible → ∀ N ∈ d.heights, 1 ≤ N → N * d.K N ≤ c * lcmUpto N

/-- **Candidate D — granularity / lattice compression.**  The aggregate upper-gap mass of an
admissible configuration lies in the lattice `(1 / L_D) ℤ` for the explicit modulus `D`; this is
the exact form the mass-intersection consumer asks for. -/
def UpperGapCarryCompressionGranularity (D : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : CarryData, d.admissible → ∃ k : ℤ, aggregateMass d = (k : ℚ) / lcmUpto D

/-- The four candidates are recorded as *distinct* interfaces; no reduction between them is
claimed here. -/
theorem compression_candidates_not_reduced :
    (UpperGapCarryCompressionSupport 1 → UpperGapCarryCompressionSupport 1) ∧
    (UpperGapCarryCompressionWindow 1 → UpperGapCarryCompressionWindow 1) ∧
    (UpperGapCarryCompressionSize 1 → UpperGapCarryCompressionSize 1) ∧
    (UpperGapCarryCompressionGranularity 1 → UpperGapCarryCompressionGranularity 1) :=
  ⟨id, id, id, id⟩

/-! ## 3.  Exact consequences of the candidates (conditional, kernel-proved implications) -/

/-- **CONDITIONAL.**  Under support compression with `c = 1`, an admissible aggregate mass is a
single carry fraction `K_N / L_N`, or zero. -/
theorem mass_single_term_of_support_one (h : UpperGapCarryCompressionSupport 1)
    (d : CarryData) (hd : d.admissible) :
    aggregateMass d = 0 ∨ ∃ N, aggregateMass d = (d.K N : ℚ) / lcmUpto N := by
  have hcard := h d hd
  rw [aggregateMass_eq_active]
  rcases Finset.card_le_one.1 hcard with hone
  rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty (activeHeights d) with hempty | ⟨N, hN⟩
  · left; rw [hempty]; simp
  · right
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    have : activeHeights d = {N} := by
      refine Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2 ⟨hN, fun x hx => hone x hx N hN⟩
    rw [this, Finset.sum_singleton]

/-- **CONDITIONAL.**  Under granularity compression at modulus `D`, the admissible upper-gap mass
has reduced denominator dividing `L_D`; this is exactly the input format requested by the
mass-intersection consumer. -/
theorem mass_den_dvd_of_granularity {D : ℕ} (h : UpperGapCarryCompressionGranularity D)
    (d : CarryData) (hd : d.admissible) : (aggregateMass d).den ∣ lcmUpto D :=
  (den_dvd_iff (lcmUpto_pos D)).2 (h d hd)

/-- **Kernel.**  Aggregating several carries that already live in the lattice `(1/L)ℤ` stays in
that lattice — the exact granularity algebra that the compression owner must supply externally
only for the *admissibility* part. -/
theorem sum_in_lattice {L : ℕ} (S : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ → ℤ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, ∑ N ∈ S, (k N : ℚ) / L = (m : ℚ) / L := by
  refine ⟨∑ N ∈ S, k N, ?_⟩
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  push_cast
  ring

/-! ## 4.  The final owner: exact mass intersection -/

/-- **`ExactMassIntersection`, OWNER-OPEN.**  Given the frozen core/top mass `frozen`, the set
`middleSpectrum` of masses realizable by the completed middle band, and the set `upperSpectrum` of
masses realizable by admissible upper-gap carries, the unresolved step is the exact equation
`S = 1`: no admissible combination sums to `1`.

This is **uninhabited**: it is the open final owner, not a theorem of this layer. -/
def ExactMassIntersection (frozen : ℚ) (middleSpectrum upperSpectrum : Set ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ middleSpectrum, ∀ u ∈ upperSpectrum, frozen + m + u ≠ 1

/-- The exact logical consequence of the final owner: an admissible configuration cannot have
total mass `1`. -/
theorem no_unit_mass_of_exactMassIntersection {frozen : ℚ} {middleSpectrum upperSpectrum : Set ℚ}
    (h : ExactMassIntersection frozen middleSpectrum upperSpectrum)
    {m u : ℚ} (hm : m ∈ middleSpectrum) (hu : u ∈ upperSpectrum) : frozen + m + u ≠ 1 :=
  h m hm u hu

/-! ## 5.  Firewall: denominator information is not closure -/

/-- **FIREWALL (machine-checked).**  `den(S) ∣ J` does **not** close Erdős #287: for every
modulus `J ≥ 2` there is a rational `S` with `den(S) ∣ J`, `0 < S < 1` (so `S ≠ 1`).  Knowing the
denominator of the total mass therefore never yields the exact equation `S = 1`. -/
theorem den_dvd_does_not_close (J : ℕ) (hJ : 2 ≤ J) :
    ∃ S : ℚ, S.den ∣ J ∧ 0 < S ∧ S < 1 ∧ S ≠ 1 := by
  refine ⟨((J : ℚ) - 1) / J, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : ((J : ℚ) - 1) / J = (((J : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((J : ℤ) : ℚ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h]
    exact (den_dvd_iff (by omega : 0 < J)).2 ⟨(J : ℤ) - 1, rfl⟩
  · have hJ' : (0:ℚ) < (J:ℚ) := by positivity
    have : (1:ℚ) ≤ (J:ℚ) - 1 := by
      have : (2:ℚ) ≤ (J:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
      linarith
    positivity
  · have hJ' : (0:ℚ) < (J:ℚ) := by
      have : (2:ℚ) ≤ (J:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
      linarith
    rw [div_lt_one hJ']
    linarith
  · intro hcon
    have hJ' : (0:ℚ) < (J:ℚ) := by
      have : (2:ℚ) ≤ (J:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hJ
      linarith
    rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq (ne_of_gt hJ')] at hcon
    linarith

/-- The same firewall in non-implication form: denominator divisibility never implies `S = 1`. -/
theorem den_dvd_not_sufficient : ¬ (∀ (S : ℚ) (J : ℕ), 0 < J → S.den ∣ J → S = 1) := by
  intro h
  have := h 0 1 (by norm_num) (by simp)
  norm_num at this

end OpenOwners
end ResearchBankV6
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4622 sha256=aa17118fbb13acd2975d657996e8e248a520202d6a088a9dc39cb0355b767597 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV6/SupportDisjointness.lean@@
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V6: upper-gap support disjointness (kernel)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Elementary, fully kernel-proved support-disjointness for high prime rows:

* `no_shared_denominator` : for distinct primes `p ≠ q` with `p q > M`, no positive `n ≤ M` lies
  in both the `p`-row and the `q`-row;
* `rowSupport_disjoint` : the two physical row supports are disjoint finite sets;
* `rowSupport_disjoint_of_sqrt_lt` : any two distinct prime rows above `√M` have disjoint support.

**Firewall.**  `shared_support_does_not_give_independence` records that disjointness of physical
support does *not* make the row choices independent: the `no-00` neighbour coupling is a
constraint between *different* positions and survives disjointness.  Nothing here may be used to
claim independent row selection.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV6
namespace UpperGap

open Finset

/-! ## 1.  Physical row supports -/

/-- The physical support of the prime row `p` in the window `[1, M]`: the multiples of `p`. -/
def rowSupport (M p : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun n => p ∣ n)

theorem mem_rowSupport {M p n : ℕ} : n ∈ rowSupport M p ↔ (1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ M) ∧ p ∣ n := by
  simp [rowSupport, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, and_assoc]

/-! ## 2.  The disjointness kernel -/

/-- **Support disjointness kernel.**  For distinct primes `p ≠ q` with `p q > M`, no positive
`n ≤ M` is divisible by both `p` and `q`. -/
theorem no_shared_denominator {p q M n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hM : M < p * q) (hn1 : 1 ≤ n) (hn2 : n ≤ M) (hpn : p ∣ n) (hqn : q ∣ n) : False := by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime p q := (Nat.coprime_primes hp hq).2 hpq
  have : p * q ∣ n := Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd hcop hpn hqn
  have hle : p * q ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd hn1 this
  omega

/-- The same statement as disjointness of the two physical supports. -/
theorem rowSupport_disjoint {p q M : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hM : M < p * q) : Disjoint (rowSupport M p) (rowSupport M q) := by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro n hnp hnq
  rw [mem_rowSupport] at hnp hnq
  exact no_shared_denominator hp hq hpq hM hnp.1.1 hnp.1.2 hnp.2 hnq.2

/-- **High rows have disjoint support.**  Two distinct prime rows above `√M` never share a
physical denominator position in `[1, M]`. -/
theorem rowSupport_disjoint_of_sqrt_lt {p q M : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hps : Nat.sqrt M < p) (hqs : Nat.sqrt M < q) : Disjoint (rowSupport M p) (rowSupport M q) := by
  refine rowSupport_disjoint hp hq hpq ?_
  have h : M < (Nat.sqrt M + 1) * (Nat.sqrt M + 1) := by simpa using Nat.lt_succ_sqrt M
  have : (Nat.sqrt M + 1) * (Nat.sqrt M + 1) ≤ p * q :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

/-- Consequently, for a *family* of prime rows all above `√M`, the physical supports are pairwise
disjoint. -/
theorem rowSupports_pairwiseDisjoint {M : ℕ} (P : Finset ℕ)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime ∧ Nat.sqrt M < p) :
    ∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ P, p ≠ q → Disjoint (rowSupport M p) (rowSupport M q) := by
  intro p hpP q hqP hpq
  exact rowSupport_disjoint_of_sqrt_lt (hP p hpP).1 (hP q hqP).1 hpq (hP p hpP).2 (hP q hqP).2

/-! ## 3.  Firewall: disjoint support ≠ independent choices -/

/-- **Firewall.**  Disjointness of the physical supports does **not** imply that the row choices
are independent.  Formally: there is a constraint `R` on a pair of Boolean choices living on
*disjoint* coordinate sets which is not the product of its own coordinate projections — each
coordinate value is individually attainable, yet not every combination is allowed. -/
theorem shared_support_does_not_give_independence :
    ∃ R : Bool → Bool → Prop,
      (∀ a : Bool, ∃ b, R a b) ∧ (∀ b : Bool, ∃ a, R a b) ∧
      ¬ (∀ a b : Bool, R a b) := by
  refine ⟨fun a b => a = b, fun a => ⟨a, rfl⟩, fun b => ⟨b, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro h
  exact absurd (h true false) (by decide)

/-- The concrete form used by the bank: two rows with disjoint supports can still be coupled by a
`no-00` type neighbour condition at *different* positions, so disjointness licenses only the
statement that no *position* is shared. -/
theorem disjoint_support_conclusion_is_only_positional {M p q : ℕ}
    (h : Disjoint (rowSupport M p) (rowSupport M q)) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ rowSupport M p) :
    n ∉ rowSupport M q := Finset.disjoint_left.1 h hn

end UpperGap
end ResearchBankV6
end Erdos287
